        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "// 技术点相关类型定义\nimport { CarModel } from './carModel';\n\nexport interface TechPoint {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  features?: string; // 技术特性（从technology_versions迁移）\n  version?: string; // 版本号（从technology_versions迁移）\n  release_date?: string; // 发布日期（从technology_versions迁移）\n  technology_id?: number; // 关联的技术IP（从technology_versions迁移）\n  category_id: number;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level: number;\n  tech_type: TechType; // 统一使用tech_type与后端保持一致\n  priority: TechPriority;\n  status: TechStatus;\n  tags?: string[];\n  technical_details?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  benefits?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  applications?: string[];\n  keywords?: string[];\n  source_url?: string;\n  created_by?: string;\n  tech_principle?: string; // 技术原理\n  tech_value?: string; // 价值\n  tech_boundary?: string; // 适用边界\n  highlights?: string[]; // 技术亮点列表\n  evidence_measured?: string[]; // 证据-实测列表\n  evidence_certified?: string[]; // 证据-认证列表\n  evidence_comparison?: string[]; // 证据-对比列表\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n  category?: TechCategory;\n}\n\nexport interface TechCategory {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    speech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\n    event_date DATE,\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 知识点收藏表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_point_favorites (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 技术包装材料表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_packaging_materials (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    material_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh',\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 技术推广策略表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\n-- 创建数据库\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\nUSE todify3;\n\n-- 1. 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 2. 车型车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\n);\n\n-- 3. 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 创建数据库",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;",

          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE tech_categories (",

          {

          {

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 15

          {

          {

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建技术点\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_points (\n        name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n        priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n        keywords, source_url, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.name,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.category_id || null,\n      data.parent_id || null,\n      data.level || 1,\n      data.tech_type || TechType.FEATURE,\n      data.priority || Priority.MEDIUM,\n      data.status || Status.DRAFT,\n      data.tags ? JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\n      data.benefits ?         "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    speech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\n    event_date DATE,\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/database/database-design-v2.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

          "endPosition": {

        },
        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |",

        "contents": "async function createTechTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  if (await tableExists('tech_points')) {\n    console.log('✅ tech_points 表已存在');\n  } else {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\n        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n        name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n        description TEXT,\n        category_id INTEGER,\n        parent_id INTEGER,\n        level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n        tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n        priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\n        status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n        tags TEXT,\n        technical_details TEXT,\n        benefits TEXT,\n        applications TEXT,\n        keywords TEXT,\n        source_url VARCHAR(500),\n        created_by VARCHAR(255),\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n        FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n      );\n      \n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_category_id ON tech_points(category_id);\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_parent_id ON tech_points(parent_id);\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_status ON tech_points(status);\n    &#96;;\n    await executeSQL(sql);\n    console.log('✅ tech_points 表创建成功');\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 创建页面工具配置表\n */\nasync function createPageToolConfigTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  if\n}",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

        "contents": "// 技术点相关类型定义\nimport { CarModel } from './carModel';\n\nexport interface TechPoint {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  features?: string; // 技术特性（从technology_versions迁移）\n  version?: string; // 版本号（从technology_versions迁移）\n  release_date?: string; // 发布日期（从technology_versions迁移）\n  technology_id?: number; // 关联的技术IP（从technology_versions迁移）\n  category_id: number;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level: number;\n  tech_type: TechType; // 统一使用tech_type与后端保持一致\n  priority: TechPriority;\n  status: TechStatus;\n  tags?: string[];\n  technical_details?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  benefits?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  applications?: string[];\n  keywords?: string[];\n  source_url?: string;\n  created_by?: string;\n  tech_principle?: string; // 技术原理\n  tech_value?: string; // 价值\n  tech_boundary?: string; // 适用边界\n  highlights?: string[]; // 技术亮点列表\n  evidence_measured?: string[]; // 证据-实测列表\n  evidence_certified?: string[]; // 证据-认证列表\n  evidence_comparison?: string[]; // 证据-对比列表\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n  category?: TechCategory;\n}\n\nexport interface TechCategory {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建技术点\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_points (\n        name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n        priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n        keywords, source_url, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.name,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.category_id || null,\n      data.parent_id || null,\n      data.level || 1,\n      data.tech_type || TechType.FEATURE,\n      data.priority || Priority.MEDIUM,\n      data.status || Status.DRAFT,\n      data.tags ? JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.benefits) : null,\n      data.applications ? JSON.stringify(data.applications) : null,\n      data.keywords ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\n      data.source_url || null,\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\n\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\n\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\n\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\n\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\n\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\n\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\n\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\n\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\n\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\n\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\n\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\n\n存储Agent工作流定义。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\n-- 创建数据库\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\nUSE todify3;\n\n-- 1. 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 2. 车型车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\n);\n\n-- 3. 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "-- ==============================================",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "-- ==============================================",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    name TEXT NOT NULL,",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "    description TEXT,",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "    cover_image TEXT,",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    icon TEXT,",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    created_by TEXT,",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    last_opened_at DATETIME",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "-- ==============================================",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "-- ==============================================",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 项目与技术点关联表",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "    notes TEXT,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)",

          },
          {
            "text": "    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,",

            "text": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (",

        "contents": "-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(speech_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第四层：工作流与对话层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- Agent工作流表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_workflows (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0.0',\n    nodes TEXT NOT NULL,              -- JSON字符串，存储节点列表\n    edges TEXT NOT NULL,              -- JSON字符串，存储边列表\n    metadata TEXT,                     -- JSON字符串，存储元数据\n    published INTEGER DEFAULT 0,       -- 0或1，是否已发布\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 工作流模板表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_templates (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT NOT NULL,\n    category TEXT NOT NULL,\n    thumbnail TEXT,\n    workflow_structure TEXT NOT NULL,  -- JSON字符串，存储工作流结构\n    metadata TEXT,                     -- JSON字符串，元数据\n    is_public INTEGER DEFAULT 0,       -- 0或1，是否公开\n    usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,     -- 使用次数\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 统一的工作流执行表（合并Agent工作流和Dify工作流执行记录）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,",

JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\n      data.source_url || null,\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n    return result.length &gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有技术点\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;TechPoint&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n        values.push(value);\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据分类ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findByCategoryId(categoryId: number, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;TechPoint[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \n      WHERE category_id = ? AND status = ?\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [categoryId, Status.ACTIVE]);\n    return result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据父级ID获取子技术点\n   */\n  async findByParentId(parentId: number | null, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;TechPoint[]&gt; {\n    const whereCondition = parentId === null ? 'parent_id IS NULL' : 'parent_id = ?';\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \n      WHERE ${whereCondition} AND status = ?\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = parentId === null ? [Status.ACTIVE] : [parentId, Status.ACTIVE];\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点树结构\n   */\n  async getTree(categoryId?: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint[]&gt; {\n    let sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \n      WHERE status = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const values: any[] = [Status.ACTIVE];\n\n    if (categoryId) {\n      sql += ' AND category_id = ?';\n      values.push(categoryId);\n    }\n\n    sql += ' ORDER BY level ASC, priority DESC, created_at DESC';\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const techPoints = result.map((row: any) =&gt; { children?: TechPoint[] })[] = [];\n\n    // 初始化所有技术点\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&gt; {\n      techPointMap.set(techPoint.id, { ...techPoint, children: [] });\n    });\n\n    // 构建父子关系\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&gt; {\n      const techPointWithChildren = techPointMap.get(techPoint.id)!;\n      \n      if (techPoint.parent_id === null) {\n        rootTechPoints.push(techPointWithChildren);\n      } else {\n        const parent = techPointMap.get(techPoint.parent_id!);\n        if (parent) {\n          parent.children!.push(techPointWithChildren);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    return rootTechPoints;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新技术点\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with child tech points');\n    }\n\n    const sql = 'DELETE FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &gt;                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"CREATE TABLE tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\","

                  "lineNumber": 66403,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\n    notes TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 知识点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    source_query TEXT,\\n    source_url TEXT,\\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 插入示例数据\\n-- 技术分类示例数据\\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\\n\\n-- 车型车系示例数据\\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\\n\\n-- 技术点示例数据\\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据\","

created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\n-- NULL,\\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\n    notes TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\n--    created_by INTEGER,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\n    notes TEXT,\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\\n);\","

                  "lineNumber": 90981,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    // 获取通稿\\n    const pressSql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT pr.*, pt.weight \\n      FROM tech_press_releases pr\\n      JOIN press_tech_points pt ON pr.id = pt.press_release_id\\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\\n      ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    // 获取演讲稿\\n    const speechSql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT sp.*, st.weight \\n      FROM tech_speeches sp\\n      JOIN speech_tech_points st ON sp.id = st.speech_id\\n      WHERE st.tech_point_id = ?\\n      ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n\\n    const [packagingResult, promotionResult, pressResult, speechResult] = await Promise.all([\\n      this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]),\\n      this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]),\\n      this.db.query(pressSql, [techPointId]),\\n      this.db.query(speechSql, [techPointId])\\n    ]);\\n\\n    return {\\n      packagingMaterials: packagingResult,\\n      promotionStrategies: promotionResult,\\n      pressReleases: pressResult,\\n      speeches: speechResult\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\\n   */\\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&amp;lt;any[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT cm.*, tcm.application_status, tcm.implementation_date, tcm.notes\\n      FROM car_models cm\\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\\n      ORDER BY cm.brand, cm.series, cm.model\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    return await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 关联车型到技术点\\n   */\\n  async associateCarModel(\\n    techPointId: number, \\n    carModelId: number, \\n    applicationStatus?: string,\\n    implementationDate?: string,\\n    notes?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否已存在关联\\n    const existingSql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT id FROM tech_point_car_models \\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\\n    \\n    if (existing.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \\n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\\n      )\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [\\n      techPointId,\\n      carModelId,\\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\\n      implementationDate || null,\\n      notes || null\\n    ];\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result[0];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\\n   */\\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      DELETE FROM tech_point_car_models \\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\\n    // 对于DELETE操作，检查是否有行被影响\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;gt; 0 : true;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新车型关联信息\\n   */\\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(\\n    techPointId: number,\\n    carModelId: number,\\n    applicationStatus?: string,\\n    implementationDate?: string,\\n    notes?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_point_car_models \\n      SET \\n        application_status = COALESCE(?, application_status),\\n        implementation_date = COALESCE(?, implementation_date),\\n        notes = COALESCE(?, notes),\\n        updated_at = datetime('now')\\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [\\n      applicationStatus,\\n      implementationDate,\\n      notes,\\n      techPointId,\\n      carModelId\\n    ];\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 解析JSON字段\\n   */\\n  private parseJsonFields(row: any): any {\\n    if (!row) return row;\\n    \\n    const jsonFields = ['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'];\\n    const parsed = { ...row };\\n    \\n    jsonFields.forEach(field =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (parsed[field] &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof parsed[field] === 'string') {\\n        try {\\n          parsed[field] = JSON.parse(parsed[field]);\\n        } catch (e) {\\n          // 如果解析失败，保持原值\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n    \\n    return parsed;\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\\n-- 创建数据库\\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\nUSE todify3;\\n\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\n);\\n\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 93667,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\n    notes TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 知识点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    source_query TEXT,\\n    source_url TEXT,\\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\","

                  "lineNumber": 94232,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \");-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\","

                  "lineNumber": 95651,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- 项目表\\n-- 用于存储项目信息\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    cover_image TEXT,\\n    icon TEXT,\\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n    created_by TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\\n);\\n\\n-- 项目来源表\\n-- 用于关联项目与各种来源（文件、URL、文本、技术点等）\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('file', 'url', 'text', 'tech_point', 'knowledge_point')),\\n    source_content TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    source_title TEXT,\\n    source_description TEXT,\\n    metadata TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 创建索引\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_type ON projects(type);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_status ON projects(status);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_created_at ON projects(created_at);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_last_opened_at ON projects(last_opened_at);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_project_id ON project_sources(project_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_source_type ON project_sources(source_type);\","

                  "lineNumber": 95979,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 插入示例数据\\n-- 技术分类示例数据\\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\\n\\n-- 车型车系示例数据\\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\\n\\n-- 技术点示例数据\\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\","

AND car_model_id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\\n    \\n    if (existing.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \\n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\\n      )\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [\\n      techPointId,\\n      carModelId,\\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\\n      implementationDate || null,\\n      notes || null\\n    ];\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result[0];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\\n   */\\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      DELETE FROM tech_point_car_models \\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\\n    // 对于DELETE操作，检查是否有行被影响\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;gt; 0 : true;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新车型关联信息\\n   */\\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(\\n    techPointId: number,\\n    carModelId: number,\\n    applicationStatus?: string,\\n    implementationDate?: string,\\n    notes?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_point_car_models \\n      SET \\n        application_status = COALESCE(?, application_status),\\n        implementation_date = COALESCE(?, implementation_date),\\n        notes = COALESCE(?, notes),\\n        updated_at = datetime('now')\\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [\\n      applicationStatus,\\n      implementationDate,\\n      notes,\\n      techPointId,\\n      carModelId\\n    ];\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 解析JSON字段\\n   */\\n  private parseJsonFields(row: any): any {\\n    if (!row) return row;\\n    \\n    const jsonFields = ['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'];\\n    const parsed = { ...row };\\n    \\n    jsonFields.forEach(field =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (parsed[field] &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof parsed[field] === 'string') {\\n        try {\\n          parsed[field] = JSON.parse(parsed[field]);\\n        } catch (e) {\\n          // 如果解析失败，保持原值\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n    \\n    return parsed;\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class TPD2DataImporter {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 导入技术点与资源关联\\n   */\\n  async importTechPointResources(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    imported: number;\\n    skipped: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      imported: 0,\\n      skipped: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      const tableExists = await this.tableExistsTPD2('tech_point_resources');\\n      if (!tableExists) {\\n        logger.warn('TPD2 数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，跳过资源关联导入');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查目标数据库中是否有 tech_point_resources 表\\n      const targetTableExists = await this.targetDb.query(\\n        \\\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='tech_point_resources'\\\"\\n      );\\n\\n      if (!targetTableExists || targetTableExists.length === 0) {\\n        logger.warn('目标数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，创建表结构...');\\n        await this.targetDb.query(&amp;#96;\\n          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_resources (\\n            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n            tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n            resource_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n            created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n            FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n            FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n            UNIQUE(tech_point_id, resource_id)\\n          )\\n        &amp;#96;);\\n        logger.info('✅ tech_point_resources 表创建成功');\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('开始导入技术点与资源关联...');\\n      const associations = await this.queryTPD2('SELECT * FROM tech_point_resources ORDER BY tech_point_id, resource_id');\\n\\n      if (associations.length === 0) {\\n        logger.info('TPD2 数据库中没有技术点与资源关联数据');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;找到 ${associations.length} 个技术点与资源关联&amp;#96;);\\n\\n      for (const assoc of associations)\\n  }\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\n    notes TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 知识点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    source_query TEXT,\\n    source_url TEXT,\\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\","

{\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT cm.*, tcm.application_status, tcm.implementation_date, tcm.notes\\n      FROM car_models cm\\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\\n      ORDER BY cm.brand_id, cm.name\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    return await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 关联车型到技术点\\n   */\\n  async associateCarModel(\\n    techPointId: number, \\n    carModelId: number, \\n    applicationStatus?: string,\\n    implementationDate?: string,\\n    notes?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否已存在关联\\n    const existingSql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT id FROM tech_point_car_models \\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\\n    \\n    if (existing.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \\n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\\n      )\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [\\n      techPointId,\\n      carModelId,\\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\\n      implementationDate || null,\\n      notes || null\\n    ];\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result[0];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\\n   */\\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      DELETE FROM tech_point_car_models \\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\\n    // 对于DELETE操作，检查是否有行被影响\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;gt; 0 : true;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新车型关联信息\\n   */\\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(\\n    techPointId: number,\\n    carModelId: number,\\n    applicationStatus?: string,\\n    implementationDate?: string,\\n    notes?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_point_car_models \\n      SET \\n        application_status = COALESCE(?, application_status),\\n        implementation_date = COALESCE(?, implementation_date),\\n        notes = COALESCE(?, notes),\\n        updated_at = datetime('now')\\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? logger.info(&amp;#96;资源导入完成: 新增 ${stats.imported} 个, 更新 ${stats.updated} 个, 错误 ${stats.errors} 个&amp;#96;);\\n      return stats;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('导入资源失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 导入技术点与资源关联\\n   */\\n  async importTechPointResources(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    imported: number;\\n    skipped: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n logger.info('开始导入技术点与资源关联...');\\n      const associations = await this.queryTPD2('SELECT * FROM tech_point_resources ORDER BY tech_point_id, resource_id');\\n\\n      if (associations.length === 0) {\\n        logger.info('TPD2 数据库中没有技术点与资源关联数据');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;找到 ${associations.length} 个技术点与资源关联&amp;#96;);\\n\\n      for (const assoc of                   "content": "        \"contents\": \");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 插入示例数据\\n-- 技术分类示例数据\\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\\n\\n-- 车型车系示例数据\\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\\n\\n-- 技术点示例数据\\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据\","

                  "lineNumber": 150736,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\","

                  "lineNumber": 151363,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"async function createTechTables(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n\\n  }\\n\\n  if (await tableExists('tech_points')) {\\n    console.log('✅ tech_points 表已存在');\\n  } else {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\n        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n        name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n        description TEXT,\\n        category_id INTEGER,\\n        parent_id INTEGER,\\n        level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n        tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\n        priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\n        status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n        tags TEXT,\\n        technical_details TEXT,\\n        benefits TEXT,\\n        applications TEXT,\\n        keywords TEXT,\\n        source_url VARCHAR(500),\\n        created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n        FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n        FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n      );\\n      \\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_category_id ON tech_points(category_id);\\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_parent_id ON tech_points(parent_id);\\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_status ON tech_points(status);\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    await executeSQL(sql);\\n    console.log('✅ tech_points 表创建成功');\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建页面工具配置表\\n */\\nasync function createPageToolConfigTable(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n  if\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 151851,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\\n-- 创建数据库\\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\nUSE todify3;\\n\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\n);\\n\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\","

                  "lineNumber": 152026,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\n    notes TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 知识点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    source_query TEXT,\\n    source_url TEXT,\\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\","

}\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 查询 TPD2 数据库\\n   */\\n  private async queryTPD2(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&amp;lt;any[]&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!this.tpd2Db) {\\n      throw new Error('TPD2  resolve();\\n        });\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 检查表是否存在\\n   */\\n  private async tableExistsTPD2(tableName: string): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const  try {\\n      // 检查表是否存在\\n      const categoriesTableExists = await this.tableExistsTPD2('tech_categories');\\n      if (!categoriesTableExists) {\\n        logger.warn('TPD2 数据库中不存在 tech_categories category.description || null,\\n                category.parent_id || null,\\n                category.level || 1,\\n                category.sort_order || 0,\\n                category.status || stats.imported++;\\n            logger.debug(&amp;#96;导入分类: ${category.name} (ID: ${category.id})&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;导入分类失败 (ID:
