                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\\n-- 创建数据库\\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\nUSE todify3;\\n\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\n);\\n\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 插入示例数据\\n-- 技术分类示例数据\\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\\n\\n-- 车型车系示例数据\\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\\n\\n-- 技术点示例数据\\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据\","

         -- 开始时间（Dify工作流）\\\\\\\\n    finished_at DATETIME,              -- 完成时间（Dify工作流）\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\\\\\\\\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\\\\\\\\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- COMMENT '排序',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\\\\\n    series TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"                  \\\"content\\\": \\\"  \\\\\\\"contents\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\\\\\\\\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\\\\\\\\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 品牌表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\\\\\\\n    name_en TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    logo_url TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    country TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    founded_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 车型表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name_en TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\\\\\\\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 车系表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术分类表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\\\\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\\\\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\\\\\\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\\\\\\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\\\\\\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\\\\\\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\\\\\\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\\\\\\\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 知识点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    source_query TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    source_url TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\\\\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\\\\\\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\\\\\\\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 知识点收藏表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_point_favorites (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(user_id, knowledge_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术包装材料表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_packaging_materials (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    content TEXT NOT DEFAULT 'draft',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术推广策略表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    strategy_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    target_market VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    timeline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储时间线\\\\\\\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(100),\\\\\\\\n    kpi_metrics TEXT, -- JSON格式存储KPI指标\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术通稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_press_releases (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    subtitle VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    summary TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    release_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    target_media TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\\\\\\\n    publication_date DATE,\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\\\\\\\\n    seo_keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\\\\\\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    published_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术演讲稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    event_date DATE,\\\\\\\\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(speech_id, tech_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第四层：工作流与对话层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- Agent工作流表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_workflows (\\\\\\\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0.0',\\\\\\\\n    nodes TEXT NOT NULL,              -- JSON字符串，存储节点列表\\\\\\\\n    edges TEXT NOT NULL,              -- JSON字符串，存储边列表\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT,                     -- JSON字符串，存储元数据\\\\\\\\n    published INTEGER DEFAULT 0,       -- 0或1，是否已发布\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 工作流模板表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_templates (\\\\\\\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    category TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    thumbnail TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    workflow_structure TEXT NOT NULL,  -- JSON字符串，存储工作流结构\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT,                     -- JSON字符串，元数据\\\\\\\\n    is_public INTEGER DEFAULT 0,       -- 0或1，是否公开\\\\\\\\n    usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,     -- 使用次数\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 统一的工作流执行表（合并Agent工作流和Dify工作流执行记录）\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\\\\\\\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\\\\\\\n    execution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution_type IN ('agent_workflow', 'dify_workflow')),\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- Agent工作流执行字段\\\\\\\\n    workflow_id TEXT,                  -- 关联agent_workflows.id\\\\\\\\n    workflow_name TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    shared_context TEXT DEFAULT '{}',  -- JSON字符串，共享上下文\\\\\\\\n    node_results TEXT DEFAULT '[]',    -- JSON字符串，节点执行结果列表\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- Dify工作流执行字段\\\\\\\\n    workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE,       -- Dify工作流运行ID\\\\\\\\n    task_id TEXT,                      -- Dify任务ID\\\\\\\\n    message_id TEXT,                    -- 关联chat_messages.message_id\\\\\\\\n    app_type TEXT,                      -- 应用类型\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 通用执行字段\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',\\\\\\\\n    error_message TEXT,                -- 错误信息\\\\\\\\n    inputs TEXT,                        -- JSON格式存储输入\\\\\\\\n    outputs TEXT,                       -- JSON格式存储输出\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 执行统计\\\\\\\\n    elapsed_time REAL DEFAULT 0,        -- 执行时间（秒）\\\\\\\\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_steps INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    duration INTEGER,                   -- 持续时间（毫秒，用于Agent工作流）\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\\\\\n    start_time TIMESTAMP,              -- 开始时间\\\\\\\\n    end_time TIMESTAMP,                -- 结束时间\\\\\\\\n    started_at DATETIME,                -- 开始时间（Dify工作流）\\\\\\\\n    finished_at DATETIME,              -- 完成时间（Dify工作流）\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES agent_workflows(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 对话会话表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\\\\\\\\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\\\\\\\\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\\\\\\\\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 聊天消息表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\\\\\\\\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\\\\\\\\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\\\\\\\\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\\\\\\\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\\\\\\\\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\\\\\\\\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\\\\\\\\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- Dify响应相关字段\\\\\\\\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\\\\\\\\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\\\\\\\\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 使用统计\\\\\\\\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\\\\\\\\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\\\\\\\\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\\\\\\\\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 状态和时间\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\\\\\\\\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 知识使用日志表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_usage_logs (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    message_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联的消息ID\\\\\\\\n    knowledge_point_ids TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储使用的知识点ID\\\\\\\\n    context_summary TEXT, -- JSON格式存储上下文摘要\\\\\\\\n    context_length INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 上下文长度\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第五层：配置与统计层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- AI角色表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_roles 来源标记：'smart-workflow', 'independent-page', 'custom'\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT \\\\\\\\n    -- 用户行为\\\\\\\\n    user_satisfaction_score REAL,\\\\\\\\n    user_behavior_data TEXT, -- JSON格式\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\\\\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\\\\\\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\\\\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\\\\\\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\\\\\\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\\\\\\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\\\\\n '包装内容',\\\\\\\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已发布', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by BIGINT COMMENT '审核人ID',\\\\\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '发布时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE (target_audience),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);-- 6. 技术推广策略表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 7. 技术通稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_press_releases (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '摘要',\\\\\\\\n    press_type ENUM('新技术发布', '技术突破', '合作公告', '产品发布', '其他') DEFAULT '新技术发布' COMMENT '通稿类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_media JSON COMMENT '目标媒体列表',\\\\\\\\n    keywords JSON COMMENT '关键词',\\\\\\\\n    release_date DATE COMMENT '计划发布日期',\\\\\\\\n    embargo_date DATETIME COMMENT '禁发时间',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE  country TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    founded_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name_en TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 车系表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    model_id market_segment VARCHAR(100),\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术分类表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    parent_id DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\\\\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\\\\\\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\\\\\\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\\\\\\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\\\\\\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\\\\\\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY implementation_date DATE,\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 知识点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n JSON字符串格式\\\\\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\\\\\\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\\\\\\\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 知识点收藏表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_point_favorites (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(user_id, knowledge_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术包装材料表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS DEFAULT 'draft',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术推广策略表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    strategy_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    target_market VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    timeline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储时间线\\\\\\\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(100),\\\\\\\\n    kpi_metrics TEXT, -- JSON格式存储KPI指标\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术通稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_press_releases (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT    publication_date DATE,\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\\\\\\\\n    seo_keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\\\\\\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    published_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术演讲稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    event_date DATE,\\\\\\\\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT tech_point_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第四层：工作流与对话层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- Agent工作流表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_workflows (\\\\\\\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0.0',\\\\\\\\n    nodes TEXT NOT NULL,              -- JSON字符串，存储节点列表\\\\\\\\n    edges TEXT NOT NULL,              -- JSON字符串，存储边列表\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT,                     -- JSON字符串，存储元数据\\\\\\\\n    published INTEGER DEFAULT 0,       -- 0或1，是否已发布\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 工作流模板表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_templates (\\\\\\\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    category TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    thumbnail TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    workflow_structure TEXT NOT NULL,  -- JSON字符串，存储工作流结构\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT,                     -- JSON字符串，元数据\\\\\\\\n    is_public INTEGER DEFAULT 0,       -- 0或1，是否公开\\\\\\\\n    usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,     -- 使用次数\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 统一的工作流执行表（合并Agent工作流和Dify工作流执行记录）\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\\\\\\\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\\\\\\\n    execution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution_type IN ('agent_workflow', 'dify_workflow')),\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- Agent工作流执行字段\\\\\\\\n    workflow_id TEXT,                  -- 关联agent_workflows.id\\\\\\\\n    workflow_name TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    shared_context TEXT DEFAULT '{}',  -- JSON字符串，共享上下文\\\\\\\\n    node_results TEXT DEFAULT '[]',    -- JSON字符串，节点执行结果列表\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- Dify工作流执行字段\\\\\\\\n    workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE,       -- Dify工作流运行ID\\\\\\\\n    task_id TEXT,                      -- Dify任务ID\\\\\\\\n    message_id TEXT,                    -- 关联chat_messages.message_id\\\\\\\\n    app_type TEXT,                      -- 应用类型\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 通用执行字段\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',\\\\\\\\n    error_message TEXT,                -- 错误信息\\\\\\\\n    inputs TEXT,                        -- JSON格式存储输入\\\\\\\\n    outputs TEXT,                       -- JSON格式存储输出\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 执行统计\\\\\\\\n    elapsed_time REAL DEFAULT 0,        -- 执行时间（秒）\\\\\\\\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_steps INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    duration INTEGER,                   -- 持续时间（毫秒，用于Agent工作流）\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\\\\\n    start_time TIMESTAMP,              -- 开始时间\\\\\\\\n    end_time TIMESTAMP,                -- 结束时间\\\\\\\\n    started_at DATETIME,                -- 开始时间（Dify工作流）\\\\\\\\n    finished_at DATETIME,              -- 完成时间（Dify工作流）\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES agent_workflows(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 对话会话表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\\\\\\\\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\\\\\\\\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\\\\\\\\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 聊天消息表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\\\\\\\\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\\\\\\\\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\\\\\\\\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\\\\\\\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\\\\\\\\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\\\\\\\\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\\\\\\\\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- Dify响应相关字段\\\\\\\\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\\\\\\\\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\\\\\\\\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 使用统计\\\\\\\\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\\\\\\\\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\\\\\\\\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\\\\\\\\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 状态和时间\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\\\\\\\\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 知识使用日志表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_usage_logs (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    message_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联的消息ID\\\\\\\\n    knowledge_point_ids TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储使用的知识点ID\\\\\\\\n    context_summary TEXT, -- JSON格式存储上下文摘要\\\\\\\\n    context_length INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 上下文长度\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第五层：配置与统计层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- AI角色表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_roles (\\\\\\\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    avatar TEXT,                     -- 角色头像URL（可选）\\\\\\\\n    system_prompt TEXT,               -- 系统提示词（可选）\\\\\\\\n    dify_config TEXT NOT NULL,       -- JSON字符串，存储Dify配置\\\\\\\\n    enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- 0或1，是否启用\\\\\\\\n    source TEXT,                     -- 来源标记：'smart-workflow', 'independent-page', 'custom'\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 公开页面配置表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_page_configs (\\\\\\\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    address TEXT,                              -- 地址配置\\\\\\\\n    display_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all',  -- all/workflow/custom/role\\\\\\\\n    workflow_id TEXT,                          -- 关联的工作流ID（workflow模式）\\\\\\\\n    role_ids TEXT,                             -- JSON字符串，角色ID列表（custom/role模式）\\\\\\\\n    access_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,         -- 访问令牌，用于生成访问链接\\\\\\\\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,               -- 0或1，是否启用\\\\\\\\n    template_type TEXT,                        -- 模板类型: 'speech', 'ai-chat', 'custom'\\\\\\\\n    custom_html TEXT,                          -- 自定义HTML内容\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 页面工具配置表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_tool_configs (\\\\\\\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\\\\\\\n    page_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- 页面类型: 'tech-package', 'press-release', 'tech-strategy', workflow_selection_key TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 工作流选择键\\\\\\\\n    enabled_tool_ids TEXT,            -- JSON数组，启用的工具ID列表\\\\\\\\n    feature_label_map TEXT,           -- JSON对象，功能标签映射\\\\\\\\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,     -- 0或1，是否启用\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 文件存储表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 文件唯一标识\\\\\\\\n    original_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件MIME类型\\\\\\\\n    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL, -- 文件大小（字节）\\\\\\\\n    file_hash TEXT, -- 文件哈希值（用于去重）\\\\\\\\n    category TEXT DEFAULT 'general', -- 文件分类\\\\\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储标签\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT, -- 文件描述\\\\\\\\n    uploader_id TEXT, -- 上传者ID\\\\\\\\n    conversation_id TEXT, -- 关联的对话ID（可选）\\\\\\\\n    usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 使用次数\\\\\\\\n    last_used_at DATETIME, -- 最后使用时间\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 工作流节点使用统计表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_node_usage (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    node_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 节点ID\\\\\\\\n    node_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 节点名称\\\\\\\\n    node_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 节点类型\\\\\\\\n    session_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 会话ID\\\\\\\\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户ID\\\\\\\\n    ai_role_id TEXT, -- 关联AI角色ID\\\\\\\\n    workflow_execution_id TEXT, -- 关联工作流执行ID\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 使用统计\\\\\\\\n    usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\\\\\\\\n    total_time_spent REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    avg_response_time REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    success_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    failure_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 内容统计\\\\\\\\n    total_characters INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    avg_characters INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    content_quality_score REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 用户交互统计\\\\\\\\n    likes_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    dislikes_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    regenerations_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    adoptions_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    edits_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 工作流上下文\\\\\\\\n    is_workflow_mode BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\\\\\\\\n    is_standalone_mode BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\\\\\\\\n    previous_node_id TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    next_node_id TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\\\\\n    first_used_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    last_used_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (ai_role_id) REFERENCES ai_roles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (workflow_execution_id) REFERENCES workflow_executions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- AI问答评价统计表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_qa_feedback (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    message_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联的消息ID\\\\\\\\n    node_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 节点ID\\\\\\\\n    session_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 会话ID\\\\\\\\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户ID\\\\\\\\n    ai_role_id TEXT, -- 关联AI角色ID\\\\\\\\n    workflow_execution_id TEXT, -- 关联工作流执行ID\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 评价类型\\\\\\\\n    feedback_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (feedback_type IN ('like', 'dislike', 'adopt', 'regenerate', 'edit')),\\\\\\\\n    feedback_value INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    feedback_comment TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 内容分析\\\\\\\\n    response_time REAL,\\\\\\\\n    content_length INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    content_quality_score REAL,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 上下文信息\\\\\\\\n    query_text TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    response_text TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    context_data TEXT, -- JSON格式\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (ai_role_id) REFERENCES ai_roles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (workflow_execution_id) REFERENCES workflow_executions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 工作流会话统计表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_session_stats (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    session_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 会话ID\\\\\\\\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户ID\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 会话基本信息\\\\\\\\n    session_start_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    session_end_time DATETIME,\\\\\\\\n    session_duration REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 工作流完整性统计\\\\\\\\n    total_nodes_visited INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    completed_nodes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    skipped_nodes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 节点访问记录（JSON格式）\\\\\\\\n    node_visit_sequence TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    node_completion_status TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 跳出点分析\\\\\\\\n    exit_node_id TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    exit_reason TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    exit_time DATETIME,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 工作流路径分析\\\\\\\\n    workflow_path TEXT, -- JSON格式\\\\\\\\n    path_efficiency_score REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 用户满意度\\\\\\\\n    overall_satisfaction_score REAL,\\\\\\\\n    user_feedback TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 节点内容处理统计表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_content_processing (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    node_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 节点ID\\\\\\\\n    session_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 会话ID\\\\\\\\n    message_id TEXT, -- 消息ID\\\\\\\\n    ai_role_id TEXT, -- 关联AI角色ID\\\\\\\\n    workflow_execution_id TEXT, -- 关联工作流执行ID\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 内容处理类型\\\\\\\\n    processing_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (processing_type IN ('direct_adopt', 'edit_adopt', 'regenerate', 'abandon')),\\\\\\\\n    processing_time REAL,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 内容分析\\\\\\\\n    original_content_length INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    final_content_length INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    edit_ratio REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 编辑详情\\\\\\\\n    edit_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    edit_types TEXT, -- JSON格式\\\\\\\\n    edit_duration REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 用户行为\\\\\\\\n    user_satisfaction_score REAL,\\\\\\\\n    user_behavior_data TEXT, -- JSON格式\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (ai_role_id) REFERENCES ai_roles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (workflow_execution_id) REFERENCES workflow_executions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 实时统计汇总表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_stats_summary (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    stat_date DATE NOT NULL, -- 统计日期\\\\\\\\n    node_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 节点ID\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 使用统计\\\\\\\\n    total_usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    unique_users INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    avg_response_time REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    success_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 内容统计\\\\\\\\n    total_characters INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    avg_characters INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    avg_content_quality REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 用户交互统计\\\\\\\\n    total_likes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_dislikes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_regenerations INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_adoptions INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    total_edits INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 采纳率统计\\\\\\\\n    direct_adoption_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    edit_adoption_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    abandonment_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 工作流统计\\\\\\\\n    workflow_completion_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    avg_session_duration REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    common_exit_points TEXT, -- JSON格式\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(stat_date, node_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 系统表\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 数据库迁移记录表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS database_migrations (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\\\\\\\nUSE todify3;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\\\\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\\\\\\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\\\\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\\\\\\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\\\\\\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\\\\\\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '包装内容',\\\\\\\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已发布', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by BIGINT COMMENT '审核人ID',\\\\\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '发布时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (content_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_audience (target_audience),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);-- 6. 技术推广策略表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_promotion_strategies (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '策略标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '策略内容',\\\\\\\\n    strategy_type ENUM('市场推广', '技术推广', '品牌推广', '产品推广') DEFAULT '技术推广' COMMENT '策略类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_market VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '目标市场',\\\\\\\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '预算范围',\\\\\\\\n    timeline VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '时间计划',\\\\\\\\n    success_metrics JSON COMMENT '成功指标',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '执行中', '已完成', '已暂停') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (strategy_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 7. 技术通稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_press_releases (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿标题',\\\\\\\\n    subtitle VARCHAR(300) COMMENT '副标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿内容',\\\\\\\\n    summary TEXT COMMENT '摘要',\\\\\\\\n    press_type ENUM('新技术发布', '技术突破', '合作公告', '产品发布', '其他') DEFAULT '新技术发布' COMMENT '通稿类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_media JSON COMMENT '目标媒体列表',\\\\\\\\n    keywords JSON COMMENT '关键词',\\\\\\\\n    release_date DATE COMMENT '计划发布日期',\\\\\\\\n    embargo_date DATETIME COMMENT '禁发时间',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (press_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_release_date (release_date),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);-- 8. 发布会演讲稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_speeches (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿内容',\\\\\\\\n    speech_type ENUM('产品发布会', '技术大会', '媒体见面会', '内部分享', '其他') DEFAULT '产品发布会' COMMENT '演讲类型',\\\\\\\\n    duration_minutes INT COMMENT '预计时长（分钟）',\\\\\\\\n    target_audience VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '目标听众',\\\\\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '活动名称',\\\\\\\\n    event_date DATE COMMENT '活动日期',\\\\\\\\n    speaker_notes LONGTEXT COMMENT '演讲者备注',\\\\\\\\n    slides_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT 'PPT链接',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已使用', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    used_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '使用时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (speech_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_event_date (event_date),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 9. 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\\\\\\\\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 插入示例数据\\\\\\\\n-- 技术分类示例数据\\\\\\\\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\\\\\\\nUSE todify3;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\\\\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\\\\\\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\\\\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\\\\\\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\\\\\\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\\\\\\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '包装内容',\\\\\\\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已发布', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by BIGINT COMMENT '审核人ID',\\\\\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '发布时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (content_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_audience (target_audience),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);-- 6. 技术推广策略表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_promotion_strategies (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '策略标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '策略内容',\\\\\\\\n    strategy_type ENUM('市场推广', '技术推广', '品牌推广', '产品推广') DEFAULT '技术推广' COMMENT '策略类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_market VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '目标市场',\\\\\\\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '预算范围',\\\\\\\\n    timeline VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '时间计划',\\\\\\\\n    success_metrics JSON COMMENT '成功指标',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '执行中', '已完成', '已暂停') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (strategy_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 7. 技术通稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_press_releases (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿标题',\\\\\\\\n    subtitle VARCHAR(300) COMMENT '副标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿内容',\\\\\\\\n    summary TEXT COMMENT '摘要',\\\\\\\\n    press_type ENUM('新技术发布', '技术突破', '合作公告', '产品发布', '其他') DEFAULT '新技术发布' COMMENT '通稿类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_media JSON COMMENT '目标媒体列表',\\\\\\\\n    keywords JSON COMMENT '关键词',\\\\\\\\n    release_date DATE COMMENT '计划发布日期',\\\\\\\\n    embargo_date DATETIME COMMENT '禁发时间',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (press_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_release_date (release_date),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);-- 8. 发布会演讲稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_speeches (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿内容',\\\\\\\\n    speech_type ENUM('产品发布会', '技术大会', '媒体见面会', '内部分享', '其他') DEFAULT '产品发布会' COMMENT '演讲类型',\\\\\\\\n    duration_minutes INT COMMENT '预计时长（分钟）',\\\\\\\\n    target_audience VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '目标听众',\\\\\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '活动名称',\\\\\\\\n    event_date DATE COMMENT '活动日期',\\\\\\\\n    speaker_notes LONGTEXT COMMENT '演讲者备注',\\\\\\\\n    slides_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT 'PPT链接',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已使用', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    used_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '使用时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (speech_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_event_date (event_date),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 9. 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\\\\\\\\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 插入示例数据\\\\\\\\n-- 技术分类示例数据\\\\\\\\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name,
