                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"                  \\\"content\\\": \\\"  \\\\\\\"contents\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\\\\\\\\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\\\\\\\\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 品牌表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\\\\\\\n    name_en TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    logo_url TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    country TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    founded_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 车型表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name_en TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\\\\\\\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 车系表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术分类表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\\\\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\\\\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\\\\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\\\\\\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\\\\\\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\\\\\\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\\\\\\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\\\\\\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\\\\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\\\\\\\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\\\\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 知识点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\\\\\n    source_query TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    source_url TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\\\\\\\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\\\\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\\\\\\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\\\\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\\\\\\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\\\\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\\\\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\\\\\\\nUSE todify3;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\\\\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\\\\\\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\\\\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\\\\\\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\\\\\\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\\\\\\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '包装内容',\\\\\\\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已发布', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    reviewed_by BIGINT COMMENT '审核人ID',\\\\\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '发布时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (content_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_audience (target_audience),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);-- 6. 技术推广策略表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_promotion_strategies (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '策略标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '策略内容',\\\\\\\\n    strategy_type ENUM('市场推广', '技术推广', '品牌推广', '产品推广') DEFAULT '技术推广' COMMENT '策略类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_market VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '目标市场',\\\\\\\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '预算范围',\\\\\\\\n    timeline VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '时间计划',\\\\\\\\n    success_metrics JSON COMMENT '成功指标',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '执行中', '已完成', '已暂停') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (strategy_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 7. 技术通稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_press_releases (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿标题',\\\\\\\\n    subtitle VARCHAR(300) COMMENT '副标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿内容',\\\\\\\\n    summary TEXT COMMENT '摘要',\\\\\\\\n    press_type ENUM('新技术发布', '技术突破', '合作公告', '产品发布', '其他') DEFAULT '新技术发布' COMMENT '通稿类型',\\\\\\\\n    target_media JSON COMMENT '目标媒体列表',\\\\\\\\n    keywords JSON COMMENT '关键词',\\\\\\\\n    release_date DATE COMMENT '计划发布日期',\\\\\\\\n    embargo_date DATETIME COMMENT '禁发时间',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (press_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_release_date (release_date),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);-- 8. 发布会演讲稿表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_speeches (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿标题',\\\\\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿内容',\\\\\\\\n    speech_type ENUM('产品发布会', '技术大会', '媒体见面会', '内部分享', '其他') DEFAULT '产品发布会' COMMENT '演讲类型',\\\\\\\\n    duration_minutes INT COMMENT '预计时长（分钟）',\\\\\\\\n    target_audience VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '目标听众',\\\\\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '活动名称',\\\\\\\\n    event_date DATE COMMENT '活动日期',\\\\\\\\n    speaker_notes LONGTEXT COMMENT '演讲者备注',\\\\\\\\n    slides_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT 'PPT链接',\\\\\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已使用', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\\\\\n    used_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '使用时间',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (speech_type),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_event_date (event_date),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 9. 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\\\\\\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\\\\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\\\\\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\\\\\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\\\\\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\\\\\\\\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\\\\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\\\\\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- 插入示例数据\\\\\\\\n-- 技术分类示例数据\\\\\\\\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, ==============================================\\\\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n\\\\n-- 品牌表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\\\n    name_en TEXT,\\\\n    logo_url TEXT,\\\\n    country TEXT,\\\\n    founded_year INTEGER,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 车型表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\n    name_en TEXT,\\\\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\\\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 车系表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\\\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\n    metadata TEXT,\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 技术分类表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 技术点表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\n TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n\\\\n--                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\\\\n-- 创建数据库\\\\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\\\nUSE todify3;\\\\n\\\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '包装内容',\\\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已发布', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 7. 技术通稿表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_press_releases (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿标题',\\\\n '新技术发布' COMMENT '通稿类型',\\\\n    target_media JSON COMMENT '目标媒体列表',\\\\n    keywords JSON COMMENT '关键词',\\\\n    release_date DATE COMMENT '计划发布日期',\\\\n    embargo_date DATETIME COMMENT '禁发时间',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (press_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_release_date (release_date),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);-- 8. 发布会演讲稿表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_speeches (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿内容',\\\\n    speech_type ENUM('产品发布会', '技术大会', '媒体见面会', '内部分享', '其他') DEFAULT '产品发布会' COMMENT '演讲类型',\\\\n    duration_minutes INT COMMENT '预计时长（分钟）',\\\\n    target_audience VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '目标听众',\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '活动名称',\\\\n    event_date DATE COMMENT '活动日期',\\\\n    speaker_notes LONGTEXT COMMENT '演讲者备注',\\\\n    slides_url idx_event_date (event_date),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 9. 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\\\\nimport { \\\\n  TechCategory, \\\\n  CreateTechCategoryDTO, \\\\n  UpdateTechCategoryDTO, \\\\n  QueryOptions, \\\\n  PaginatedResult,\\\\n  Status \\\\n} from '../types/database';\\\\n\\\\nexport class TechCategoryModel {\\\\n  private db: DatabaseManager;\\\\n\\\\n  constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {\\\\n    this.db = db;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 创建技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async create(data: CreateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      INSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, parent_id, level, sort_order, status)\\\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\\\n      RETURNING *\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const values = [\\\\n      data.name,\\\\n      data.description || null,\\\\n      data.parent_id || null,\\\\n      data.level || 1,\\\\n      data.sort_order || 0,\\\\n      data.status || Status.ACTIVE\\\\n    ];\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result[0] as TechCategory;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 根据ID获取技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories WHERE id = ?';\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\\\n    return result.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取所有技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories';\\\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\\\n    if (options.where) {\\\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        conditions.push(&amp;amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        values.push(value);\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加排序\\\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC';\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 获取总数\\\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加分页\\\\n    if (options.limit) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      if (options.offset) {\\\\n        sql += &amp;amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    \\\\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      data: result as TechCategory[],\\\\n      total,\\\\n      page,\\\\n      pageSize,\\\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 根据父级ID获取子分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findByParentId(parentId: number | null, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const whereCondition = parentId === null ? 'parent_id IS NULL' : 'parent_id = ?';\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\\\n      WHERE ${whereCondition} AND status = ?\\\\n      ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const values = parentId === null ? [Status.ACTIVE] : [parentId, Status.ACTIVE];\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result as TechCategory[];\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取分类树结构\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getTree(): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\\\n      WHERE status = ? \\\\n      ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, name ASC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ACTIVE]);\\\\n    const categories = result as TechCategory[];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 构建树结构\\\\n    const categoryMap = new Map&amp;amp;lt;number, TechCategory &amp;amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] }&amp;amp;gt;();\\\\n    const rootCategories: (TechCategory &amp;amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] })[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 初始化所有分类\\\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      categoryMap.set(category.id, { ...category, children: [] });\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    // 构建父子关系\\\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      const categoryWithChildren = categoryMap.get(category.id)!;\\\\n      \\\\n      if (category.parent_id === null) {\\\\n        rootCategories.push(categoryWithChildren);\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        const parent = categoryMap.get(category.parent_id!);\\\\n        if (parent) {\\\\n          parent.children!.push(categoryWithChildren);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return rootCategories;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 更新技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const fields: string[] = [];\\\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (value !== undefined) {\\\\n        fields.push(&amp;amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        values.push(value);\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\\\\n      return this.findById(id);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    values.push(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\\\n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n      WHERE id = ?\\\\n      RETURNING *\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 删除技术分类（软删除）\\\\n   */\\\\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\\\n    if (children.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\\\n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n      WHERE id = ?\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.INACTIVE, id]);\\\\n    return result.affectedRows &amp;amp;gt; 0;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 物理删除技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\\\n    if (children.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const sql = 'DELETE FROM tech_categories WHERE id = ?';\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\\\n    return result.affectedRows &amp;amp;gt; 0;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 搜索技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async search(keyword: string, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const searchOptions = {\\\\n      ...options,\\\\n      where: {\\\\n        ...options.where,\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    let sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\\\n      WHERE (name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?) AND status = ?\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const searchTerm = &amp;amp;#96;%${keyword}%&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    const values = [searchTerm, searchTerm, Status.ACTIVE];\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加额外的WHERE条件\\\\n    if (options.where) {\\\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if (key !== 'name' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; key !== 'description') {\\\\n          sql += &amp;amp;#96; AND ${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n          values.push(value);\\\\n        }\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加排序\\\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC';\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 获取总数\\\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加分页\\\\n    if (options.limit) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      if (options.offset) {\\\\n        sql += &amp;amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    \\\\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      data: result as TechCategory[],\\\\n      total,\\\\n      page,\\\\n      pageSize,\\\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 批量更新排序\\\\n   */\\\\n  async updateSortOrder(updates: { id: number; sort_order: number }[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const transaction = await this.db.transaction();\\\\n    \\\\n    try {\\\\n      for (const update of updates) {\\\\n        const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n          UPDATE tech_categories \\\\n          SET sort_order = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n          WHERE id = ?\\\\n        &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n        await transaction.query(sql, [update.sort_order, update.id]);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      await transaction.commit();\\\\n      return true;\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      await transaction.rollback();\\\\n      throw error;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\",\""

  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start,  tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\\\n    title ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\n    status   status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    speech_id '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 插入示例数据\\\\n-- 技术分类示例数据\\\\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\\\\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\\\\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\\\\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\\\\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\\\\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\\\\n\\\\n-- 车型车系示例数据\\\\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series,                   "lineNumber": 11105,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\\\\nimport { \\\\n  TechPoint, \\\\n  CreateTechPointDTO, \\\\n  UpdateTechPointDTO, \\\\n  QueryOptions, \\\\n  PaginatedResult,\\\\n  Status,\\\\n  TechType,\\\\n  Priority\\\\n} from '../types/database';\\\\n\\\\nexport class TechPointModel {\\\\n  private db: DatabaseManager;\\\\n\\\\n  constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {\\\\n    this.db = db;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 创建技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async create(data: CreateTechPointDTO): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      INSERT INTO tech_points (\\\\n        name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \\\\n        priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \\\\n        keywords, source_url, created_by\\\\n      )\\\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\\\n      RETURNING *\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const values = [\\\\n      data.name,\\\\n      data.description || null,\\\\n      data.category_id || null,\\\\n      data.parent_id || null,\\\\n      data.level || 1,\\\\n      data.tech_type || TechType.FEATURE,\\\\n      data.priority || Priority.MEDIUM,\\\\n      data.status || Status.DRAFT,\\\\n      data.tags ? JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\\\\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\\\\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.benefits) : null,\\\\n      data.applications ? JSON.stringify(data.applications) : null,\\\\n      data.keywords ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\\\\n      data.source_url || null,\\\\n      data.created_by || null\\\\n    ];\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechPoint | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\\\n    return result.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取所有技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points';\\\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\\\n    if (options.where) {\\\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        conditions.push(&amp;amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        values.push(value);\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加排序\\\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 获取总数\\\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加分页\\\\n    if (options.limit) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      if (options.offset) {\\\\n        sql += &amp;amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&amp;amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\\\n    \\\\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      data,\\\\n      total,\\\\n      page,\\\\n      pageSize,\\\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 根据分类ID获取技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findByCategoryId(categoryId: number, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\\\n      WHERE category_id = ? AND status = ?\\\\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [categoryId, Status.ACTIVE]);\\\\n    return result.map((row: any) =&amp;amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 根据父级ID获取子技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findByParentId(parentId: number | null, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const whereCondition = parentId === null ? 'parent_id IS NULL' : 'parent_id = ?';\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\\\n      WHERE ${whereCondition} AND status = ?\\\\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const values = parentId === null ? [Status.ACTIVE] : [parentId, Status.ACTIVE];\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result.map((row: any) =&amp;amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术点树结构\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getTree(categoryId?: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\\\n      WHERE status = ?\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    const values: any[] = [Status.ACTIVE];\\\\n\\\\n    if (categoryId) {\\\\n      sql += ' AND category_id = ?';\\\\n      values.push(categoryId);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    sql += ' ORDER BY level ASC, priority DESC, created_at DESC';\\\\n    \\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    const techPoints = result.map((row: any) =&amp;amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 构建树结构\\\\n    const techPointMap = new Map&amp;amp;lt;number, TechPoint &amp;amp;amp; { children?: TechPoint[] }&amp;amp;gt;();\\\\n    const rootTechPoints: (TechPoint &amp;amp;amp; { children?: TechPoint[] })[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 初始化所有技术点\\\\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      techPointMap.set(techPoint.id, { ...techPoint, children: [] });\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    // 构建父子关系\\\\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      const techPointWithChildren = techPointMap.get(techPoint.id)!;\\\\n      \\\\n      if (techPoint.parent_id === null) {\\\\n        rootTechPoints.push(techPointWithChildren);\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        const parent = techPointMap.get(techPoint.parent_id!);\\\\n        if (parent) {\\\\n          parent.children!.push(techPointWithChildren);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return rootTechPoints;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 更新技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechPoint | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const fields: string[] = [];\\\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (value !== undefined) {\\\\n        if (['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'].includes(key)) {\\\\n          fields.push(&amp;amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n          values.push(JSON.stringify(value));\\\\n        } else {\\\\n          fields.push(&amp;amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n          values.push(value);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\\\\n      return this.findById(id);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    values.push(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      UPDATE tech_points \\\\n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n      WHERE id = ?\\\\n      RETURNING *\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 删除技术点（软删除）\\\\n   */\\\\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\\\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\\\n    if (children.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with child tech points');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 检查是否有关联的车型\\\\n    const carModelsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_point_car_models WHERE tech_point_id = ?';\\\\n    const carModelsResult = await this.db.query(carModelsSql, [id]);\\\\n    if (carModelsResult[0].count &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with associated car models');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      UPDATE tech_points \\\\n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n      WHERE id = ?\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ARCHIVED, id]);\\\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 : result.changes &amp;amp;gt; 0;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 物理删除技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\\\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\\\n    if (children.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with child tech points');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const sql = 'DELETE FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 : result.changes &amp;amp;gt; 0;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 搜索技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async search(keyword: string, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\\\n      WHERE (name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ? OR keywords LIKE ?) AND status = ?\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const searchTerm = &amp;amp;#96;%${keyword}%&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    const values = [searchTerm, searchTerm, searchTerm, Status.ACTIVE];\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加额外的WHERE条件\\\\n    if (options.where) {\\\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if (!['name', 'description', 'keywords'].includes(key)) {\\\\n          sql += &amp;amp;#96; AND ${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n          values.push(value);\\\\n        }\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加排序\\\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC';\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 获取总数\\\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加分页\\\\n    if (options.limit) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      if (options.offset) {\\\\n        sql += &amp;amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&amp;amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\\\n    \\\\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      data,\\\\n      total,\\\\n      page,\\\\n      pageSize,\\\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 根据标签搜索技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findByTags(tags: string[], options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const tagConditions = tags.map(() =&amp;amp;gt; 'tags LIKE ?').join(' OR ');\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\\\n      WHERE (${tagConditions}) AND status = ?\\\\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const values = [...tags.map(tag =&amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;#96;%\\\\\\\"${tag}\\\\\\\"%&amp;amp;#96;), Status.ACTIVE];\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result.map((row: any) =&amp;amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术点统计信息\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getStats(): Promise&amp;amp;lt;{\\\\n    total: number;\\\\n    byStatus: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, number&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n    byType: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, number&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n    byPriority: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, number&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n  }&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const totalSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points';\\\\n    const statusSql = 'SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points GROUP BY status';\\\\n    const typeSql = 'SELECT tech_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points GROUP BY tech_type';\\\\n    const prioritySql = 'SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points GROUP BY priority';\\\\n\\\\n    const [totalResult, statusResult, typeResult, priorityResult] = await Promise.all([\\\\n      this.db.query(totalSql),\\\\n      this.db.query(statusSql),\\\\n      this.db.query(typeSql),\\\\n      this.db.query(prioritySql)\\\\n    ]);\\\\n\\\\n    const byStatus: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, number&amp;amp;gt; = {};\\\\n    statusResult.forEach((row: any) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      byStatus[row.status] = row.count;\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    const byType: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, number&amp;amp;gt; = {};\\\\n    typeResult.forEach((row: any) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      byType[row.tech_type] = row.count;\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    const byPriority: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, number&amp;amp;gt; = {};\\\\n    priorityResult.forEach((row: any) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      byPriority[row.priority] = row.count;\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return {\\\\n      total: totalResult[0].count,\\\\n      byStatus,\\\\n      byType,\\\\n      byPriority\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术点关联的所有内容\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;{\\\\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\\\\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\\\\n    pressReleases: any[];\\\\n    speeches: any[];\\\\n  }&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 获取技术包装材料\\\\n    const packagingSql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_packaging_materials \\\\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? \\\\n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 获取推广策略\\\\n    const promotionSql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT ts.*, pt.weight \\\\n      FROM tech_promotion_strategies ts\\\\n      JOIN promotion_tech_points pt ON ts.id = pt.promotion_id\\\\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\\\\n      ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 获取通稿\\\\n    const pressSql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT pr.*, pt.weight \\\\n      FROM tech_press_releases pr\\\\n      JOIN press_tech_points pt ON pr.id = pt.press_release_id\\\\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\\\\n      ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 获取演讲稿\\\\n    const speechSql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT sp.*, st.weight \\\\n      FROM tech_speeches sp\\\\n      JOIN speech_tech_points st ON sp.id = st.speech_id\\\\n      WHERE st.tech_point_id = ?\\\\n      ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n\\\\n    const [packagingResult, promotionResult, pressResult, speechResult] = await Promise.all([\\\\n      this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]),\\\\n      this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]),\\\\n      this.db.query(pressSql, [techPointId]),\\\\n      this.db.query(speechSql, [techPointId])\\\\n    ]);\\\\n\\\\n    return {\\\\n      packagingMaterials: packagingResult,\\\\n      promotionStrategies: promotionResult,\\\\n      pressReleases: pressResult,\\\\n      speeches: speechResult\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;any[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT cm.*, tcm.application_status, tcm.implementation_date, tcm.notes\\\\n      FROM car_models cm\\\\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\\\\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\\\\n      ORDER BY cm.brand, cm.series, cm.model\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    return await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 关联车型到技术点\\\\n   */\\\\n  async associateCarModel(\\\\n    techPointId: number, \\\\n    carModelId: number, \\\\n    applicationStatus?: string,\\\\n    implementationDate?: string,\\\\n    notes?: string\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;any&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 检查是否已存在关联\\\\n    const existingSql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT id FROM tech_point_car_models \\\\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\\\\n    \\\\n    if (existing.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\\\\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \\\\n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\\\\n      )\\\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\\\\n      RETURNING *\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const values = [\\\\n      techPointId,\\\\n      carModelId,\\\\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\\\\n      implementationDate || null,\\\\n      notes || null\\\\n    ];\\\\n    \\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result[0];\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\\\\n   */\\\\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      DELETE FROM tech_point_car_models \\\\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\\\\n    // 对于DELETE操作，检查是否有行被影响\\\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 : true;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 更新车型关联信息\\\\n   */\\\\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(\\\\n    techPointId: number,\\\\n    carModelId: number,\\\\n    applicationStatus?: string,\\\\n    implementationDate?: string,\\\\n    notes?: string\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;any&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      UPDATE tech_point_car_models \\\\n      SET \\\\n        application_status = COALESCE(?, application_status),\\\\n        implementation_date = COALESCE(?, implementation_date),\\\\n        notes = COALESCE(?, notes),\\\\n        updated_at = datetime('now')\\\\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ?   updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start,                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\\\\n-- 创建数据库\\\\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\\\nUSE todify3;\\\\n\\\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '包装内容',\\\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已发布', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    reviewed_by BIGINT COMMENT '审核人ID',\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '发布时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (content_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_audience (target_audience),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);-- 6. 技术推广策略表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_promotion_strategies (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '策略标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '策略内容',\\\\n    strategy_type ENUM('市场推广', '技术推广', '品牌推广', '产品推广') DEFAULT '技术推广' COMMENT '策略类型',\\\\n    target_market VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '目标市场',\\\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '预算范围',\\\\n    timeline VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '时间计划',\\\\n    success_metrics JSON COMMENT '成功指标',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '执行中', '已完成', '已暂停') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (strategy_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 7. 技术通稿表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_press_releases (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿标题',\\\\n    subtitle VARCHAR(300) COMMENT '副标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿内容',\\\\n    summary TEXT COMMENT '摘要',\\\\n    press_type ENUM('新技术发布', '技术突破', '合作公告', '产品发布', '其他') DEFAULT '新技术发布' COMMENT '通稿类型',\\\\n    target_media JSON COMMENT '目标媒体列表',\\\\n    keywords JSON COMMENT '关键词',\\\\n    release_date DATE COMMENT '计划发布日期',\\\\n    embargo_date DATETIME COMMENT '禁发时间',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (press_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_release_date (release_date),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);-- 8. 发布会演讲稿表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_speeches (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿内容',\\\\n    speech_type ENUM('产品发布会', '技术大会', '媒体见面会', '内部分享', '其他') DEFAULT '产品发布会' COMMENT '演讲类型',\\\\n    duration_minutes INT COMMENT '预计时长（分钟）',\\\\n    target_audience VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '目标听众',\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '活动名称',\\\\n    event_date DATE COMMENT '活动日期',\\\\n    speaker_notes LONGTEXT COMMENT '演讲者备注',\\\\n    slides_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT 'PPT链接',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已使用', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    used_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '使用时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (speech_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_event_date (event_date),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 9. 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\\\\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 插入示例数据\\\\n-- 技术分类示例数据\\\\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\\\\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', \\\\n    -- 上下文信息\\\\n    query_text TEXT,\\\\n    response_text TEXT,\\\\n    context_data TEXT, -- JSON格式\\\\n    \\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    \\\\n \\\\n    -- 会话基本信息\\\\n    session_start_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    session_end_time DATETIME,\\\\n    session_duration REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\n    \\\\n    -- 工作流完整性统计\\\\n    total_nodes_visited INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\n    completed_nodes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\n    skipped_nodes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\\\n    \\\\n    -- 节点访问记录（JSON格式）\\\\n    node_visit_sequence TEXT,\\\\n    node_completion_status TEXT,\\\\n    \\\\n    -- 跳出点分析\\\\n    exit_node_id TEXT,\\\\n    exit_reason TEXT,\\\\n    exit_time DATETIME,\\\\n    \\\\n    -- 工作流路径分析\\\\n    workflow_path TEXT, -- JSON格式\\\\n    path_efficiency_score REAL DEFAULT 0,\\\\n    \\\\n    -- 用户满意度\\\\n    overall_satisfaction_score REAL,\\\\n    user_feedback TEXT,\\\\n    \\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\n    created_at DATETIME \\\\n    -- 时间戳\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    \\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (ai_role_id) REFERENCES ai_roles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (workflow_execution_id) REFERENCES workflow_executions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 实时统计汇总表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_stats_summary (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    stat_date                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\\\\n-- 创建数据库\\\\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\\\nUSE todify3;\\\\n\\\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '包装内容',\\\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\n    status   status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);-- 8. 发布会演讲稿表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_speeches (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿内容',\\\\n    speech_type ENUM('产品发布会', '技术大会', '媒体见面会', '内部分享', '其他') DEFAULT '产品发布会' COMMENT '演讲类型',\\\\n    duration_minutes INT COMMENT '预计时长（分钟）',\\\\n    target_audience VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '目标听众',\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '活动名称',\\\\n    event_date DATE COMMENT '活动日期',\\\\n    speaker_notes LONGTEXT COMMENT '演讲者备注',\\\\n    slides_url idx_event_date (event_date),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 9. 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE
