==============================================\\n\\n-- 品牌表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\n    name_en TEXT,\\n    logo_url TEXT,\\n    country TEXT,\\n    founded_year INTEGER,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 车型表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    name_en TEXT,\\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 车系表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\\n    description TEXT,\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    metadata TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术分类表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF DEFAULT 'planned',\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\n    notes TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 知识点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n TEXT,\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- 知识点收藏表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\n);\\n\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\n    end_date DATE result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有技术分类\\n   */\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories';\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\n\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\n    if (options.where) {\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n        conditions.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 添加排序\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;#96;;\\n    } else {\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC';\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取总数\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\n\\n    // 添加分页\\n    if (options.limit) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;#96;;\\n      if (options.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    \\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\n    const page = options.offset ? 'parent_id IS NULL' : 'parent_id = ?';\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\n      WHERE ${whereCondition} AND status = ?\\n      ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = parentId === null ? [Status.ACTIVE] : [parentId, Status.ACTIVE];\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result as TechCategory[];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取分类树结构\\n   */\\n  async getTree(): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\n      WHERE status = ? \\n      ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, name ASC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ACTIVE]);\\n    const categories = result as TechCategory[];\\n    \\n    // 构建树结构\\n    const categoryMap = new Map&amp;lt;number, TechCategory &amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] }&amp;gt;();\\n    const rootCategories: (TechCategory &amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] })[] = [];\\n\\n    // 初始化所有分类\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;gt; {\\n      categoryMap.set(category.id, { ...category, children: [] });\\n    });\\n\\n    // 构建父子关系\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;gt; {\\n      const categoryWithChildren = categoryMap.get(category.id)!;\\n      \\n      if (category.parent_id === null) {\\n        rootCategories.push(categoryWithChildren);\\n      } else {\\n        const parent = categoryMap.get(category.parent_id!);\\n        if (parent) {\\n          parent.children!.push(categoryWithChildren);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return rootCategories;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新技术分类\\n   */\\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory | null&amp;gt; {\\n    const fields: string[] = [];\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n\\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (value !== undefined) {\\n        fields.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\\n      return this.findById(id);\\n    }\\n\\n    values.push(id);\\n    \\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除技术分类（软删除）\\n   */\\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.INACTIVE, id]);\\n    return result.affectedRows &amp;gt; 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 物理删除技术分类\\n   */\\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = 'DELETE FROM tech_categories WHERE id = ?';\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\n    return result.affectedRows &amp;gt; 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 搜索技术分类\\n   */\\n  async search(keyword: string, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    const searchOptions = {\\n      ...options,\\n      where: {\\n        ...options.where,\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    let sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\n      WHERE (name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?) AND status = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const searchTerm = &amp;#96;%${keyword}%&amp;#96;;\\n    const values = [searchTerm, searchTerm, Status.ACTIVE];\\n\\n    // 添加额外的WHERE条件\\n    if (options.where) {\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n        if (key !== 'name' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; key !== 'description') {\\n          sql += &amp;#96; AND ${key} = ?&amp;#96;;\\n          values.push(value);\\n        }\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 添加排序\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;#96;;\\n    } else {\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC';\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取总数\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\n\\n    // 添加分页\\n    if (options.limit) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;#96;;\\n      if (options.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    \\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\n    const page = options.offset ? JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.benefits) : null,\\n      data.applications ? JSON.stringify(data.applications) : null,\\n      data.keywords ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\\n      data.source_url || null,\\n      data.created_by || null\\n    ];\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\\n   */\\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint | null&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有技术点\\n   */\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points';\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\n\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\n    if (options.where) {\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n        conditions.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 添加排序\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;#96;;\\n    } else {\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取总数\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\n\\n    // 添加分页\\n    if (options.limit) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;#96;;\\n      if (options.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n    \\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\n    const page = options.offset ? AND status = ?\\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [categoryId, Status.ACTIVE]);\\n    return result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据父级ID获取子技术点\\n   */\\n  async findByParentId(parentId: number | null, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const whereCondition = parentId === null ? 'parent_id IS NULL' : 'parent_id = ?';\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\n      WHERE ${whereCondition} AND status = ?\\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = parentId === null ? {\\n    let sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\n      WHERE status = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    const values: any[] = [Status.ACTIVE];\\n\\n    if (categoryId) {\\n      sql += ' AND category_id = ?';\\n      values.push(categoryId);\\n    }\\n\\n    sql += ' ORDER BY level ASC, priority DESC, created_at DESC';\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    const techPoints = result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n    \\n    // 构建树结构\\n    const techPointMap = new Map&amp;lt;number, TechPoint &amp;amp; { children?: TechPoint[] }&amp;gt;();\\n    const rootTechPoints: (TechPoint &amp;amp; { children?: TechPoint[] })[] = [];\\n\\n    // 初始化所有技术点\\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&amp;gt; {\\n      techPointMap.set(techPoint.id, { ...techPoint, children: [] });\\n    });\\n\\n    // 构建父子关系\\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&amp;gt; {\\n      const techPointWithChildren = techPointMap.get(techPoint.id)!;\\n      \\n      if (techPoint.parent_id === null) {\\n        rootTechPoints.push(techPointWithChildren);\\n      } else {\\n        const parent = techPointMap.get(techPoint.parent_id!);\\n        if (parent) {\\n          parent.children!.push(techPointWithChildren);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return rootTechPoints;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新技术点\\n   */\\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint | null&amp;gt; {\\n    const fields: string[] = [];\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n\\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (value !== undefined) {\\n        if (['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'].includes(key)) {\\n          fields.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n          values.push(JSON.stringify(value));\\n        } else {\\n          fields.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n          values.push(value);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\\n      return this.findById(id);\\n    }\\n\\n    values.push(id);\\n    \\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_points \\n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除技术点（软删除）\\n   */\\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with child tech points');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 检查是否有关联的车型\\n    const carModelsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_point_car_models WHERE tech_point_id = ?';\\n    const carModelsResult = await this.db.query(carModelsSql, [id]);\\n    if (carModelsResult[0].count &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with associated car models');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_points \\n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ARCHIVED, id]);\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;gt; 0 : result.changes &amp;gt; 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 物理删除技术点\\n   */\\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with child tech points');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = 'DELETE FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;gt; 0 : result.changes &amp;gt; 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 搜索技术点\\n   */\\n  async search(keyword: string, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\n      WHERE (name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ? OR keywords LIKE ?) {\\n    const tagConditions = tags.map(() =&amp;gt; 'tags LIKE ?').join(' OR ');\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\n      WHERE (${tagConditions}) AND status = ?\\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [...tags.map(tag =&amp;gt; &amp;#96;%\\\"${tag}\\\"%&amp;#96;), Status.ACTIVE];\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点统计信息\\n   */\\n  async getStats(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    total: number;\\n    byStatus: Record&amp;lt;string, number&amp;gt;;\\n    byType: Record&amp;lt;string, number&amp;gt;;\\n    byPriority: Record&amp;lt;string, number&amp;gt;;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const totalSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points';\\n    const statusSql = 'SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points GROUP BY status';\\n    const typeSql = 'SELECT tech_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points GROUP BY tech_type';\\n    const prioritySql = 'SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points GROUP BY priority';\\n\\n    const [totalResult, statusResult, typeResult, priorityResult] = await Promise.all([\\n      this.db.query(totalSql),\\n      this.db.query(statusSql),\\n      this.db.query(typeSql),\\n      this.db.query(prioritySql)\\n    ]);\\n\\n    const byStatus: Record&amp;lt;string, number&amp;gt; = {};\\n    statusResult.forEach((row: any) =&amp;gt; {\\n      byStatus[row.status] = row.count;\\n    });\\n\\n    const byType: Record&amp;lt;string, number&amp;gt; = {};\\n    typeResult.forEach((row: any) =&amp;gt; {\\n      byType[row.tech_type] = row.count;\\n    });\\n\\n    const byPriority: Record&amp;lt;string, number&amp;gt; = {};\\n    priorityResult.forEach((row: any) =&amp;gt; {\\n      byPriority[row.priority] = row.count;\\n    });\\n\\n    return {\\n      total: totalResult[0].count,\\n      byStatus,\\n      byType,\\n      byPriority\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点关联的所有内容\\n   */\\n  async getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\\n    pressReleases: any[];\\n    speeches: any[];\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    // 获取技术包装材料\\n    const packagingSql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_packaging_materials \\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? \\n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    // 获取推广策略\\n    const promotionSql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT ts.*, pt.weight \\n      FROM tech_promotion_strategies ts\\n      JOIN promotion_tech_points pt ON ts.id = pt.promotion_id\\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\\n      ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    // 获取通稿\\n    const pressSql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT pr.*, pt.weight \\n      FROM tech_press_releases pr\\n      JOIN press_tech_points pt ON pr.id = pt.press_release_id\\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\\n      ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    // 获取演讲稿\\n    const speechSql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT sp.*, st.weight \\n      FROM tech_speeches sp\\n      JOIN speech_tech_points st ON sp.id = st.speech_id\\n      WHERE st.tech_point_id = ?\\n      ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n\\n    const [packagingResult, promotionResult, pressResult, speechResult] = await Promise.all([\\n      this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]),\\n      this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]),\\n      this.db.query(pressSql, [techPointId]),\\n      this.db.query(speechSql, [techPointId])\\n    ]);\\n\\n    return {\\n      packagingMaterials: packagingResult,\\n      promotionStrategies: promotionResult,\\n      pressReleases: pressResult,\\n      speeches: speechResult\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\\n   */\\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&amp;lt;any[]&amp;gt; AND car_model_id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\\n    \\n    if (existing.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \\n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\\n      )\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [\\n      techPointId,\\n      carModelId,\\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\\n      implementationDate || null,\\n      notes || null\\n    ];\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result[0];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\\n   */\\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      DELETE FROM tech_point_car_models \\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? {
  "contents": "/**\n * 创建缺失的数据库表\n * 为当前数据库中缺失的表创建表结构\n */\n\nimport { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\nimport { readFileSync } from 'fs';\nimport { join } from 'path';\n\nconst db = new DatabaseManager();\n\n/**\n * 检查表是否存在\n */\nasync function tableExists(tableName: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  try {\n    await db.connect();\n    const result = await db.query(&#96;\n      SELECT name FROM sqlite_master \n      WHERE type='table' AND name = ?\n    &#96;, [tableName]);\n    return Array.isArray(result) &amp;&amp; result.length &gt; 0;\n  } catch (error) {\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 执行SQL语句（支持多语句）\n */\nasync function executeSQL(sql: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  const statements = sql\n    .split(';')\n    .map(s =&gt; s.trim())\n    .filter(s =&gt; s.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !s.startsWith('--'));\n\n  for (const statement of statements) {\n    if (statement.trim()) {\n      try {\n        await db.query(statement);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 忽略表已存在的错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n            !error?.message?.includes('duplicate') &amp;&amp;\n            !error?.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn(&#96;⚠️  执行SQL语句失败:&#96;, error?.message);\n          console.warn(&#96;SQL: ${statement.substring(0, 100)}...&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    }",
  "totalLinesInFile": 403
}

        "contents": "-- 项目表\n-- 用于存储项目信息\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- 项目来源表\n-- 用于关联项目与各种来源（文件、URL、文本、技术点等）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('file', 'url', 'text', 'tech_point', 'knowledge_point')),\n    source_content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_title TEXT,\n    source_description TEXT,\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_type ON projects(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_status ON projects(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_created_at ON projects(created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_last_opened_at ON projects(last_opened_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_project_id ON project_sources(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_source_type ON project_sources(source_type);",

        "contents": "## 数据库表完整列表（20个）\n\n数据库文件: ./data/todify2.db\n\n### 核心配置表 (6个):\nagent_workflows - Agent工作流 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nai_roles - AI角色配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_templates - 工作流模板 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npublic_page_configs - 公开页面配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npage_tool_configs - 页面工具配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n\n### AI搜索相关表 (4个):\nai_search_conversations - AI搜索对话 [服务✅]\nai_search_messages - AI搜索消息 [服务✅]\nai_search_outputs - AI搜索输出 [服务✅]\nai_search_field_mappings - AI搜索字段映射 [服务✅]\n\n### 聊天对话表 (4个):\nconversations - 对话会话 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nchat_messages - 聊天消息 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nknowledge_usage_logs - 知识使用日志 [服务✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [服务✅ 路由✅] (与第3项重复)\n\n\n### 业务数据表 (5个):\nbrands - 品牌 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_models - 车型 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_series - 车系 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_categories - 技术分类 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_points - 技术点 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 文件和服务表 (2个):\nfiles - 文件存储 [服务✅]\nworkflow_stats_summary - 工作流统计 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 来源信息表 (1个):\nsource_information - 来源信息 [模型✅ 路由✅]",

        "contents": "        fi\n    fi\n}\n\n# 获取脚本所在目录\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" &amp;&amp; pwd)\"\n\n# 安装后端依赖\ninstall_dependencies \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend\" \"后端\"\n\n# 修复后端依赖兼容性问题\nfix_backend_dependencies \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend\"\n\n# 检查后端 .env 文件\nif [ ! -f \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend/.env\" ]; then\n    echo \"⚠️  警告: 后端 .env 文件不存在\"\n    echo \"   创建默认 .env 文件...\"\n    cat &gt; \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend/.env\" &lt;&lt; EOF\n# 服务器端口配置\nPORT=3003\n\n# 数据库配置\nDB_TYPE=sqlite\nSQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/todify2.db\n\n# 服务器配置\nNODE_ENV=development\nEOF\n    echo \"✅ 已创建默认 .env 文件，请根据需要修改配置\"\nfi\n\n# 安装前端依赖\ninstall_dependencies \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend\" \"前端\"\n\n# 检查前端是否缺少 reactflow\nif [ ! -d \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend/node_modules/reactflow\" ]; then\n    echo \"📥 安装缺失的 reactflow 依赖...\"\n    cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend\"\n    npm install reactflow\nfi\n\necho \"🎯 启动服务...\"\n\n# 启动后端服务\necho \"🔧 启动后端服务 (端口: $BACKEND_PORT)...\"\ncd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend\"\n\n# 确保数据库目录存在\nif [ -f \".env\" ]; then\n    # 从 .env 文件中读取数据库路径\n    DB_PATH=$(grep \"^SQLITE_DB_PATH=\" .env | cut -d '=' -f2 | tr -d '\"' | tr -d \"'\" | xargs || echo \"./data/todify2.db\")\n    # 如果路径是相对路径，确保相对于 backend 目录\n    if [[ \"$DB_PATH\" != /* ]]; then\n        DB_PATH=\"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend/$DB_PATH\"\n    fi\n    DB_DIR=$(dirname \"$DB_PATH\")\n    if [ ! -d \"$DB_DIR\" ]; then\n        echo \"📁 创建数据库目录: $DB_DIR\"\n        mkdir -p \"$DB_DIR\"\n    fi\n    echo \"📂 数据库路径: $DB_PATH\"\nfi\n\n# 确保日志文件存在\nBACKEND_LOG=\"/tmp/backend.log\"\ntouch \"$BACKEND_LOG\"\n\n# 清理旧的日志文件\n&gt; \"$BACKEND_LOG\"\n\n# 检查必要的依赖\necho \"🔍 检查后端依赖...\"\nif [ ! -d \"node_modules\" ]; then\n    echo \"❌ 后端依赖未安装，请先运行 npm install\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# 检查 TypeScript 编译工具\nif ! command -v ts-node-dev &amp;&gt; /dev/null &amp;&amp; [ ! -f \"node_modules/.bin/ts-node-dev\" ]; then\n    ",

        "contents": "# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\n\n## 一、概述\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\n\n### 1.1 设计目标\n\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\n\n### 1.2 架构分层\n\n数据库架构分为五层：\n\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\n\n## 二、表结构设计\n\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\n\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\n\n存储汽车品牌信息。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\n\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# Todify3 统一数据库初始化脚本 v2.0\n# 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n# 说明: 统一执行数据库架构和索引脚本\n\nset -e\n\n# 颜色输出\nRED='\\033[0;31m'\nGREEN='\\033[0;32m'\nYELLOW='\\033[1;33m'\nNC='\\033[0m' # No Color\n\n# 脚本目录\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" &amp;&amp; pwd)\"\nSCHEMA_FILE=\"$SCRIPT_DIR/unified-database-schema-v2.sql\"\nINDEXES_FILE=\"$SCRIPT_DIR/unified-database-indexes-v2.sql\"\n\n# 数据库配置\nDB_TYPE=\"${DB_TYPE:-sqlite}\"  # sqlite 或 postgresql\nDB_PATH=\"${DB_PATH:-$SCRIPT_DIR/../../database.db}\"\n\n# 函数：打印信息\ninfo() {\n    echo -e \"${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nwarn() {\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nerror() {\n    echo -e \"${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\n# 检查文件是否存在\ncheck_files() {\n    if [ ! -f \"$SCHEMA_FILE\" ]; then\n        error \"架构文件不存在: $SCHEMA_FILE\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    if [ ! -f \"$INDEXES_FILE\" ]; then\n        error \"索引文件不存在: $INDEXES_FILE\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    info \"文件检查通过\"\n}\n\n# SQLite 初始化\ninit_sqlite() {\n    info \"使用 SQLite 数据库: $DB_PATH\"\n    ",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * 技术点同步服务\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\n * \n * 后续实现功能：\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\n * 5. 同步日志记录\n */\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\n  /**\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n   * @param options 同步选项\n   */\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\n  }): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;{\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量（总数）\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\n  }&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync', {\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\n      });\n      // 后端返回的格式是 { success, message, data: { total, created, updated, errors } }\n      if (response.data &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        const stats = response.data.data;\n        return {\n          success: response.data.success ?? true,\n          data: {\n            synced: stats.total || (stats.created || 0) + (stats.updated || 0),\n            updated: stats.updated || 0,\n            created: stats.created || 0,\n            errors: stats.errors || 0,\n          },\n          message: response.data.message,\n        };\n      }\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\n   */\n,\n};",

        "contents": "# Todify3 - 智能文档生成平台\n\n## 项目简介\n\nTodify3 是一个基于 AI 的智能文档生成平台，支持多种文档类型和工作流配置。\n\n## 快速开始\n\n### 本地开发\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 安装依赖\nnpm install\n\n# 启动后端服务\ncd backend\nnpm install\nnpm run dev\n\n# 启动前端服务\ncd frontend\nnpm install\nnpm run dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 服务器部署\n\n详细部署指南请参考 [部署文档](docs/DEPLOYMENT_STANDARD_GUIDE.md)\n\n## 自动启动配置\n\n项目已配置自动启动机制，服务器重启后服务会自动启动。\n\n### 配置自动启动\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 在服务器上运行配置脚本\ncd /root/todify3\n./setup-autostart.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 服务管理\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 使用PM2命令\npm2 list                    # 查看服务状态\npm2 logs                     # 查看日志\npm2 restart todify3-backend  # 重启后端\npm2 restart todify3-frontend # 重启前端\n\n# 使用服务管理脚本\n./scripts/start-services.sh start    # 启动服务\n./scripts/start-services.sh stop     # 停止服务\n./scripts/start-services.sh restart  # 重启服务\n./scripts/start-services.sh status   # 查看状态\n./scripts/start-services.sh logs     # 查看日志\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 测试自动启动\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 运行测试脚本\n./scripts/test-autostart.sh\n\n# 完整测试（需要重启服务器）\nreboot\n# 重启后检查\npm2 list\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n详细说明请参考 [自动启动指南](docs/AUTOSTART_GUIDE.md)\n\n## 项目结构\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ntodify3/\n├── backend/          # 后端服务\n├── frontend/         # 前端应用\n├── scripts/          # 脚本文件\n│   ├── start-services.sh    # 服务管理脚本\n│   └── test-autostart.sh     # 自动启动测试脚本\n├── docs/             # 文档\n│   ├── AUTOSTART_GUIDE.md    # 自动启动指南\n│   └── DEPLOYMENT_STANDARD_GUIDE.md  # 部署指南\n├── setup-autostart.sh # 自动启动配置脚本\n└── ecosystem.config.js # PM2配置文件\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 服务端口\n\n- **前端**: 2201 (本地开发: 3001)\n- **后端**: 2203 (本地开发: 3003)",

        "contents": "│   └── 📄 seed-data.ts           # 种子数据脚本\n│\n├── 📁 types/                     # 类型定义\n│   ├── 📄 api.ts                 # API相关类型定义\n│   └── 📄 database.ts            # 数据库相关类型定义\n│\n└── 📁 utils/                     # 工具函数\n    └── 📄 validation.ts          # 数据验证工具\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📚 文档目录 (guide/)\n\n### 🏗️ 架构文档 (architecture-guide/)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\narchitecture-guide/\n├── 📄 system-architecture.md     # 系统架构设计文档\n├── 📄 data-flow-management.md    # 数据流管理文档\n├── 📄 unified-monitoring-strategy.md # 统一监控策略\n├── 📄 ARCHITECTURE_OPTIMIZATION_REPORT.md # 架构优化报告\n├── 📄 后端项目架构规划.md         # 后端架构规划\n├── 📄 三大模块映射关系分析.md      # 模块映射关系分析\n├── 📄 Todify平台数据关系和一致性评估报告.md # 数据一致性评估\n├── 🖼️ 系统技术架构图.svg          # 系统架构图\n├── 🖼️ 数据流架构图.svg            # 数据流架构图\n├── 🖼️ ip-mining-database-schema.svg # IP挖掘数据库架构图\n├── 🖼️ speech-writing-database-schema.svg # 演讲稿数据库架构图\n├── 📄 ip-mining-field-mappings.json # IP挖掘字段映射\n├── 📄 speech-writing-field-mappings.json # 演讲稿字段映射\n└── 📄 tech-article-field-mappings.json # 技术文章字段映射\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 💾 数据库文档 (database/)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ndatabase/\n├── 📄 database-design.md         # 数据库设计文档\n├── 📄 create-database.sql        # 数据库创建脚本\n├── 📄 migration-three-tier.sql   # 三层架构迁移脚本\n├── 📄 migration-three-tier-sqlite.sql # SQLite三层架构迁移\n└── 🖼️ database-schema.svg        # 数据库架构图\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 🔄 工作流文档 (workflow/)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nworkflow/\n├── 📄 AI问答.yml                 # AI问答工作流配置\n├── 📄 AI问答-技术包装2.yml        # AI问答技术包装工作流",

        "contents": "export class TechPointController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\n   * POST /api/v1/tech-points/sync\n   */\n  async syncFromTPD(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      console.log('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n      \n      const result = await tpdSyncService.syncTechPoints();\n      \n      if (result.success) {\n        res.json({\n          success: true,\n          message: result.message,\n          data: result.stats\n        });\n      } else {\n        res.status(500).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: result.message,\n          data: result.stats\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('同步 TPD2 技术点数据失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    file_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (file_id) REFERENCES files(file_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与来源信息关联表（多对多，支持来源信息复用）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_source_informations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_information_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (source_information_id) REFERENCES source_information(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, source_information_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 3. 在生成内容表中添加 project_id 字段\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 技术包装材料表添加 project_id\n-- 注意：如果表已存在，需要先检查字段是否存在\n-- SQLite 不支持直接 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS，需要手动检查\n-- 这里使用 ALTER TABLE，如果字段已存在会报错，需要在应用层处理\n\n-- 为 tech_packaging_materials 添加 project_id\n-- 先检查表是否存在 project_id 列（通过尝试添加，如果失败则忽略）\n-- 实际执行时，如果字段已存在，需要手动处理或使用应用层检查\n\nALTER TABLE tech_packaging_materials ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_packaging_materials_project_id ON tech_packaging_materials(project_id);\n-- 添加外键约束（SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持，旧版本可能需要重建表）\n-- FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL",

        "contents": "// 获取数据库配置\nexport function getDatabaseConfig(): DatabaseConfig {\n  const dbType = (process.env.DB_TYPE || 'sqlite') as DatabaseType;\n  \n  const config: DatabaseConfig = {\n    type: dbType\n  };\n\n  if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n    config.sqlite = {\n      path: process.env.SQLITE_DB_PATH || './data/todify3.db'\n    };\n  } else {\n    config.postgresql = {\n      host: process.env.PG_HOST || 'localhost',\n      port: parseInt(process.env.PG_PORT || '5432'),\n      user: process.env.PG_USER || 'postgres',\n      password: process.env.PG_PASSWORD || '',\n      database: process.env.PG_DATABASE || 'todify3'\n    };\n  }\n\n  return config;\n}\n\n// SQLite 连接管理\nclass SQLiteManager {\n  private db: sqlite3.Database | null = null\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "// 获取数据库配置",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },

        "contents": "# Todify3 项目部署标准指南\n\n## 📋 概述\n\n本文档记录了Todify3项目的完整部署过程，包括问题排查、修复方案和最佳实践，为后续部署提供标准化指导。\n\n## 🏗️ 项目架构\n\n### 服务架构\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n用户访问 (8088端口)\n    ↓\nNginx 反向代理\n    ↓\n┌─────────────────┬─────────────────┐\n│   前端服务       │   后端服务       │\n│   (3001端口)     │   (3003端口)     │\n│   React + Vite   │   Express + TS   │\n└─────────────────┴─────────────────┘\n    ↓\nDify API 代理\n    ↓\nDify 服务 (9999端口)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 技术栈\n- **前端**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS\n- **后端**: Node.js + Express + TypeScript + SQLite\n- **代理**: Nginx (反向代理)\n- **AI服务**: Dify API (外部服务)\n\n## 🚀 部署流程\n\n### 1. 环境准备\n\n#### 1.1 服务器要求\n- **操作系统**: Ubuntu/CentOS\n- **内存**: 至少 2GB\n- **存储**: 至少 10GB\n- **网络**: 公网IP，开放8088端口\n\n#### 1.2 软件依赖\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 安装Node.js (推荐v18+)\ncurl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x | sudo -E bash -\nsudo apt-get install -y nodejs\n\n# 安装Nginx\nsudo apt-get update\nsudo apt-get install -y nginx\n\n# 安装其他工具\nsudo apt-get install -y git curl wget\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 代码部署\n\n#### 2.1 上传代码\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 创建部署目录\nsudo mkdir -p /root/todify2-deploy\ncd /root/todify2-deploy\n\n# 上传项目文件 (使用scp或其他方式)\n# 确保包含以下目录结构：\n# ├── frontend/          # 前端代码\n# ├── backend/           # 后端代码\n# ├── nginx-proxy.conf   # Nginx配置\n# └── deploy.sh          # 部署脚本\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2.2 安装依赖\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 安装前端依赖\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/frontend\nnpm install\n\n# 安装后端依赖\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/backend\nnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 配置管理\n\n#### 3.1 后端环境变量配置",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# 同步本地数据库配置信息到云端项目数据库\n\nset -e\n\n# 设置颜色输出\nRED='\\033[0;31m'\nGREEN='\\033[0;32m'\nYELLOW='\\033[1;33m'\nBLUE='\\033[0;34m'\nNC='\\033[0m' # No Color\n\n# 日志函数\nlog_info() {\n    echo -e \"${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nlog_success() {\n    echo -e \"${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nlog_warning() {\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nlog_error() {\n    echo -e \"${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\n# 服务器信息\nSERVER_IP=\"47.113.225.93\"\nSERVER_USER=\"root\"\nSERVER_PASSWORD=\"Qb89100820\"\nDEPLOY_PATH=\"/root/todify3\"\nBACKEND_PATH=\"${DEPLOY_PATH}/backend\"\nSSH_OPTIONS=\"-o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null\"\nSERVICE_NAME=\"todify3\"\n\n# 检查sshpass工具\ncheck_sshpass() {\n    log_info \"检查sshpass工具...\"\n    if ! command -v sshpass &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n        log_error \"未找到sshpass工具\"\n        echo \"\"\n        echo \"请安装sshpass工具：\"\n        echo \"  macOS:   brew install hudochenkov/sshpass/sshpass\"\n        echo \"  Ubuntu:  sudo apt-get install sshpass\"\n        echo \"  CentOS:  sudo yum install sshpass\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    log_success \"sshpass工具已安装\"\n}\n\n# 检查本地数据库文件\ncheck_local_database() {\n    log_info \"检查本地数据库文件...\"\n    local db_path=\"./backend/data/todify3.db\"\n    \n    if [ ! -f \"$db_path\" ]; then\n        log_error \"本地数据库文件不存在: $db_path\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    local db_size=$(ls -lh \"$db_path\" | awk '{print $5}')\n    log_success \"找到本地数据库文件: $db_path (大小: $db_size)\"\n    echo \"$db_path\"\n}\n\n# 备份云端数据库\nbackup_cloud_database() {\n    log_info \"备份云端数据库...\"\n    ",

                {
                  "lineNumber": 7295,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../config/tpd';\\nimport {\\n  TechPoint,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  PaginatedResponse,\\n  TechPointSearchParams,\\n} from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 项目技术点服务\\n * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\\n */\\nclass TPDTechPointService {\\n  private client: AxiosInstance;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    this.client = axios.create({\\n      baseURL: TPD_API_BASE_URL,\\n      timeout: 30000,\\n      headers: {\\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\\n      },\\n    });\\n\\n    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\\n      (response) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\\n        // todify3 期望格式: { success: true, data: {...} }\\n        if (response.data &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.code === 200) {\\n          return {\\n            ...response,\\n            data: {\\n              success: true,\\n              data: response.data.data,\\n              message: response.data.message,\\n            },\\n          };\\n        }\\n        return response;\\n      },\\n      (error) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // 错误响应格式转换\\n        if (error.response &amp;amp;&amp;amp; error.response.data) {\\n          const tpdError = error.response.data;\\n          return Promise.reject({\\n            ...error,\\n            response: {\\n              ...error.response,\\n              data: {\\n                success: false,\\n                error: tpdError.message || '请求失败',\\n                code: tpdError.code,\\n              },\\n            },\\n          });\\n        }\\n        return Promise.reject(error);\\n      }\\n    );\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n}\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7334,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \" * TPD2 项目技术点服务\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 7338,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \" * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7394,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7406,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7554,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7805,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class TPDTechPointService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n  async getTechPoints(\\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\\n      const queryParams: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {};\\n\\n      if (params?.page) {\\n        queryParams.page = params.page.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.pageSize) {\\n        queryParams.pageSize = params.pageSize.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.keyword) {\\n        queryParams.keyword = params.keyword;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.category_id) {\\n        queryParams.category_id = params.category_id.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.status) {\\n        queryParams.status = params.status;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.type) {\\n        queryParams.tech_type = params.type;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.priority) {\\n        queryParams.priority = params.priority;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortBy) {\\n        queryParams.orderBy = params.sortBy;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortOrder) {\\n        queryParams.orderDirection = params.sortOrder.toUpperCase();\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await this.client.get('/tech-points', {\\n        params: queryParams,\\n      });\\n\\n      // 响应已经被拦截器转换，现在格式是 { success: true, data: {...} }\\n      const responseData = response.data;\\n\\n      if (responseData.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; responseData.data)\\n  }\\n}\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7841,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7868,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8356,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      total: 0,\\n      created: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n\\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\\n      let page = 1;\\n      const pageSize = 100;\\n      let hasMore = true;\\n\\n      while (hasMore) {\\n        try {\\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\\n          const response = await axios.get(&amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&amp;#96;, {\\n            params: {\\n              page,\\n              pageSize,\\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\\n            },\\n            timeout: 30000,\\n          });\\n\\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\\n\\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\\n\\n          // 处理每个技术点\\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\\n            try {\\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\\n              if (result.created) {\\n                stats.created++;\\n              } else {\\n                stats.updated++;\\n              }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n              logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n              stats.errors++;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\\n          if (techPoints.length &amp;lt; pageSize) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n          } else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      }\\n  }\\n}\","
                },

                {
                  "lineNumber": 8733,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export const techPointService = {\\n,\\n\\n  // 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\\n  async syncFromTPD(): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    total: number;\\n    created: number;\\n    updated: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/sync&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nexport default techPointService;\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8781,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"  // 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 9527,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"async getTechPoints(\\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n\\n\\n      if (responseData.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; responseData.data) {\\n        // TPD2 返回的 data 格式: { data: [], total: number, page: number, pageSize: number, totalPages: number }\\n        // 确保返回格式符合 PaginatedResponse\\n        const paginatedData = responseData.data;\\n        const dataArray = paginatedData.data || [];\\n        const total = paginatedData.total || 0;\\n        const page = paginatedData.page || 1;\\n        const pageSize = paginatedData.pageSize || 20;\\n        const totalPages = paginatedData.totalPages || Math.ceil(total / pageSize);\\n        \\n        return {\\n          success: true,\\n          data: {\\n            data: dataArray,\\n            items: dataArray, // 兼容性：某些地方可能使用 items\\n            total,\\n            page,\\n            pageSize,\\n            totalPages,\\n          },\\n          message: responseData.message,\\n        };\\n      }\\n\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: responseData.error || '获取技术点列表失败',\\n      };\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      console.error('获取技术点列表失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error:\\n          error.response?.data?.error ||\\n          error.message ||\\n          '获取技术点列表失败',\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n// 导出单例实例\\nexport const tpdTechPointService = new TPDTechPointService();\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 10127,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import axios from 'axios';\\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 同步服务\\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\\n */\\nexport class TPDSyncService {\\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 12448,
                  "content": "  \"plan\": \"# 技术点库入口及功能对齐实现计划\\n\\n## 目标\\n1. 在 HomePage 的\\\"公共知识库\\\"按钮右侧添加\\\"技术点库\\\"按钮\\n2. 创建新的技术点库页面（路由：&amp;#96;/tech-point-library&amp;#96;），功能完全对齐 TPD2 项目的技术点模块\\n3. 从 TPD2 复制完整的技术点管理功能实现\\n4. 预留后续信息同步接口\\n\\n## 实现步骤\\n\\n### 1. 修改 HomePage 添加按钮入口\\n**文件**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 在第 166-171 行的\\\"公共知识库\\\"按钮后添加\\\"技术点库\\\"按钮\\n- 按钮样式与\\\"公共知识库\\\"保持一致\\n- 点击后导航到 &amp;#96;/tech-point-library&amp;#96; 路由\\n\\n### 2. 创建技术点库页面（从 TPD2 复制）\\n**新文件**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/TechPointLibraryPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 从 &amp;#96;/Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/TPD2/frontend/src/pages/TechPointsPage.tsx&amp;#96; 复制实现\\n- 使用 Ant Design 组件库（与 TPD2 保持一致）\\n- 包含完整的搜索、筛选、列表展示、分页功能\\n- 支持创建、编辑、删除、查看详情操作\\n\\n### 3. 复制技术点相关组件（从 TPD2）\\n**源目录**: &amp;#96;/Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/TPD2/frontend/src/components/techPoint/&amp;#96;\\n\\n需要复制的组件：\\n- &amp;#96;TechPointEditModal.tsx&amp;#96; - 技术点编辑/创建模态框\\n- &amp;#96;TechPointDetail.tsx&amp;#96; - 技术点详情展示组件\\n- &amp;#96;TechPointList.tsx&amp;#96; - 技术点列表组件（如果 TPD2 使用单独组件）\\n\\n**目标目录**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/techPoint/&amp;#96;\\n- 注意：当前项目已有部分 techPoint 组件，需要确认是否覆盖或重命名\\n\\n### 4. 创建技术点详情页面\\n**新文件**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/TechPointLibraryDetailPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 从 &amp;#96;/Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/TPD2/frontend/src/pages/TechPointDetailPage.tsx&amp;#96; 复制实现\\n- 路由：&amp;#96;/tech-point-library/:id&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 5. 适配类型定义\\n**文件**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/types/techPoint.ts&amp;#96;\\n- 确保类型定义与 TPD2 项目一致\\n- 如果 TPD2 有额外的类型定义，需要补充\\n\\n### 6. 适配服务层\\n**文件**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/techPointService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- 检查 API 接口是否与 TPD2 后端兼容\\n- 如果 TPD2 使用不同的 API 端点，可能需要：\\n  - 使用现有的 &amp;#96;tpdTechPointService.ts&amp;#96; 作为桥梁\\n  - 或者修改 &amp;#96;techPointService.ts&amp;#96; 以支持两种后端\\n\\n### 7. 添加路由配置\\n**文件**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/App.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 添加 &amp;#96;/tech-point-library&amp;#96; 路由指向 &amp;#96;TechPointLibraryPage&amp;#96;\\n- 添加 &amp;#96;/tech-point-library/:id&amp;#96; 路由指向 &amp;#96;TechPointLibraryDetailPage&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 8. 依赖检查\\n**检查项目依赖**:\\n- 确认项目是否已安装 &amp;#96;antd&amp;#96;（Ant Design）\\n- 确认是否已安装 &amp;#96;@ant-design/icons&amp;#96;\\n- 确认是否已安装 &amp;#96;dayjs&amp;#96;（TPD2 使用的时间处理库）\\n- 如未安装，需要添加到 &amp;#96;package.json&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 9. 样式和布局适配\\n- TPD2 使用 Ant Design 的布局系统\\n- 当前项目主要使用 Tailwind CSS\\n- 技术点库页面可以使用 Ant Design 保持功能一致性\\n- 顶部导航栏部分可以保持与 HomePage 一致的样式\\n\\n### 10. 后续同步功能预留\\n**预留接口位置**:\\n- 在服务层添加同步相关的方法（如：&amp;#96;syncTechPointsFromTPD2&amp;#96;）\\n- 在页面组件中预留同步按钮的位置\\n- 创建同步服务的骨架结构：&amp;#96;frontend/src/services/techPointSyncService.ts&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 关键技术点\\n\\n### Ant Design vs Tailwind CSS\\n- 技术点库页面将使用 Ant Design（与 TPD2 对齐）\\n- 主页面的导航按钮使用 Tailwind CSS（保持现有风格）\\n- 两个设计系统可以共存\\n\\n### API 兼容性\\n- 检查 TPD2 后端 API 格式\\n- 确保当前项目的 &amp;#96;techPointService&amp;#96; 或 &amp;#96;tpdTechPointService&amp;#96; 可以正确调用\\n- 如果需要，创建适配层\\n\\n### 路由命名\\n- 使用 &amp;#96;/tech-point-library&amp;#96; 作为新路由（区别于现有的 &amp;#96;/tech-points&amp;#96;）\\n- 保留现有的 &amp;#96;/tech-points&amp;#96; 路由和页面，避免冲突\\n\\n## 注意事项\\n\\n1. **组件冲突**: 如果当前项目的 &amp;#96;components/techPoint/&amp;#96; 目录已有组件，需要：\\n   - 评估是否需要保留现有组件\\n   - 或者使用不同的组件名称（如 &amp;#96;TechPointLibraryEditModal.tsx&amp;#96;）\\n\\n2. **依赖管理**: TPD2 项目可能使用了不同的依赖版本，需要：\\n   - 检查版本兼容性\\n   - 优先使用当前项目的依赖版本\\n\\n3. **API 端点**: 确认后端 API 是否已经支持技术点相关接口，或者需要：\\n   - 使用 TPD2 的后端 API（通过 &amp;#96;tpdTechPointService&amp;#96;）\\n   - 或者实现适配层\\n\\n4. **类型兼容**: 确保从 TPD2 复制的代码中的类型定义与当前项目的类型系统兼容\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../config/tpd';\\nimport {\\n  TechPoint,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  PaginatedResponse,\\n  TechPointSearchParams,\\n} from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 项目技术点服务\\n * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\\n */\\nclass TPDTechPointService {\\n  private client: AxiosInstance;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    this.client = axios.create({\\n      baseURL: TPD_API_BASE_URL,\\n      timeout: 30000,\\n      headers: {\\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\\n      },\\n    });\\n\\n    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\\n      (response) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\\n        // todify3 期望格式: { success: true, data: {...} }\\n        if (response.data &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.code === 200) {\\n          return {\\n            ...response,\\n            data: {\\n              success: true,\\n              data: response.data.data,\\n              message: response.data.message,\\n            },\\n          };\\n        }\\n        return response;\\n      },\\n      (error) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // 错误响应格式转换\\n        if (error.response &amp;amp;&amp;amp; error.response.data) {\\n          const tpdError = error.response.data;\\n          return Promise.reject({\\n            ...error,\\n            response: {\\n              ...error.response,\\n              data: {\\n                success: false,\\n                error: tpdError.message || '请求失败',\\n                code: tpdError.code,\\n              },\\n            },\\n          });\\n        }\\n        return Promise.reject(error);\\n      }\\n    );\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n}\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13461,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \" * TPD2 项目技术点服务\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13465,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \" * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13521,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13533,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 13681,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14182,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import axios from 'axios';\\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 同步服务\\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\\n */\\nexport class TPDSyncService {\\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n}\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14209,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \" * TPD2 同步服务\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14213,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \" * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14237,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 14260,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14288,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export const techPointService = {\\n,\\n\\n  // 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\\n  async syncFromTPD(): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    total: number;\\n    created: number;\\n    updated: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/sync&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nexport default techPointService;\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14336,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"  // 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14732,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class TPDTechPointService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n  async getTechPoints(\\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\\n      const queryParams: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {};\\n\\n      if (params?.page) {\\n        queryParams.page = params.page.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.pageSize) {\\n        queryParams.pageSize = params.pageSize.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.keyword) {\\n        queryParams.keyword = params.keyword;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.category_id) {\\n        queryParams.category_id = params.category_id.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.status) {\\n        queryParams.status = params.status;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.type) {\\n        queryParams.tech_type = params.type;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.priority) {\\n        queryParams.priority = params.priority;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortBy) {\\n        queryParams.orderBy = params.sortBy;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortOrder) {\\n        queryParams.orderDirection = params.sortOrder.toUpperCase();\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await this.client.get('/tech-points', {\\n        params: queryParams,\\n      });\\n\\n      // 响应已经被拦截器转换，现在格式是 { success: true, data: {...} }\\n      const responseData = response.data;\\n\\n      if (responseData.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; responseData.data)\\n  }\\n}\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14768,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14795,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 15218,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      total: 0,\\n      created: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n\\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\\n      let page = 1;\\n      const pageSize = 100;\\n      let hasMore = true;\\n\\n      while (hasMore) {\\n        try {\\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\\n          const response = await axios.get(&amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&amp;#96;, {\\n            params: {\\n              page,\\n              pageSize,\\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\\n            },\\n            timeout: 30000,\\n          });\\n\\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\\n\\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\\n\\n          // 处理每个技术点\\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\\n            try {\\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\\n              if (result.created) {\\n                stats.created++;\\n              } else {\\n                stats.updated++;\\n              }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n              logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n              stats.errors++;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\\n          if (techPoints.length &amp;lt; pageSize) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n          } else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      }\\n  }\\n}\","
                },

{\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}/content&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取技术点关联内容失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取技术点关联内容失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  async getTechPointAssociatedCarModels(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;CarModel[]&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}/car-models&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取技术点关联车型失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取技术点关联车型失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 技术分类相关API\\n  async getTechCategories(): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(TECH_CATEGORY_BASE_URL);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取技术分类失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取技术分类失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  async createTechCategory(data: { name: string; description?: string; parent_id?: number }): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post(TECH_CATEGORY_BASE_URL, data);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('创建技术分类失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '创建技术分类失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 车型相关API\\n  async getCarModels(): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;CarModel[]&amp;gt;&amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 22761,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"async getTechPoints(\\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n\\n\\n      if (responseData.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; responseData.data) {\\n        // TPD2 返回的 data 格式: { data: [], total: number, page: number, pageSize: number, totalPages: number }\\n        // 确保返回格式符合 PaginatedResponse\\n        const paginatedData = responseData.data;\\n        const dataArray = paginatedData.data || [];\\n        const total = paginatedData.total || 0;\\n        const page = paginatedData.page || 1;\\n        const pageSize = paginatedData.pageSize || 20;\\n        const totalPages = paginatedData.totalPages || Math.ceil(total / pageSize);\\n        \\n        return {\\n          success: true,\\n          data: {\\n            data: dataArray,\\n            items: dataArray, // 兼容性：某些地方可能使用 items\\n            total,\\n            page,\\n            pageSize,\\n            totalPages,\\n          },\\n          message: responseData.message,\\n        };\\n      }\\n\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: responseData.error || '获取技术点列表失败',\\n      };\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      console.error('获取技术点列表失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error:\\n          error.response?.data?.error ||\\n          error.message ||\\n          '获取技术点列表失败',\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n// 导出单例实例\\nexport const tpdTechPointService = new TPDTechPointService();\","

                  "lineNumber": 26276,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class TPDTechPointService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n  async getTechPoints(\\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\\n      const queryParams: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {};\\n\\n      if (params?.page) {\\n        queryParams.page = params.page.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.pageSize) {\\n        queryParams.pageSize = params.pageSize.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.keyword) {\\n        queryParams.keyword = params.keyword;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.category_id) {\\n        queryParams.category_id = params.category_id.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.status) {\\n        queryParams.status = params.status;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.type) {\\n        queryParams.tech_type = params.type;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.priority) {\\n        queryParams.priority = params.priority;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortBy) {\\n        queryParams.orderBy = params.sortBy;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortOrder) {\\n        queryParams.orderDirection = params.sortOrder.toUpperCase();\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await this.client.get('/tech-points', {\\n        params: queryParams,\\n      });\\n\\n      // 响应已经被拦截器转换，现在格式是 { success: true, data: {...} }\\n      const responseData = response.data;\\n\\n      if (responseData.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; responseData.data)\\n  }\\n}\","
