                  "lineNumber": 26842,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * 技术点同步服务\\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\\n * \\n * 后续实现功能：\\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\\n * 5. 同步日志记录\\n */\\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\\n  /**\\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n   * @param options 同步选项\\n   */\\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量\\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/tpd2', {\\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\\n   */\\n  async syncToTPD2(techPointIds?: number[]): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    synced: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/to-tpd2', {\\n        techPointIds,\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点到 TPD2 失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点到 TPD2 失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取同步状态\\n   */\\n  async getSyncStatus(): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    lastSyncTime: string | null;\\n    lastSyncType: 'from_tpd2' | 'to_tpd2' | null;\\n    syncInProgress: boolean;\\n    syncProgress?: {\\n      total: number;\\n      completed: number;\\n      failed: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get('/tech-points/sync/status');\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取同步状态失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取同步状态失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取同步日志\\n   * @param options 查询选项\\n   */\\n  async getSyncLogs(options?: {\\n    page?: number;\\n    pageSize?: number;\\n    startDate?: string;\\n    endDate?: string;\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    id: number;\\n    syncType: 'from_tpd2' | 'to_tpd2';\\n    status: 'success' | 'failed' | 'partial';\\n    syncedCount: number;\\n    errorCount: number;\\n    startTime: string;\\n    endTime: string | null;\\n    errorMessage?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get('/tech-points/sync/logs', {\\n        params: options,\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取同步日志失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取同步日志失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n};\\n\\nexport default techPointSyncService;\\n\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TechPointController {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\\n   * POST /api/v1/tech-points/sync\\n   */\\n  async syncFromTPD(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      console.log('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n      \\n      const result = await tpdSyncService.syncTechPoints();\\n      \\n      if (result.success) {\\n        res.json({\\n          success: true,\\n          message: result.message,\\n          data: result.stats\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        res.status(500).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: result.message,\\n          data: result.stats\\n        });\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步 TPD2 技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 27283,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * 技术点同步服务\\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\\n * \\n * 后续实现功能：\\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\\n * 5. 同步日志记录\\n */\\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\\n  /**\\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n   * @param options 同步选项\\n   */\\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量\\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/tpd2', {\\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\\n   */\\n,\\n};\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 27500,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      total: 0,\\n      created: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n\\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\\n      let page = 1;\\n      const pageSize = 100;\\n      let hasMore = true;\\n\\n      while (hasMore) {\\n        try {\\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\\n          const response = await axios.get(&amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&amp;#96;, {\\n            params: {\\n              page,\\n              pageSize,\\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\\n            },\\n            timeout: 30000,\\n          });\\n\\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\\n\\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\\n\\n          // 处理每个技术点\\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\\n            try {\\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\\n              if (result.created) {\\n                stats.created++;\\n              } else {\\n                stats.updated++;\\n              }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n              logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n              stats.errors++;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\\n          if (techPoints.length &amp;lt; pageSize) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n          } else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      }\\n  }\\n}\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 27875,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import axios from 'axios';\\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 同步服务\\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\\n */\\nexport class TPDSyncService {\\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 27906,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \" * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\","
                },

                  "content": "            \"text\": \"    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\","

                  "content": "            \"text\": \"   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 28413,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../config/tpd';\\nimport {\\n  TechPoint,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  PaginatedResponse,\\n  TechPointSearchParams,\\n} from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 项目技术点服务\\n * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\\n */\\nclass TPDTechPointService {\\n  private client: AxiosInstance;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    this.client = axios.create({\\n      baseURL: TPD_API_BASE_URL,\\n      timeout: 30000,\\n      headers: {\\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\\n      },\\n    });\\n\\n    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\\n      (response) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\\n        // todify3 期望格式: { success: true, data: {...} }\\n        if (response.data &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.code === 200) {\\n          return {\\n            ...response,\\n            data: {\\n              success: true,\\n              data: response.data.data,\\n              message: response.data.message,\\n            },\\n          };\\n        }\\n        return response;\\n      },\\n      (error) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // 错误响应格式转换\\n        if (error.response &amp;amp;&amp;amp; error.response.data) {\\n          const tpdError = error.response.data;\\n          return Promise.reject({\\n            ...error,\\n            response: {\\n              ...error.response,\\n              data: {\\n                success: false,\\n                error: tpdError.message || '请求失败',\\n                code: tpdError.code,\\n              },\\n            },\\n          });\\n        }\\n        return Promise.reject(error);\\n      }\\n    );\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n}\","
                },

                {
                  "lineNumber": 28851,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class TPDTechPointService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n  async getTechPoints(\\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\\n      const queryParams: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {};\\n\\n      if (params?.page) {\\n        queryParams.page = params.page.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.pageSize) {\\n        queryParams.pageSize = params.pageSize.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.keyword) {\\n        queryParams.keyword = params.keyword;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.category_id) {\\n        queryParams.category_id = params.category_id.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.status) {\\n        queryParams.status = params.status;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.type) {\\n        queryParams.tech_type = params.type;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.priority) {\\n        queryParams.priority = params.priority;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortBy) {\\n        queryParams.orderBy = params.sortBy;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortOrder) {\\n        queryParams.orderDirection = params.sortOrder.toUpperCase();\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await this.client.get('/tech-points', {\\n        params: queryParams,\\n      });\\n\\n      // 响应已经被拦截器转换，现在格式是 { success: true, data: {...} }\\n      const responseData = response.data;\\n\\n      if (responseData.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; responseData.data)\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\nasync syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\nwhile (hasMore) {\\n else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n          stats.errors++;\\n          hasMore = false;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('TPD2 技术点数据同步完成', stats);\\n\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n        message: &amp;#96;同步完成：总计 ${stats.total} 条，新增 ${stats.created} 条，更新 ${stats.updated} 条，错误 ${stats.errors} 条&amp;#96;,\\n        stats,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败',\\n        stats,\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步单个技术点\\n   * @returns {Promise&amp;lt;{created: boolean}&amp;gt;} 返回是否为新创建\\n   */\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export const techPointSyncService = {\\n,\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取同步日志\\n   * @param options 查询选项\\n   */\\n  async getSyncLogs(options?: {\\n    page?: number;\\n    pageSize?: number;\\n    startDate?: string;\\n    endDate?: string;\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    id: number;\\n    syncType: 'from_tpd2' | 'to_tpd2';\\n    status: 'success' | 'failed' | 'partial';\\n    syncedCount: number;\\n    errorCount: number;\\n    startTime: string;\\n    endTime: string | null;\\n    errorMessage?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get('/tech-points/sync/logs', {\\n        params: options,\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取同步日志失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取同步日志失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n};\\n\\nexport default techPointSyncService;\","

                  "lineNumber": 30528,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"async getTechPoints(\\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n\\n\\n      if (responseData.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; responseData.data) {\\n        // TPD2 返回的 data 格式: { data: [], total: number, page: number, pageSize: number, totalPages: number }\\n        // 确保返回格式符合 PaginatedResponse\\n        const paginatedData = responseData.data;\\n        const dataArray = paginatedData.data || [];\\n        const total = paginatedData.total || 0;\\n        const page = paginatedData.page || 1;\\n        const pageSize = paginatedData.pageSize || 20;\\n        const totalPages = paginatedData.totalPages || Math.ceil(total / pageSize);\\n        \\n        return {\\n          success: true,\\n          data: {\\n            data: dataArray,\\n            items: dataArray, // 兼容性：某些地方可能使用 items\\n            total,\\n            page,\\n            pageSize,\\n            totalPages,\\n          },\\n          message: responseData.message,\\n        };\\n      }\\n\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: responseData.error || '获取技术点列表失败',\\n      };\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      console.error('获取技术点列表失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error:\\n          error.response?.data?.error ||\\n          error.message ||\\n          '获取技术点列表失败',\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n// 导出单例实例\\nexport const tpdTechPointService = new TPDTechPointService();\","

                  "lineNumber": 32392,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * 技术点同步服务\\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\\n * \\n * 后续实现功能：\\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\\n * 5. 同步日志记录\\n */\\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\\n  /**\\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n   * @param options 同步选项\\n   */\\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量\\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/tpd2', {\\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\\n   */\\n  async syncToTPD2(techPointIds?: number[]): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    synced: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/to-tpd2', {\\n        techPointIds,\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点到 TPD2 失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点到 TPD2 失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取同步状态\\n   */\\n  async getSyncStatus(): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    lastSyncTime: string | null;\\n    lastSyncType: 'from_tpd2' | 'to_tpd2' | null;\\n    syncInProgress: boolean;\\n    syncProgress?: {\\n      total: number;\\n      completed: number;\\n      failed: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get('/tech-points/sync/status');\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取同步状态失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取同步状态失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取同步日志\\n   * @param options 查询选项\\n   */\\n  async getSyncLogs(options?: {\\n    page?: number;\\n    pageSize?: number;\\n    startDate?: string;\\n    endDate?: string;\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    id: number;\\n    syncType: 'from_tpd2' | 'to_tpd2';\\n    status: 'success' | 'failed' | 'partial';\\n    syncedCount: number;\\n    errorCount: number;\\n    startTime: string;\\n    endTime: string | null;\\n    errorMessage?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get('/tech-points/sync/logs', {\\n        params: options,\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取同步日志失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取同步日志失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n};\\n\\nexport default techPointSyncService;\\n\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * 技术点同步服务\\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\\n * \\n * 后续实现功能：\\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\\n * 5. 同步日志记录\\n */\\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\\n  /**\\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n   * @param options 同步选项\\n   */\\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量\\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/tpd2', {\\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\\n   */\\n,\\n};\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 38078,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"\\n  /**\\n   * 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\\n   * POST /api/v1/tech-points/sync\\n   */\\n  async syncFromTPD(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      console.log('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n      \\n      const result = await tpdSyncService.syncTechPoints();\\n      \\n      if (result.success) {\\n        res.json({\\n          success: true,\\n          message: result.message,\\n          data: result.stats\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        res.status(500).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: result.message,\\n          data: result.stats\\n        });\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步 TPD2 技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 66044,
                  "content": "执行数据复制，将TPD2的技术点数据库数据，直接导入到本项目技术点库"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 66055,
                  "content": "查看项目结构和数据库配置，以便将 TPD2 的技术点数据导入当前项目。"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 72270,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import axios from 'axios';\\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 同步服务\\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\\n */\\nexport class TPDSyncService {\\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      total: 0,\\n      created: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n\\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\\n      let page = 1;\\n      const pageSize = 100;\\n      let hasMore = true;\\n\\n      while (hasMore) {\\n        try {\\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\\n          const response = await axios.get(&amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&amp;#96;, {\\n            params: {\\n              page,\\n              pageSize,\\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\\n            },\\n            timeout: 30000,\\n          });\\n\\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\\n\\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\\n\\n          // 处理每个技术点\\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\\n            try {\\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\\n              if (result.created) {\\n                stats.created++;\\n              } else {\\n                stats.updated++;\\n              }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n              logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n              stats.errors++;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\\n          if (techPoints.length &amp;lt; pageSize) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n          } else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n          stats.errors++;\\n          hasMore = false;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('TPD2 技术点数据同步完成', stats);\\n\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n        message: &amp;#96;同步完成：总计 ${stats.total} 条，新增 ${stats.created} 条，更新 ${stats.updated} 条，错误 ${stats.errors} 条&amp;#96;,\\n        stats,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败',\\n        stats,\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步单个技术点\\n   * @returns {Promise&amp;lt;{created: boolean}&amp;gt;} 返回是否为新创建\\n   */\\n  private async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&amp;lt;{ created: boolean }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 获取技术点详情（包含关联数据）\\n      const detailResponse = await axios.get(\\n        &amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${tpdTechPoint.id}&amp;#96;,\\n        {\\n          params: {\\n            includeAssociations: true,\\n          },\\n          timeout: 30000,\\n        }\\n      );\\n\\n      if (detailResponse.data.code !== 200 || !detailResponse.data.data) {\\n        throw new Error('获取技术点详情失败');\\n      }\\n\\n      const techPointDetail = detailResponse.data.data;\\n\\n      // 准备技术点数据\\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\\n      };\\n\\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称查找，因为 ID 可能不同）\\n      // 首先尝试通过 ID 查找\\n      let existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\\n      \\n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\\n      if (!existing) {\\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&amp;gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\\n      }\\n\\n      let created = false;\\n      if (existing) {\\n        // 更新现有技术点\\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\\n        created = false;\\n      } else {\\n        // 创建新技术点\\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\\n        created = true;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;amp;&amp;amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\\n        logger.debug(&amp;#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n\\n      return { created };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 映射技术点类型\\n   */\\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\\n    const typeMap: Record&amp;lt;string, TechType&amp;gt; = {\\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE,\\n      technology: TechType.TECHNOLOGY,\\n      innovation: TechType.INNOVATION,\\n      improvement: TechType.IMPROVEMENT,\\n    };\\n    return typeMap[tpdType] || TechType.FEATURE;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 映射优先级\\n   */\\n  private mapPriority(tpdPriority: string): Priority {\\n    const priorityMap: Record&amp;lt;string, Priority&amp;gt; = {\\n      low: Priority.LOW,\\n      medium: Priority.MEDIUM,\\n      high: Priority.HIGH,\\n      critical: Priority.CRITICAL,\\n    };\\n    return priorityMap[tpdPriority] || Priority.MEDIUM;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 映射状态\\n   */\\n  private mapStatus(tpdStatus: string): Status {\\n    const statusMap: Record&amp;lt;string, Status&amp;gt; = {\\n      active: Status.ACTIVE,\\n      inactive: Status.INACTIVE,\\n      draft: Status.DRAFT,\\n      archived: Status.ARCHIVED,\\n    };\\n    return statusMap[tpdStatus] || Status.DRAFT;\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n// 导出单例实例\\nexport const tpdSyncService = new TPDSyncService();\\n\\n\","
                },

logger.debug(&amp;#96;导入技术点: ${techPoint.name} (ID: ${techPoint.id})&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;导入技术点失败 (ID: ${techPoint.id}, Name:                   "lineNumber": 102057,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import sqlite3 from 'sqlite3';\\nimport { promisify } from 'util';\\nimport path from 'path';\\nimport fs from 'fs';\\nimport { DatabaseManager, getDatabaseConfig } from '../config/database';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\n\\n/**\\n * 从 TPD2 数据库直接导入技术点数据到当前项目\\n * \\n * 使用方法：\\n * 1. 确保 TPD2 数据库文件路径正确（默认：/Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/TPD2/backend/data/todify2.db）\\n * 2. 运行: npx ts-node backend/src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts\\n */\\n\\ninterface TechCategoryRow {\\n  id: number;\\n  name: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  parent_id?: number;\\n  level: number;\\n  sort_order: number;\\n  status: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  updated_at: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface TechPointRow {\\n  id: number;\\n  name: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  category_id?: number;\\n  parent_id?: number;\\n  level: number;\\n  tech_type: string;\\n  priority: string;\\n  status: string;\\n  tags?: string;\\n  technical_details?: string;\\n  benefits?: string;\\n  applications?: string;\\n  keywords?: string;\\n  source_url?: string;\\n  created_by?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  updated_at: string;\\n}\\n\\nclass TPD2DataImporter {\\n  private tpd2DbPath: string;\\n  private tpd2Db: sqlite3.Database | null = null;\\n  private targetDb: DatabaseManager;\\n\\n  constructor(tpd2DbPath: string) {\\n    this.tpd2DbPath = tpd2DbPath;\\n    this.targetDb = new DatabaseManager();\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 连接到 TPD2 数据库\\n   */\\n  async connectTPD2(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (!fs.existsSync(this.tpd2DbPath)) {\\n        reject(new Error(&amp;#96;TPD2 数据库文件不存在: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&amp;#96;));\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      this.tpd2Db = new sqlite3.Database(this.tpd2DbPath, (err) =&amp;gt; {\\n        if (err) {\\n          logger.error('连接 TPD2 数据库失败:', err);\\n          reject(err);\\n        } else {\\n          logger.info(&amp;#96;✅ 成功连接到 TPD2 数据库: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&amp;#96;);\\n          resolve();\\n        }\\n      });\\n    });\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 查询 TPD2 数据库\\n   */\\n  private async queryTPD2(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&amp;lt;any[]&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!this.tpd2Db) {\\n      throw new Error('TPD2 数据库未连接');\\n    }\\n\\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&amp;gt; {\\n      this.tpd2Db!.all(sql, params, (err, rows) =&amp;gt; {\\n        if (err) {\\n          logger.error('TPD2 数据库查询失败:', err);\\n          reject(err);\\n        } else {\\n          resolve(rows);\\n        }\\n      });\\n    });\\n  }\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 102167,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行完整导入流程\\n   */\\n  async import(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 连接数据库\\n      await this.connectTPD2();\\n      await this.targetDb.connect();\\n\\n      logger.info('========================================');\\n      logger.info('开始从 TPD2 导入技术点数据');\\n      logger.info('========================================');\\n\\n      // 导入技术分类\\n      const categoryStats = await this.importTechCategories();\\n\\n      // 导入技术点\\n      const techPointStats = await this.importTechPoints();\\n\\n      // 导入技术点与车型关联\\n      const carModelStats = await this.importTechPointCarModels();\\n\\n      // 输出汇总\\n      logger.info('========================================');\\n      logger.info('数据导入完成');\\n      logger.info('========================================');\\n      logger.info('技术分类:');\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;  新增: ${categoryStats.imported}&amp;#96;);\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;  更新: ${categoryStats.skipped}&amp;#96;);\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;  错误: ${categoryStats.errors}&amp;#96;);\\n      logger.info('技术点:');\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;  新增: ${techPointStats.imported}&amp;#96;);\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;  更新: ${techPointStats.updated}&amp;#96;);\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;  错误: ${techPointStats.errors}&amp;#96;);\\n      logger.info('技术点与车型关联:');\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;  新增: ${carModelStats.imported}&amp;#96;);\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;  更新: ${carModelStats.skipped}&amp;#96;);\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;  错误: ${carModelStats.errors}&amp;#96;);\\n      logger.info('========================================');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('导入过程发生错误:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    } finally {\\n      // 关闭数据库连接\\n      await this.closeTPD2();\\n      await this.targetDb.close();\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n// 主函数\\nasync function main() {\\n  // TPD2 数据库路径（可根据实际情况修改）\\n  const tpd2DbPath = process.env.TPD2_DB_PATH || '/Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/TPD2/backend/data/todify2.db';\\n\\n  // 检查文件是否存在\\n  if (!fs.existsSync(tpd2DbPath)) {\\n    logger.error(&amp;#96;❌ TPD2 数据库文件不存在: ${tpd2DbPath}&amp;#96;);\\n    logger.info('请设置环境变量 TPD2_DB_PATH 指定正确的数据库路径');\\n    process.exit(1);\\n  }\\n\\n  logger.info(&amp;#96;TPD2 数据库路径: ${tpd2DbPath}&amp;#96;);\\n\\n  // 获取当前项目数据库配置\\n  const config = getDatabaseConfig();\\n  if (config.type === 'sqlite' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.sqlite) {\\n    logger.info(&amp;#96;目标数据库路径: ${config.sqlite.path}&amp;#96;);\\n  }\\n\\n  try {\\n    const importer = new TPD2DataImporter(tpd2DbPath);\\n    await importer.import();\\n    logger.info('✅ 数据导入成功完成');\\n    process.exit(0);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('❌ 数据导入失败:', error);\\n    process.exit(1);\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n// 执行主函数\\nif (require.main === module) {\\n  main().catch((error) =&amp;gt; {\\n    logger.error('未处理的错误:', error);\\n    process.exit(1);\\n  });\\n}\\n\\nexport { TPD2DataImporter };\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"  async getCarModels(): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;CarModel[]&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(CAR_MODEL_BASE_URL);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取车型列表失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取车型列表失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 技术点与车型关联\\n  async getTechPointCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;CarModel[]&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/${techPointId}/car-models&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取技术点关联车型失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取技术点关联车型失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 关联车型到技术点\\n  async associateCarModelToTechPoint(\\n    techPointId: number,\\n    data: {\\n      carModelId: number;\\n      applicationStatus?: string;\\n      implementationDate?: string;\\n      notes?: string;\\n    }\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/${techPointId}/car-models&amp;#96;, data);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('关联车型失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '关联车型失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 取消车型与技术点的关联\\n  async disassociateCarModelFromTechPoint(\\n    techPointId: number,\\n    carModelId: number\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.delete(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/${techPointId}/car-models/${carModelId}&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('取消关联失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '取消关联失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 更新车型关联信息\\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(\\n    techPointId: number,\\n    carModelId: number,\\n    data: {\\n      applicationStatus?: string;\\n      implementationDate?: string;\\n      notes?: string;\\n    }\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.put(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/${techPointId}/car-models/${carModelId}&amp;#96;, data);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('更新关联信息失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '更新关联信息失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  async addTechPointCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;void&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/${techPointId}/car-models&amp;#96;, {\\n        car_model_id: carModelId\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('添加技术点车型关联失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '添加技术点车型关联失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  async removeTechPointCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;void&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.delete(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/${techPointId}/car-models/${carModelId}&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('移除技术点车型关联失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '移除技术点车型关联失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\\n  async syncFromTPD(): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    total: number;\\n    created: number;\\n    updated: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/sync&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 获取技术点的完整关联数据（用于图谱展示和资源加载）\\n  async getGraphRelations(techPointId: number): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    products: any[];\\n    category: any;\\n    resources: any[];\\n    technologies: any[];\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/${techPointId}/graph-relations&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取技术点关联数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取技术点关联数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nexport default techPointService;\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 109501,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class TPD2DataImporter {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 导入技术点与资源关联\\n   */\\n  async importTechPointResources(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    imported: number;\\n    skipped: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      imported: 0,\\n      skipped: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      const tableExists = await this.tableExistsTPD2('tech_point_resources');\\n      if (!tableExists) {\\n        logger.warn('TPD2 数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，跳过资源关联导入');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查目标数据库中是否有 tech_point_resources 表\\n      const targetTableExists = await this.targetDb.query(\\n        \\\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='tech_point_resources'\\\"\\n      );\\n\\n      if (!targetTableExists || targetTableExists.length === 0) {\\n        logger.warn('目标数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，创建表结构...');\\n        await this.targetDb.query(&amp;#96;\\n          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_resources (\\n            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n            tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n            resource_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n            created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n            FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n            FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n            UNIQUE(tech_point_id, resource_id)\\n          )\\n        &amp;#96;);\\n        logger.info('✅ tech_point_resources 表创建成功');\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('开始导入技术点与资源关联...');\\n      const associations = await this.queryTPD2('SELECT * FROM tech_point_resources ORDER BY tech_point_id, resource_id');\\n\\n      if (associations.length === 0) {\\n        logger.info('TPD2 数据库中没有技术点与资源关联数据');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;找到 ${associations.length} 个技术点与资源关联&amp;#96;);\\n\\n      for (const assoc of associations)\\n  }\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 125646,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import sqlite3 from 'sqlite3';\\nimport { promisify } from 'util';\\nimport path from 'path';\\nimport fs from 'fs';\\nimport { DatabaseManager, getDatabaseConfig } from '../config/database';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\n\\n/**\\n * 从 TPD2 数据库直接导入技术点数据到当前项目\\n * \\n * 使用方法：\\n * 1. 确保 TPD2 数据库文件路径正确（默认：/Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/TPD2/backend/data/todify2.db）\\n * 2. 运行: npx ts-node backend/src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts\\n */\\n\\ninterface TechCategoryRow {\\n  id: number;\\n  name: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  parent_id?: number;\\n  level: number;\\n  sort_order: number;\\n  status: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  updated_at: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface TechPointRow {\\n  id: number;\\n  name: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  category_id?: number;\\n  parent_id?: number;\\n  level: number;\\n  tech_type: string;\\n  priority: string;\\n  status: string;\\n  tags?: string;\\n  technical_details?: string;\\n  benefits?: string;\\n  applications?: string;\\n  keywords?: string;\\n  source_url?: string;\\n  created_by?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  updated_at: string;\\n}\\n\\nclass TPD2DataImporter {\\n  private tpd2DbPath: string;\\n  private tpd2Db: sqlite3.Database | null = null;\\n  private targetDb: DatabaseManager;\\n\\n  constructor(tpd2DbPath: string) {\\n    this.tpd2DbPath = tpd2DbPath;\\n    this.targetDb = new DatabaseManager();\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 连接到 TPD2 数据库\\n   */\\n  async connectTPD2(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (!fs.existsSync(this.tpd2DbPath)) {\\n        reject(new Error(&amp;#96;TPD2 数据库文件不存在: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&amp;#96;));\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      this.tpd2Db = new sqlite3.Database(this.tpd2DbPath, (err) =&amp;gt; {\\n        if (err) {\\n          logger.error('连接 TPD2 数据库失败:', err);\\n          reject(err);\\n        } else {\\n          logger.info(&amp;#96;✅ 成功连接到 TPD2 数据库: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&amp;#96;);\\n          resolve();\\n        }\\n      });\\n    });\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 查询 TPD2 数据库\\n   */\\n  private async queryTPD2(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&amp;lt;any[]&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!this.tpd2Db) {\\n      throw new Error('TPD2 数据库未连接');\\n    }\\n\\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&amp;gt; {\\n      this.tpd2Db!.all(sql, params, (err, rows) =&amp;gt; {\\n        if (err) {\\n          logger.error('TPD2 数据库查询失败:', err);\\n          reject(err);\\n        } else {\\n          resolve(rows);\\n        }\\n      });\\n    });\\n  }\\n\","

AND type = ?',\\n              [resource.name, resource.type]\\n            );\\n          }\\n\\n          if (existing &amp;amp;&amp;amp; existing.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n            const existingId = existing[0].id;\\n            await this.targetDb.query(\\n              &amp;#96;UPDATE resources SET\\n                name = ?,\\n                type = ?,\\n                description = ?,\\n                status = ?,\\n                delivery_date = ?,\\n                attachments = ?,\\n                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n                WHERE id = ?&amp;#96;,\\n              [\\n                resource.name,\\n                resource.type,\\n                resource.description || null,\\n                resource.status || '开发中',\\n                resource.delivery_date || null,\\n                resource.attachments || null,\\n                existingId,\\n              ]\\n            );\\n            stats.updated++;\\n          } else {\\n            await this.targetDb.query(\\n              &amp;#96;INSERT INTO resources (\\n                id, name, type, description, status, delivery_date, \\n                attachments, created_at, updated_at\\n              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)&amp;#96;,\\n              [\\n                resource.id,\\n                resource.name,\\n                resource.type,\\n                resource.description || null,\\n                resource.status || '开发中',\\n                resource.delivery_date || null,\\n                resource.attachments || null,\\n                resource.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),\\n                resource.updated_at || new Date().toISOString(),\\n              ]\\n            );\\n            stats.imported++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;导入资源失败 (ID: ${resource.id}, Name: ${resource.name}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n          stats.errors++;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;资源导入完成: 新增 ${stats.imported} 个, 更新 ${stats.updated} 个, 错误 ${stats.errors} 个&amp;#96;);\\n      return stats;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('导入资源失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 导入技术点与资源关联\\n   */\\n  async importTechPointResources(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    imported: number;\\n    skipped: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      imported: 0,\\n      skipped: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      const tableExists = await this.tableExistsTPD2('tech_point_resources');\\n      if (!tableExists) {\\n        logger.warn('TPD2 数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，跳过资源关联导入');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查目标数据库中是否有 tech_point_resources 表\\n      const targetTableExists = await this.targetDb.query(\\n        \\\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='tech_point_resources'\\\"\\n      );\\n\\n      if (!targetTableExists || targetTableExists.length === 0) {\\n        logger.warn('目标数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，创建表结构...');\\n        await this.targetDb.query(&amp;#96;\\n          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_resources (\\n            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n            tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n            resource_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n            created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n            FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n            FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n            UNIQUE(tech_point_id, resource_id)\\n          )\\n        &amp;#96;);\\n        logger.info('✅ tech_point_resources 表创建成功');\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('开始导入技术点与资源关联...');\\n      const associations = await this.queryTPD2('SELECT * FROM tech_point_resources ORDER BY tech_point_id, resource_id');\\n\\n      if (associations.length === 0) {\\n        logger.info('TPD2 数据库中没有技术点与资源关联数据');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;找到 ${associations.length} 个技术点与资源关联&amp;#96;);\\n\\n      for (const assoc of associations) {\\n        try {\\n          // 检查关联是否已存在\\n          const existing = await this.targetDb.query(\\n            'SELECT id FROM tech_point_resources WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND resource_id = ?',\\n            [assoc.tech_point_id, assoc.resource_id]\\n          );\\n\\n          // 检查技术点和资源是否存在\\n          const techPointExists = await this.targetDb.query(\\n            'SELECT id FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?',\\n            [assoc.tech_point_id]\\n          );\\n          const resourceExists = await this.targetDb.query(\\n            'SELECT id FROM resources WHERE id = ?',\\n            [assoc.resource_id]\\n          );\\n\\n          if (!techPointExists || techPointExists.length === 0) {\\n            logger.debug(&amp;#96;技术点 ${assoc.tech_point_id} 不存在，跳过关联&amp;#96;);\\n            stats.skipped++;\\n            continue;\\n          }\\n\\n          if (!resourceExists || resourceExists.length === 0) {\\n            logger.debug(&amp;#96;资源 ${assoc.resource_id} 不存在，跳过关联&amp;#96;);\\n            stats.skipped++;\\n            continue;\\n          }\\n\\n          if (existing &amp;amp;&amp;amp; existing.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n            stats.skipped++;\\n          } else {\\n            await this.targetDb.query(\\n              &amp;#96;INSERT INTO tech_point_resources (\\n                tech_point_id, resource_id, created_at\\n              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?)&amp;#96;,\\n              [\\n                assoc.tech_point_id,\\n                assoc.resource_id,\\n                assoc.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),\\n              ]\\n            );\\n            stats.imported++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;导入技术点与资源关联失败 (tech_point_id: ${assoc.tech_point_id}, resource_id: ${assoc.resource_id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n          stats.errors++;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;技术点与资源关联导入完成: 新增 ${stats.imported} 个, 更新 ${stats.skipped} 个, 错误 ${stats.errors} 个&amp;#96;);\\n      return stats;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('导入技术点与资源关联失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行完整导入流程\\n   */\\n  async import(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 125951,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * 技术点同步服务\\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\\n * \\n * 后续实现功能：\\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\\n * 5. 同步日志记录\\n */\\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\\n  /**\\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\\n   * @param options 同步选项\\n   */\\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量（总数）\\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync', {\\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\\n      });\\n      // 后端返回的格式是 { success, message, data: { total, created, updated, errors } }\\n      if (response.data &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const stats = response.data.data;\\n        return {\\n          success: response.data.success ?? true,\\n          data: {\\n            synced: stats.total || (stats.created || 0) + (stats.updated || 0),\\n            updated: stats.updated || 0,\\n            created: stats.created || 0,\\n            errors: stats.errors || 0,\\n          },\\n          message: response.data.message,\\n        };\\n      }\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\\n   */\\n,\\n};\","

                  "lineNumber": 126224,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      total: 0,\\n      created: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n\\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\\n      let page = 1;\\n      const pageSize = 100;\\n      let hasMore = true;\\n\\n      while (hasMore) {\\n        try {\\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\\n          const response = await axios.get(&amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&amp;#96;, {\\n            params: {\\n              page,\\n              pageSize,\\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\\n            },\\n            timeout: 30000,\\n          });\\n\\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\\n\\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\\n\\n          // 处理每个技术点\\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\\n            try {\\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\\n              if (result.created) {\\n                stats.created++;\\n              } else {\\n                stats.updated++;\\n              }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n              logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n              stats.errors++;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\\n          if (techPoints.length &amp;lt; pageSize) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n          } else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      }\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\nasync syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\nwhile (hasMore) {\\n else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n          stats.errors++;\\n          hasMore = false;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('TPD2 技术点数据同步完成', stats);\\n\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n        message: &amp;#96;同步完成：总计 ${stats.total} 条，新增 ${stats.created} 条，更新 ${stats.updated} 条，错误 ${stats.errors} 条&amp;#96;,\\n        stats,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败',\\n        stats,\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步单个技术点\\n   * @returns {Promise&amp;lt;{created: boolean}&amp;gt;} 返回是否为新创建\\n   */\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class TPD2DataImporter {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行完整导入流程\\n   */\\n  async import(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 连接数据库\\n      await this.connectTPD2();\\n      await this.targetDb.connect();\\n\\n      logger.info('========================================');\\n      logger.info('开始从 TPD2 导入数据');\\n      logger.info('========================================');\\n\\n      // 1. 导入品牌（车型的前置依赖）\\n      const brandStats = await this.importBrands();\\n\\n      // 2. 导入技术分类\\n      const categoryStats = await this.importTechCategories();\\n\\n      // 3. 导入技术点\\n      const techPointStats = await this.importTechPoints();\\n\\n      // 4. 导入车型（依赖品牌）\\n      const carModelStats = await this.importCarModels();\\n\\n      // 5. 导入资源\\n      const resourceStats = await this.importResources();\\n\\n      // 6. 导入技术点与车型关联\\n      const carModelAssocStats = await this.importTechPointCarModels();\\n\\n      // 7. 导入技术点与资源关联\\n      const resourceAssocStats = await this.importTechPointResources();\\n\\n      // 输出汇总\\n      logger.info('========================================');\\n      logger.info('数据导入完成');\\n      logger.info('========================================');\\n      logger.info('品牌:');\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;                   "lineNumber": 130621,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class TPD2DataImporter {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 导入技术点与资源关联\\n   */\\n  async importTechPointResources(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    imported: number;\\n    skipped: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      imported: 0,\\n      skipped: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      const tableExists = await this.tableExistsTPD2('tech_point_resources');\\n      if (!tableExists) {\\n        logger.warn('TPD2 数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，跳过资源关联导入');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查目标数据库中是否有 tech_point_resources 表\\n      const targetTableExists = await this.targetDb.query(\\n        \\\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='tech_point_resources'\\\"\\n      );\\n\\n      if (!targetTableExists || targetTableExists.length === 0) {\\n        logger.warn('目标数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，创建表结构...');\\n        await this.targetDb.query(&amp;#96;\\n          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_resources (\\n            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n            tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n            resource_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n            created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n            FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n            FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n            UNIQUE(tech_point_id, resource_id)\\n          )\\n        &amp;#96;);\\n        logger.info('✅ tech_point_resources 表创建成功');\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('开始导入技术点与资源关联...');\\n      const associations = await this.queryTPD2('SELECT * FROM tech_point_resources ORDER BY tech_point_id, resource_id');\\n\\n      if (associations.length === 0) {\\n        logger.info('TPD2 数据库中没有技术点与资源关联数据');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;找到 ${associations.length} 个技术点与资源关联&amp;#96;);\\n\\n      for (const assoc of associations)\\n  }\","

                  "lineNumber": 144272,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      total: 0,\\n      created: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n\\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\\n      let page = 1;\\n      const pageSize = 100;\\n      let hasMore = true;\\n\\n      while (hasMore) {\\n        try {\\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\\n          const response = await axios.get(&amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&amp;#96;, {\\n            params: {\\n              page,\\n              pageSize,\\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\\n            },\\n            timeout: 30000,\\n          });\\n\\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\\n\\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\\n\\n          // 处理每个技术点\\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\\n            try {\\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\\n              if (result.created) {\\n                stats.created++;\\n              } else {\\n                stats.updated++;\\n              }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n              logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n              stats.errors++;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\\n          if (techPoints.length &amp;lt; pageSize) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n          } else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      }\\n  }\\n}\","

&amp;#96;UPDATE tech_categories SET\\n                name = ?,\\n                description = ?,\\n                parent_id = ?,\\n                level = ?,\\n                sort_order = ?,\\n stats.imported++;\\n            logger.debug(&amp;#96;导入分类: ${category.name} (ID: ${category.id})&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;导入分类失败 (ID: {\\n    const stats = {\\n      imported: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      skipped: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      const tableExists = await this.tableExistsTPD2('car_models');\\n      if (!tableExists) {\\n        logger.warn('TPD2 数据库中不存在 car_models 表，跳过车型导入');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('开始导入车型...');\\n      const carModels = await this.queryTPD2('SELECT * FROM car_models ORDER BY id');\\n\\n      if (carModels.length === 0) {\\n        logger.info('TPD2 数据库中没有车型数据');\\n        return stats;\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;找到 ${carModels.length} 个车型&amp;#96;);\\n\\n      for (const carModel of carModels) {\\n        try {\\n          // 检查品牌是否存在\\n          const brandExists = await this.targetDb.query(\\n            'SELECT id FROM brands WHERE id = ?',\\n            [carModel.brand_id]\\n          );\\n\\n          if (!brandExists || brandExists.length === 0) {\\n            logger.debug(&amp;#96;品牌 ${carModel.brand_id} 不存在，跳过车型 ${carModel.name}&amp;#96;);\\n            stats.skipped++;\\n            continue;\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查车型是否已存在\\n          let existing = await this.targetDb.query(\\n            'SELECT id, name FROM car_models WHERE id = ?',\\n            [carModel.id]\\n          );\\n\\n          if (!existing || existing.length === 0) {\\n            existing = await this.targetDb.query(\\n              'SELECT id, name FROM car_models WHERE brand_id = ? AND name = ?',\\n              [carModel.brand_id, carModel.name]\\n            );\\n          }\\n\\n          // 确保 status 字段符合 CHECK 约束\\n          let status = carModel.status || 'active';\\n          if (status !== 'active' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; status !== 'discontinued' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; status !== 'planned') {\\n            status = 'active';\\n          }\\n\\n          // 确保 category 字段符合 CHECK 约束\\n          const validCategories = ['sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv'];\\n          let category = carModel.category;\\n          if (category) {\\n            const categoryLower = category.toLowerCase();\\n            if (!validCategories.includes(categoryLower)) {\\n              // 尝试映射常见的中文值\\n              const categoryMap: Record&amp;lt;string, string&amp;gt; = {\\n                '豪华轿车': 'sedan',\\n                '中型轿车': 'sedan',\\n                '中大型轿车': 'sedan',\\n                '豪华suv': 'suv',\\n                '紧凑型suv': 'suv',\\n                '中大型suv': 'suv',\\n                '中型suv': 'suv',\\n                '轿车': 'sedan',\\n                'SUV': 'suv',\\n                'suv': 'suv',\\n                'SUV/越野': 'suv',\\n                '两厢车': 'hatchback',\\n                '三厢车': 'sedan',\\n                '跑车': 'coupe',\\n                '敞篷车': 'convertible',\\n                '旅行车': 'wagon',\\n                '皮卡': 'pickup',\\n                '面包车': 'van',\\n                'MPV': 'mpv',\\n                'mpv': 'mpv',\\n              };\\n              // 检查是否包含关键词\\n              if (category.includes('SUV') || category.includes('suv') || category.includes('越野')) {\\n                category = 'suv';\\n              } else if (category.includes('轿车')) {\\n                category = 'sedan';\\n              } else {\\n                category = categoryMap[category] || categoryMap[categoryLower] || null;\\n              }\\n              if (!category) {\\n                logger.debug(&amp;#96;车型 ${carModel.name} 的 category 值 \\\"${carModel.category}\\\" 不符合约束，设为 null&amp;#96;);\\n                category = null;\\n              }\\n            } else {\\n              category = categoryLower;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          if (existing &amp;amp;&amp;amp; existing.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n            const existingId = existing[0].id;\\n            //                 {
                  "lineNumber": 169845,
                  "content": "&lt;div&gt;基本信息 技术领域 智能化 技术IP 未关联技术IP 创建时间 2025/11/28 更新时间 2025/12/08 描述 原理：依托星睿智算中心与火山引擎边缘节点构建云端算力底座，利用实时音视频推流技术（1080P/60帧）、网络波动摆尾技术及云端热更新机制，将计算负载转移至云端，终端仅负责显示与交互。 价值：解决传统车机算力不足、存储受限及应用生态匮乏的痛点，以10万级车型价格实现&lt;/div&gt;  基础信息，与TPD2 基础信息存在差异，有多余的字段&lt;Card title=\"基本信息\" size=\"small\" children=\"[Array]\"&gt;吉利历时4年、投入超180亿元研发的全球首个纯电原创架构，以用户出行体验为核心，构建了硬件层、系统层、生态层三位一体的立体化布局，是全球最高效的智能电动汽车解决方案。 [1][2] 原理：采用'硬件层+系统层+生态层'三位一体架构。硬件层通过1800-3300mm的超大带宽实现全尺寸覆盖；系统层首发SEA OS整车智能开发系统；生态层向全球开发者开放，实现全场景、全生命周期的体验进化。 [1][&lt;/Card&gt;"
                },

                  "lineNumber": 169885,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';\\nimport {\\n  Modal,\\n  Card,\\n  Descriptions,\\n  Tag,\\n  Space,\\n  Button,\\n  Empty,\\n  Spin,\\n  Typography,\\n  Divider,\\n  List,\\n  Row,\\n  Col,\\n  Image,\\n  Dropdown,\\n  message,\\n} from 'antd';\\nimport {\\n  BookOutlined,\\n  CarOutlined,\\n  CalendarOutlined,\\n  PlusOutlined,\\n  FileImageOutlined,\\n  FileOutlined,\\n  VideoCameraOutlined,\\n  DownloadOutlined,\\n} from '@ant-design/icons';\\nimport type { MenuProps } from 'antd';\\nimport { TechPoint } from '../../types/techPoint';\\nimport { techPointService } from '../../services/techPointService';\\nimport { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../../config/tpd';\\nimport dayjs from 'dayjs';\\nimport jsPDF from 'jspdf';\\nimport html2canvas from 'html2canvas';\\n\\nconst { Text } = Typography;\\n\\ninterface TechPointDetailProps {\\n  techPoint: TechPoint;\\n  onClose: () =&amp;gt; = ({\\n  techPoint,\\n  onClose,\\n  onRefresh,\\n}) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const [currentTechPoint, setCurrentTechPoint] = useState&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;(techPoint);\\n  const [associatedContent, setAssociatedContent] = useState&amp;lt;AssociatedContent&amp;gt;({\\n    packagingMaterials: [],\\n    promotionStrategies: [],\\n    pressReleases: [],\\n    speeches: [],\\n    resources: [],\\n  });\\n  const [associatedCarModels, setAssociatedCarModels] = useState&amp;lt;any[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [associatedResources, setAssociatedResources] = useState&amp;lt;any[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [error, setError] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [technologyName, setTechnologyName] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [categoryName, setCategoryName] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);\\n  const detailContentRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentTechPoint(techPoint);\\n    fetchTechPointData();\\n  }, [techPoint.id, techPoint.technology_id, techPoint.category_id]);\\n\\n  const fetchTechPointData = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPointById(techPoint.id);\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setCurrentTechPoint(response.data);\\n        await Promise.all([fetchAssociatedData(), fetchTechnologyInfo(), fetchCategoryInfo()]);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('重新加载技术点数据失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    fetchAssociatedData();\\n    fetchTechnologyInfo();\\n    fetchCategoryInfo();\\n  }, [currentTechPoint.id, currentTechPoint.technology_id, currentTechPoint.category_id]);\\n\\n  const fetchTechnologyInfo = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    const techId = currentTechPoint.technology_id;\\n    if (!techId) {\\n      setTechnologyName(null);\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 尝试从 TPD2 API 获取技术IP信息\\n      const response = await fetch(&amp;#96;${TPD_API_BASE_URL}/technologies/${techId}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.ok) {\\n        const data = await response.json();\\n        if (data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; data.data) {\\n          setTechnologyName(data.data.name);\\n          return;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('从 TPD2 获取技术IP信息失败，尝试本地API:', error);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果 TPD2 API 失败，尝试本地 API（如果存在）\\n    try {\\n      const response = await fetch(&amp;#96;/api/v1/technologies/${techId}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.ok) {\\n        const data = await response.json();\\n        if (data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; data.data) {\\n          setTechnologyName(data.data.name);\\n          return;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('从本地API获取技术IP信息失败:', error);\\n    }\\n\\n    setTechnologyName(null);\\n  };\\n\\n  const fetchCategoryInfo = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    const categoryId = currentTechPoint.category_id;\\n    if (!categoryId) {\\n      setCategoryName(null);\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    try {\\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechCategories();\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        // 确保 data 是数组\\n        const categories = Array.isArray(response.data) \\n          ? response.data \\n          : [];\\n        const category = categories.find((cat: any) =&amp;gt; cat.id === categoryId);\\n        setCategoryName(category ? category.name : null);\\n      } else {\\n        setCategoryName(null);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取技术领域信息失败:', error);\\n      setCategoryName(null);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const parsedDescription = useMemo&amp;lt;ParsedDescription&amp;gt;(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const result: ParsedDescription = {\\n      principle: '',\\n      value: '',\\n      boundary: '',\\n      highlights: [],\\n      evidenceMeasured: [],\\n      evidenceCertified: [],\\n      evidenceComparison: [],\\n    };\\n\\n    if (!currentTechPoint.description) return result;\\n\\n    // 首先尝试从 technical_details JSON 中读取（如果有的话）\\n    if (currentTechPoint.technical_details) {\\n      try {\\n        const techDetails = typeof currentTechPoint.technical_details === 'string'\\n          ? JSON.parse(currentTechPoint.technical_details)\\n          : currentTechPoint.technical_details;\\n        \\n        if (techDetails.tech_principle) {\\n          result.principle = typeof techDetails.tech_principle === 'string' \\n            ? techDetails.tech_principle \\n            : JSON.stringify(techDetails.tech_principle);\\n        }\\n        if (techDetails.tech_value) {\\n          result.value = typeof techDetails.tech_value === 'string'\\n            ? techDetails.tech_value\\n            : JSON.stringify(techDetails.tech_value);\","

                  "lineNumber": 32416,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      total: 0,\\n      created: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n\\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\\n      let page = 1;\\n      const pageSize = 100;\\n      let hasMore = true;\\n\\n      while (hasMore) {\\n        try {\\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\\n          const response = await axios.get(&amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&amp;#96;, {\\n            params: {\\n              page,\\n              pageSize,\\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\\n            },\\n            timeout: 30000,\\n          });\\n\\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\\n\\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\\n\\n          // 处理每个技术点\\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\\n            try {\\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\\n              if (result.created) {\\n                stats.created++;\\n              } else {\\n                stats.updated++;\\n              }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n              logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n              stats.errors++;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\\n          if (techPoints.length &amp;lt; pageSize) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n          } else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      }\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export const techPointService = {\\n,\\n\\n  // 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\\n  async syncFromTPD(): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;{\\n    total: number;\\n    created: number;\\n    updated: number;\\n    errors: number;\\n  }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post(&amp;#96;${TECH_POINT_BASE_URL}/sync&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nexport default techPointService;\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 33426,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../config/tpd';\\nimport {\\n  TechPoint,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  PaginatedResponse,\\n  TechPointSearchParams,\\n} from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 项目技术点服务\\n * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\\n */\\nclass TPDTechPointService {\\n  private client: AxiosInstance;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    this.client = axios.create({\\n      baseURL: TPD_API_BASE_URL,\\n      timeout: 30000,\\n      headers: {\\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\\n      },\\n    });\\n\\n    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\\n      (response) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\\n        // todify3 期望格式: { success: true, data: {...} }\\n        if (response.data &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.code === 200) {\\n          return {\\n            ...response,\\n            data: {\\n              success: true,\\n              data: response.data.data,\\n              message: response.data.message,\\n            },\\n          };\\n        }\\n        return response;\\n      },\\n      (error) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // 错误响应格式转换\\n        if (error.response &amp;amp;&amp;amp; error.response.data) {\\n          const tpdError = error.response.data;\\n          return Promise.reject({\\n            ...error,\\n            response: {\\n              ...error.response,\\n              data: {\\n                success: false,\\n                error: tpdError.message || '请求失败',\\n                code: tpdError.code,\\n              },\\n            },\\n          });\\n        }\\n        return Promise.reject(error);\\n      }\\n    );\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 12628,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class TPDTechPointService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n  async getTechPoints(\\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\\n      const queryParams: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {};\\n\\n      if (params?.page) {\\n        queryParams.page = params.page.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.pageSize) {\\n        queryParams.pageSize = params.pageSize.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.keyword) {\\n        queryParams.keyword = params.keyword;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.category_id) {\\n        queryParams.category_id = params.category_id.toString();\\n      }\\n      if (params?.status) {\\n        queryParams.status = params.status;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.type) {\\n        queryParams.tech_type = params.type;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.priority) {\\n        queryParams.priority = params.priority;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortBy) {\\n        queryParams.orderBy = params.sortBy;\\n      }\\n      if (params?.sortOrder) {\\n        queryParams.orderDirection = params.sortOrder.toUpperCase();\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await this.client.get('/tech-points', {\\n        params: queryParams,\\n      });\\n\\n      // 响应已经被拦截器转换，现在格式是 { success: true, data: {...} }\\n      const responseData = response.data;\\n\\n      if (responseData.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; responseData.data)\\n  }\\n}\","
