                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"async getTechPoints(\\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n\\n\\n      if (responseData.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; responseData.data) {\\n        // TPD2 返回的 data 格式: { data: [], total: number, page: number, pageSize: number, totalPages: number }\\n        // 确保返回格式符合 PaginatedResponse\\n        const paginatedData = responseData.data;\\n        const dataArray = paginatedData.data || [];\\n        const total = paginatedData.total || 0;\\n        const page = paginatedData.page || 1;\\n        const pageSize = paginatedData.pageSize || 20;\\n        const totalPages = paginatedData.totalPages || Math.ceil(total / pageSize);\\n        \\n        return {\\n          success: true,\\n          data: {\\n            data: dataArray,\\n            items: dataArray, // 兼容性：某些地方可能使用 items\\n            total,\\n            page,\\n            pageSize,\\n            totalPages,\\n          },\\n          message: responseData.message,\\n        };\\n      }\\n\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: responseData.error || '获取技术点列表失败',\\n      };\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      console.error('获取技术点列表失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error:\\n          error.response?.data?.error ||\\n          error.message ||\\n          '获取技术点列表失败',\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n// 导出单例实例\\nexport const tpdTechPointService = new TPDTechPointService();\","

                  "lineNumber": 13744,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      total: 0,\\n      created: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n\\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\\n      let page = 1;\\n      const pageSize = 100;\\n      let hasMore = true;\\n\\n      while (hasMore) {\\n        try {\\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\\n          const response = await axios.get(&amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&amp;#96;, {\\n            params: {\\n              page,\\n              pageSize,\\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\\n            },\\n            timeout: 30000,\\n          });\\n\\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\\n\\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\\n\\n          // 处理每个技术点\\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\\n            try {\\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\\n              if (result.created) {\\n                stats.created++;\\n              } else {\\n                stats.updated++;\\n              }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n              logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n              stats.errors++;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\\n          if (techPoints.length &amp;lt; pageSize) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n          } else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      }\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../config/tpd';\\nimport {\\n  TechPoint,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  PaginatedResponse,\\n  TechPointSearchParams,\\n} from '../types/techPoint';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 项目技术点服务\\n * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\\n */\\nclass TPDTechPointService {\\n  private client: AxiosInstance;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    this.client = axios.create({\\n      baseURL: TPD_API_BASE_URL,\\n      timeout: 30000,\\n      headers: {\\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\\n      },\\n    });\\n\\n    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\\n      (response) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\\n        // todify3 期望格式: { success: true, data: {...} }\\n        if (response.data &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.code === 200) {\\n          return {\\n            ...response,\\n            data: {\\n              success: true,\\n              data: response.data.data,\\n              message: response.data.message,\\n            },\\n          };\\n        }\\n        return response;\\n      },\\n      (error) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // 错误响应格式转换\\n        if (error.response &amp;amp;&amp;amp; error.response.data) {\\n          const tpdError = error.response.data;\\n          return Promise.reject({\\n            ...error,\\n            response: {\\n              ...error.response,\\n              data: {\\n                success: false,\\n                error: tpdError.message || '请求失败',\\n                code: tpdError.code,\\n              },\\n            },\\n          });\\n        }\\n        return Promise.reject(error);\\n      }\\n    );\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点列表\\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\\n   */\\n}\","

{
  "contents": "import axios from 'axios';\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\n\n/**\n * TPD2 同步服务\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\n */\nexport class TPDSyncService {\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\n\n  constructor() {\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n          stats.errors++;\n          hasMore = false;\n        }\n      }\n\n      logger.info('TPD2 技术点数据同步完成', stats);\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        message: &#96;同步完成：总计 ${stats.total} 条，新增 ${stats.created} 条，更新 ${stats.updated} 条，错误 ${stats.errors} 条&#96;,\n        stats,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败',\n        stats,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 同步单个技术点\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{created: boolean}&gt;} 返回是否为新创建\n   */\n  private async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 获取技术点详情（包含关联数据）\n      const detailResponse = await axios.get(\n        &#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${tpdTechPoint.id}&#96;,\n        {\n          params: {\n            includeAssociations: true,\n          },\n          timeout: 30000,\n        }\n      );\n\n      if (detailResponse.data.code !== 200 || !detailResponse.data.data) {\n        throw new Error('获取技术点详情失败');\n      }\n\n      const techPointDetail = detailResponse.data.data;\n\n      // 准备技术点数据\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\n      };\n\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称查找，因为 ID 可能不同）\n      // 首先尝试通过 ID 查找\n      let existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&#96;);\n      }\n\n      return { created };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&#96;, error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射技术点类型\n   */\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\n    const typeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE,\n      technology: TechType.TECHNOLOGY,\n      innovation: TechType.INNOVATION,\n      improvement: TechType.IMPROVEMENT,\n    };\n    return typeMap[tpdType] || TechType.FEATURE;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射优先级\n   */\n  private mapPriority(tpdPriority: string): Priority {\n    const priorityMap: Record&lt;string, Priority&gt; = {\n      low: Priority.LOW,\n      medium: Priority.MEDIUM,\n      high: Priority.HIGH,\n      critical: Priority.CRITICAL,\n    };\n    return priorityMap[tpdPriority] || Priority.MEDIUM;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射状态\n   */\n  private mapStatus(tpdStatus: string): Status {\n    const statusMap: Record&lt;string, Status&gt; = {\n      active: Status.ACTIVE,\n      inactive: Status.INACTIVE,\n      draft: Status.DRAFT,\n      archived: Status.ARCHIVED,\n    };\n    return statusMap[tpdStatus] || Status.DRAFT;\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例实例\nexport const tpdSyncService = new TPDSyncService();\n\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 241
}

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找车型\n   */\n  async findById(id: number, includeBrand: boolean = true): Promise&lt;CarModel&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM car_models WHERE id = ?';\n    \n    if (includeBrand) {\n      sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        WHERE cm.id = ?\n      &#96;;\n    }\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [result];\n      \n      if (carModels.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('车型不存在');\n      }\n      \n      const carModel = carModels[0] as any;\n      \n      if (includeBrand &amp;&amp; carModel.brand_name) {\n        return {\n          ...carModel,\n          brand: {\n            id: carModel.brand_id,\n            name: carModel.brand_name,\n            name_en: carModel.brand_name_en\n          }\n        } as CarModel;\n      }\n      \n      return carModel as CarModel;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查找车型失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查找车型失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车型\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车型\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const {\n      limit = 50,\n      offset = 0,\n      orderBy = 'created_at',\n      orderDirection = 'DESC',\n      includeBrand = true\n    } = options;\n\n    // 构建WHERE条件\n    let whereClause = '';\n    let whereParams: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (options.where) {\n      const conditions: string[] = [];\n      \n      if (options.where.name) {\n        conditions.push('cm.name LIKE ?');\n        whereParams.push(&#96;%${options.where.name}%&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.brand_id) {\n        conditions.push('cm.brand_id = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.brand_id);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.status) {\n        conditions.push('cm.status = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.status);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.category) {\n        conditions.push('cm.category = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.category);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.launch_year) {\n        conditions.push('cm.launch_year = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.launch_year);\n      }\n      \n      if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n        whereClause = 'WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 查询总数\n    const countSql = &#96;SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM car_models cm ${whereClause}&#96;;\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, whereParams);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].total : countResult.total;\n\n    // 查询数据\n    let sql = &#96;\n      SELECT cm.* FROM car_models cm\n      ${whereClause}\n      ORDER BY cm.${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    if (includeBrand)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 3. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  NOW(),\n  NOW()\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != ''\nON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW();\n\n-- 4. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nRENAME TABLE car_models TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 5. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\n-- 创建数据库\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\nUSE todify3;\n\n-- 1. 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 2. 车型车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\n);\n\n-- 3. 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",

        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本 (SQLite版本)\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  logo_url TEXT,\n  country TEXT,\n  founded_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 创建更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS brands_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON brands\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE brands SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 3. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 4. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT OR IGNORE INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  datetime('now'),\n  datetime('now')\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != '';\n\n-- 5. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nALTER TABLE car_models RENAME TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n  launch_year INTEGER,\n  end_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 7. 创建车型表更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS car_models_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON car_models\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE car_models SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 8. 创建车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);",

        "contents": "  END;\n\n-- 8. 创建车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_status ON car_models(status);\n\n-- 9. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  generation TEXT,\n  launch_year INTEGER,\n  end_year INTEGER,\n  market_segment TEXT CHECK (market_segment IN ('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium')),\n  body_style TEXT,\n  engine_types TEXT, -- JSON格式存储\n  fuel_types TEXT,   -- JSON格式存储\n  description TEXT,\n  metadata TEXT,     -- JSON格式存储\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 10. 创建车系表更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS car_series_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON car_series\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE car_series SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 11. 创建车系表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_model_id ON car_series(model_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_status ON car_series(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_market_segment ON car_series(market_segment);\n\n-- 12. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车型记录\n-- 这里假设原有的 series 字段实际上是车型名称\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  b.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.series, '未知车型'),\n  '从原有数据迁移',\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.status = 'active' THEN 'active'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'discontinued' THEN 'discontinued'\n    ELSE 'active'\n  END,\n  cst.created_at,\n  cst.updated_at\nFROM car_series_temp cst\nJOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\nWHERE cst.series IS NOT NULL AND cst.series != '';\n\n-- 13. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车系记录",

        "contents": "# 三层级车系架构设计\n\n## 概述\n将原有的两层级结构（品牌-车系）调整为三层级结构（品牌-车型-车系），以更好地反映汽车行业的实际层级关系。\n\n## 层级关系\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n品牌 (Brand)\n├── 车型 (Model) \n    ├── 车系 (Series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据库设计\n\n### 1. 品牌表 (brands)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 车型表 (car_models)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建车系\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateCarSeriesDTO): Promise&lt;CarSeries&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    // 验证车型是否存在\n    const modelCheckSql = 'SELECT id FROM car_models WHERE id = ?';\n    const modelResult = await this.db.query(modelCheckSql, [data.model_id]);\n    const models = Array.isArray(modelResult) ? modelResult : modelResult.rows || [modelResult];\n    \n    if (models.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('指定的车型不存在');\n    }\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO car_series (model_id, name, name_en, description, launch_year, end_year, market_segment, status, metadata)\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [\n      data.model_id,\n      data.name,\n      data.name_en || null,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.launch_year || null,\n      data.end_year || null,\n      data.market_segment || null,\n      data.status || CarSeriesStatus.ACTIVE,\n      data.metadata ? JSON.stringify(data.metadata) : null\n    ];\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n      const insertId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n      \n      return await this.findById(insertId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('创建车系失败:', error);\n      if (error.message?.includes('UNIQUE constraint failed')) {\n        throw new Error('车系名称已存在');\n      }\n      throw new Error('创建车系失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找车系\n   */\n  async findById(id: number, includeModel: boolean = true, includeBrand: boolean = true): Promise&lt;CarSeries&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新车型\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateCarModelDTO): Promise&lt;CarModel&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    // 如果更新品牌ID，验证品牌是否存在\n    if (data.brand_id) {\n      const brandCheckSql = 'SELECT id FROM brands WHERE id = ?';\n      const brandResult = await this.db.query(brandCheckSql, [data.brand_id]);\n      const brands = Array.isArray(brandResult) ? brandResult : brandResult.rows || [brandResult];\n      \n      if (brands.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('指定的品牌不存在');\n      }\n    }\n    \n    const updates: string[] = [];\n    const params: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (data.brand_id !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('brand_id = ?');\n      params.push(data.brand_id);\n    }\n    \n    if (data.name !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('name = ?');\n      params.push(data.name);\n    }\n    \n    if (data.name_en !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('name_en = ?');\n      params.push(data.name_en);\n    }\n    \n    if (data.category !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('category = ?');\n      params.push(data.category);\n    }\n    \n    if (data.launch_year !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('launch_year = ?');\n      params.push(data.launch_year);\n    }\n    \n    if (data.end_year !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('end_year = ?');\n      params.push(data.end_year);\n    }\n    \n    if (data.description !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('description = ?');\n      params.push(data.description);\n    }\n    \n    if (data.status !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('status = ?');\n      params.push(data.status);\n    }\n    \n    if (updates.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('没有要更新的数据');\n    }\n    \n    updates.push('updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');\n    params.push(id);\n    \n    const sql = &#96;UPDATE car_models SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?&#96;;\n    \n    try {\n      await this.db.query(sql, params);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 6. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  generation VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '世代信息',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  market_segment ENUM('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium') COMMENT '市场定位',\n  body_style VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '车身样式',\n  engine_types JSON COMMENT '发动机类型',\n  fuel_types JSON COMMENT '燃料类型',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车系描述',\n  metadata JSON COMMENT '额外信息',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_model_id (model_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status),\n  INDEX idx_market_segment (market_segment)\n);\n\n-- 7. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车型记录\n-- 这里假设原有的 series 字段实际上是车型名称\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  b.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.series, '未知车型'),\n  '从原有数据迁移',\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.status = 'active' THEN 'active'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'discontinued' THEN 'discontinued'\n    ELSE 'active'\n  END,\n  cst.created_at,\n  cst.updated_at\nFROM car_series_temp cst\nJOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\nWHERE cst.series IS NOT NULL AND cst.series != '';\n\n-- 8. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车系记录\nINSERT INTO car_series (\n  model_id, \n  name, \n  launch_year, \n  end_year, \n  market_segment,\n  description, \n  metadata, \n  status, \n  created_at, \n  updated_at\n)\nSELECT \n  cm.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.model, CONCAT(cst.series, ' 基础版')),",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取车型统计信息\n   */\n  async getStats(): Promise&lt;{\n    total: number;\n    byStatus: Record&lt;string, number&gt;;\n    byCategory: Record&lt;string, number&gt;;\n    byBrand: Record&lt;string, number&gt;;\n  }&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    try {\n      // 总数统计\n      const totalResult = await this.db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM car_models');\n      const total = Array.isArray(totalResult) ? totalResult[0].total : totalResult.total;\n      \n      // 按状态统计\n      const statusResult = await this.db.query(&#96;\n        SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count \n        FROM car_models \n        GROUP BY status\n      &#96;);\n      const statusRows = Array.isArray(statusResult) ? statusResult : statusResult.rows || [];\n      const byStatus: Record&lt;string, number&gt; = {};\n      statusRows.forEach((row: any) =&gt; {\n        byStatus[row.status] = row.count;\n      });\n      \n      // 按类别统计\n      const categoryResult = await this.db.query(&#96;\n        SELECT category, COUNT(*) as count \n        FROM car_models \n        WHERE category IS NOT NULL \n        GROUP BY category\n      &#96;);\n      const categoryRows = Array.isArray(categoryResult) ? categoryResult : categoryResult.rows || [];\n      const byCategory: Record&lt;string, number&gt; = {};\n      categoryRows.forEach((row: any) =&gt; {\n        byCategory[row.category] = row.count;\n      });\n      \n      // 按品牌统计\n      const brandResult = await this.db.query(&#96;\n        SELECT b.name, COUNT(*) as count \n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        GROUP BY cm.brand_id, b.name\n      &#96;);\n      const brandRows = Array.isArray(brandResult) ? brandResult : brandResult.rows || [];\n      const byBrand: Record&lt;string, number&gt; = {};\n      brandRows.forEach((row: any) =&gt; {\n        byBrand[row.name] = row.count;\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        total,\n        byStatus,\n        byCategory,\n        byBrand\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车型统计信息失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车型统计信息失败');\n    }\n  }\n}",

{\\\\n    const searchOptions = {\\\\n      ...options,\\\\n      where: {\\\\n        ...options.where,\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    let sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\\\n      WHERE (name LIKE ?                   "lineNumber": 24464,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TechCategoryModel {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有技术分类\\n   */\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories';\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\n\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\n    if (options.where) {\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n        conditions.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 添加排序\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;#96;;\\n    } else {\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC';\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取总数\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\n\\n    // 添加分页\\n    if (options.limit) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;#96;;\\n      if (options.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    \\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\n    const page = options.offset ?                   "lineNumber": 27875,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import axios from 'axios';\\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 同步服务\\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\\n */\\nexport class TPDSyncService {\\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n}\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 72270,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import axios from 'axios';\\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 同步服务\\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\\n */\\nexport class TPDSyncService {\\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    message: string;\\n    stats: {\\n      total: number;\\n      created: number;\\n      updated: number;\\n      errors: number;\\n    };\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    const stats = {\\n      total: 0,\\n      created: 0,\\n      updated: 0,\\n      errors: 0,\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\\n\\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\\n      let page = 1;\\n      const pageSize = 100;\\n      let hasMore = true;\\n\\n      while (hasMore) {\\n        try {\\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\\n          const response = await axios.get(&amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&amp;#96;, {\\n            params: {\\n              page,\\n              pageSize,\\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\\n            },\\n            timeout: 30000,\\n          });\\n\\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\\n\\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n\\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\\n\\n          // 处理每个技术点\\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\\n            try {\\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\\n              if (result.created) {\\n                stats.created++;\\n              } else {\\n                stats.updated++;\\n              }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n              logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&amp;#96;, error);\\n              stats.errors++;\\n            }\\n          }\\n\\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\\n          if (techPoints.length &amp;lt; pageSize) {\\n            hasMore = false;\\n          } else {\\n            page++;\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          logger.error(&amp;#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n          stats.errors++;\\n          hasMore = false;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('TPD2 技术点数据同步完成', stats);\\n\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n        message: &amp;#96;同步完成：总计 ${stats.total} 条，新增 ${stats.created} 条，更新 ${stats.updated} 条，错误 ${stats.errors} 条&amp;#96;,\\n        stats,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败',\\n        stats,\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步单个技术点\\n   * @returns {Promise&amp;lt;{created: boolean}&amp;gt;} 返回是否为新创建\\n   */\\n  private async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&amp;lt;{ created: boolean }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 获取技术点详情（包含关联数据）\\n      const detailResponse = await axios.get(\\n        &amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${tpdTechPoint.id}&amp;#96;,\\n        {\\n          params: {\\n            includeAssociations: true,\\n          },\\n          timeout: 30000,\\n        }\\n      );\\n\\n      if (detailResponse.data.code !== 200 || !detailResponse.data.data) {\\n        throw new Error('获取技术点详情失败');\\n      }\\n\\n      const techPointDetail = detailResponse.data.data;\\n\\n      // 准备技术点数据\\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\\n      };\\n\\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称查找，因为 ID 可能不同）\\n      // 首先尝试通过 ID 查找\\n      let existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\\n      \\n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\\n      if (!existing) {\\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&amp;gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\\n      }\\n\\n      let created = false;\\n      if (existing) {\\n        // 更新现有技术点\\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\\n        created = false;\\n      } else {\\n        // 创建新技术点\\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\\n        created = true;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;amp;&amp;amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\\n        logger.debug(&amp;#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n\\n      return { created };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error(&amp;#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 映射技术点类型\\n   */\\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\\n    const typeMap: Record&amp;lt;string, TechType&amp;gt; = {\\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE,\\n      technology: TechType.TECHNOLOGY,\\n      innovation: TechType.INNOVATION,\\n      improvement: TechType.IMPROVEMENT,\\n    };\\n    return typeMap[tpdType] || TechType.FEATURE;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 映射优先级\\n   */\\n  private mapPriority(tpdPriority: string): Priority {\\n    const priorityMap: Record&amp;lt;string, Priority&amp;gt; = {\\n      low: Priority.LOW,\\n      medium: Priority.MEDIUM,\\n      high: Priority.HIGH,\\n      critical: Priority.CRITICAL,\\n    };\\n    return priorityMap[tpdPriority] || Priority.MEDIUM;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 映射状态\\n   */\\n  private mapStatus(tpdStatus: string): Status {\\n    const statusMap: Record&amp;lt;string, Status&amp;gt; = {\\n      active: Status.ACTIVE,\\n      inactive: Status.INACTIVE,\\n      draft: Status.DRAFT,\\n      archived: Status.ARCHIVED,\\n    };\\n    return statusMap[tpdStatus] || Status.DRAFT;\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n// 导出单例实例\\nexport const tpdSyncService = new TPDSyncService();\\n\\n\","
                },

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import axios from 'axios';\\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\n\\n/**\\n * TPD2 同步服务\\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\\n */\\nexport class TPDSyncService {\\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步技术点数据\\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\\n   */\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 147135,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TechCategoryController {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术分类详情\\n   */\\n  async getById(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.findById(id);\\n      if (!category) {\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: category\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Get tech category error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '获取技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术分类列表\\n   */\\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 152328,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TechCategoryModel {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除技术分类（软删除）\\n   */\\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.INACTIVE, id]);\\n    return result.affectedRows &amp;gt; 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 物理删除技术分类\\n   */\\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\\\\nimport { \\\\n  TechCategory, \\\\n  CreateTechCategoryDTO, \\\\n  UpdateTechCategoryDTO, \\\\n  QueryOptions, \\\\n  PaginatedResult,\\\\n  Status \\\\n} from '../types/database';\\\\n\\\\nexport class TechCategoryModel {\\\\n  private db: DatabaseManager;\\\\n\\\\n  constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {\\\\n    this.db = db;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 创建技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async create(data: CreateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      INSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, parent_id, level, sort_order, status)\\\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\\\n      RETURNING *\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const values = [\\\\n      data.name,\\\\n      data.description || null,\\\\n      data.parent_id || null,\\\\n      data.level || 1,\\\\n      data.sort_order || 0,\\\\n      data.status || Status.ACTIVE\\\\n    ];\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result[0] as TechCategory;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 根据ID获取技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories WHERE id = ?';\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\\\n    return result.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取所有技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories';\\\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\\\n    if (options.where) {\\\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        conditions.push(&amp;amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        values.push(value);\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加排序\\\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC';\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 获取总数\\\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加分页\\\\n    if (options.limit) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      if (options.offset) {\\\\n        sql += &amp;amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    \\\\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      data: result as TechCategory[],\\\\n      total,\\\\n      page,\\\\n      pageSize,\\\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 根据父级ID获取子分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async findByParentId(parentId: number | null, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const whereCondition = parentId === null ? 'parent_id IS NULL' : 'parent_id = ?';\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\\\n      WHERE ${whereCondition} AND status = ?\\\\n      ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const values = parentId === null ? [Status.ACTIVE] : [parentId, Status.ACTIVE];\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result as TechCategory[];\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取分类树结构\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getTree(): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\\\n      WHERE status = ? \\\\n      ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, name ASC\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ACTIVE]);\\\\n    const categories = result as TechCategory[];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 构建树结构\\\\n    const categoryMap = new Map&amp;amp;lt;number, TechCategory &amp;amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] }&amp;amp;gt;();\\\\n    const rootCategories: (TechCategory &amp;amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] })[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 初始化所有分类\\\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      categoryMap.set(category.id, { ...category, children: [] });\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    // 构建父子关系\\\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      const categoryWithChildren = categoryMap.get(category.id)!;\\\\n      \\\\n      if (category.parent_id === null) {\\\\n        rootCategories.push(categoryWithChildren);\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        const parent = categoryMap.get(category.parent_id!);\\\\n        if (parent) {\\\\n          parent.children!.push(categoryWithChildren);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return rootCategories;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 更新技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const fields: string[] = [];\\\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (value !== undefined) {\\\\n        fields.push(&amp;amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        values.push(value);\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\\\\n      return this.findById(id);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    values.push(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\\\n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n      WHERE id = ?\\\\n      RETURNING *\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    return result.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 删除技术分类（软删除）\\\\n   */\\\\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\\\n    if (children.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\\\n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n      WHERE id = ?\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.INACTIVE, id]);\\\\n    return result.affectedRows &amp;amp;gt; 0;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 物理删除技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\\\n    if (children.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const sql = 'DELETE FROM tech_categories WHERE id = ?';\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\\\n    return result.affectedRows &amp;amp;gt; 0;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 搜索技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async search(keyword: string, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const searchOptions = {\\\\n      ...options,\\\\n      where: {\\\\n        ...options.where,\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    let sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\\\n      WHERE (name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?) AND status = ?\\\\n    &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    \\\\n    const searchTerm = &amp;amp;#96;%${keyword}%&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    const values = [searchTerm, searchTerm, Status.ACTIVE];\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加额外的WHERE条件\\\\n    if (options.where) {\\\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if (key !== 'name' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; key !== 'description') {\\\\n          sql += &amp;amp;#96; AND ${key} = ?&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n          values.push(value);\\\\n        }\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加排序\\\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC';\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 获取总数\\\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\\\n\\\\n    // 添加分页\\\\n    if (options.limit) {\\\\n      sql += &amp;amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      if (options.offset) {\\\\n        sql += &amp;amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\\\n    \\\\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      data: result as TechCategory[],\\\\n      total,\\\\n      page,\\\\n      pageSize,\\\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 批量更新排序\\\\n   */\\\\n  async updateSortOrder(updates: { id: number; sort_order: number }[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const transaction = await this.db.transaction();\\\\n    \\\\n    try {\\\\n      for (const update of updates) {\\\\n        const sql = &amp;amp;#96;\\\\n          UPDATE tech_categories \\\\n          SET sort_order = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n          WHERE id = ?\\\\n        &amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n        await transaction.query(sql, [update.sort_order, update.id]);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      await transaction.commit();\\\\n      return true;\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      await transaction.rollback();\\\\n      throw error;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\",\""

error.message : '创建技术分类失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术分类详情\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getById(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.findById(id);\\\\n      if (!category) {\\\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: category\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Get tech category error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: '获取技术分类失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术分类列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const {\\\\n        page = 1,\\\\n        pageSize = 20,\\\\n        orderBy = 'sort_order',\\\\n        orderDirection = 'ASC',\\\\n        status,\\\\n        parent_id\\\\n      } = req.query;\\\\n\\\\n      const options = {\\\\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\\\\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\\\\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\\\\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\\\\n        where: {} as any\\\\n      };\\\\n\\\\n      if (status) {\\\\n        options.where.status = status;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      if (parent_id !== undefined) {\\\\n        options.where.parent_id = parent_id === 'null' ? null : parseInt(parent_id as string);\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const result = await techCategoryModel.findAll(options);\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: result\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Get tech categories error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: '获取技术分类列表失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术分类树结构\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getTree(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const tree = await techCategoryModel.getTree();\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: tree\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Get tech category tree error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: '获取技术分类树失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 更新技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async update(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO = req.body;\\\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.update(id, data);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (!category) {\\\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: category,\\\\n        message: '技术分类更新成功'\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Update tech category error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新技术分类失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 删除技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async delete(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const success = await techCategoryModel.delete(id);\\\\n      if (!success) {\\\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        message: '技术分类删除成功'\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Delete tech category error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: error instanceof Error ?                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\\nimport { \\n  TechCategory, \\n  CreateTechCategoryDTO, \\n  UpdateTechCategoryDTO, \\n  QueryOptions, \\n  PaginatedResult,\\n  Status \\n} from '../types/database';\\n\\nexport class TechCategoryModel {\\n  private db: DatabaseManager;\\n\\n  constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {\\n    this.db = db;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建技术分类\\n   */\\n  async create(data: CreateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      INSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, parent_id, level, sort_order, status)\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [\\n      data.name,\\n      data.description || null,\\n      data.parent_id || null,\\n      data.level || 1,\\n      data.sort_order || 0,\\n      data.status || Status.ACTIVE\\n    ];\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result[0] as TechCategory;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据ID获取技术分类\\n   */\\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory | null&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories WHERE id = ?';\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有技术分类\\n   */\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories';\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\n\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\n    if (options.where) {\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n        conditions.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 添加排序\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;#96;;\\n    } else {\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC';\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取总数\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\n\\n    // 添加分页\\n    if (options.limit) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;#96;;\\n      if (options.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    \\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\n    \\n    return {\\n      data: result as TechCategory[],\\n      total,\\n      page,\\n      pageSize,\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据父级ID获取子分类\\n   */\\n  async findByParentId(parentId: number | null, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const whereCondition = parentId === null ? 'parent_id IS NULL' : 'parent_id = ?';\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\n      WHERE ${whereCondition} AND status = ?\\n      ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = parentId === null ? [Status.ACTIVE] : [parentId, Status.ACTIVE];\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result as TechCategory[];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取分类树结构\\n   */\\n  async getTree(): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\n      WHERE status = ? \\n      ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, name ASC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ACTIVE]);\\n    const categories = result as TechCategory[];\\n    \\n    // 构建树结构\\n    const categoryMap = new Map&amp;lt;number, TechCategory &amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] }&amp;gt;();\\n    const rootCategories: (TechCategory &amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] })[] = [];\\n\\n    // 初始化所有分类\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;gt; {\\n      categoryMap.set(category.id, { ...category, children: [] });\\n    });\\n\\n    // 构建父子关系\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;gt; {\\n      const categoryWithChildren = categoryMap.get(category.id)!;\\n      \\n      if (category.parent_id === null) {\\n        rootCategories.push(categoryWithChildren);\\n      } else {\\n        const parent = categoryMap.get(category.parent_id!);\\n        if (parent) {\\n          parent.children!.push(categoryWithChildren);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return rootCategories;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新技术分类\\n   */\\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory | null&amp;gt; {\\n    const fields: string[] = [];\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n\\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (value !== undefined) {\\n        fields.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\\n      return this.findById(id);\\n    }\\n\\n    values.push(id);\\n    \\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除技术分类（软删除）\\n   */\\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;gt; 已创建技术点数据导入功能。总结如下：

## 已创建的文件

1. **`import-tech-points-from-json.ts`** - 从JSON文件导入技术点
2. **`import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts`** - 从TPD2 API导入技术点
3. **`README-IMPORT-TECH-POINTS.md`** - 使用说明文档

## 使用方法

### 方法一：从JSON文件导入（推荐）

如果你有TPD2导出的JSON文件：

```bash
cd backend
npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-json.ts <json文件路径>
```

### 方法二：从TPD2 API导入

如果TPD2项目正在运行：

```bash
cd backend
npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts
```

## 功能特性

- 自动创建技术分类（如果不存在）
- 自动创建品牌和车型（如果不存在）
- 自动关联技术点与车型
- 智能更新：如果技术点已存在（通过名称匹配），会更新而不是创建新记录
- 数据映射：自动映射技术类型、优先级、状态等字段
- 技术详情合并：将 `tech_principle`、`tech_value`、`highlights` 等字段合并到 `technical_details` 中

## 使用建议

1. 先清空现有数据（如需要）：
   ```bash
   npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/clear-tech-points-data.ts
   ```

2. 然后导入数据：
   - 如果有JSON文件，使用方法一
   - 如果TPD2项目正在运行，使用方法二

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport {\n  KnowledgePoint,\n  CreateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  UpdateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  KnowledgePointQueryOptions,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/knowledgePoint';\n\nconst KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL = '/knowledge-points';\n\nexport const knowledgePointService = {\n  // 创建知识点\n  async create(data: CreateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.post(KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options?: KnowledgePointQueryOptions\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const params = {\n      page: options?.page || 1,\n      pageSize: options?.pageSize || 10,\n      orderBy: options?.orderBy || 'created_at',\n      orderDirection: options?.orderDirection || 'DESC'\n    };\n    \n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/tech-point/${techPointId}&#96;, { params });\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点详情\n  async getById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 删除知识点\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  }\n};",

        "contents": "const KnowledgePointManager: React.FC&lt;KnowledgePointManagerProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n\n    try {\n      if (editingPoint) {\n        // 更新知识点\n        const { tech_point_id, id, ...updateData } = formData;\n\n        const response = await knowledgePointService.update(\n          editingPoint.id,\n          updateData as UpdateKnowledgePointFormData,\n        );\n        if (response.success) {\n          await fetchKnowledgePoints();\n          resetForm();\n        }\n      } else {\n        // 创建新知识点\n        const { id, ...createData } = formData;\n        const response = await knowledgePointService.create(\n          createData as CreateKnowledgePointFormData,\n        );\n        if (response.success) {\n          await fetchKnowledgePoints();\n          resetForm();\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(editingPoint ? \"更新知识点失败\" : \"创建知识点失败\");\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleEdit = (point: KnowledgePoint) =&gt; {\n    setEditingPoint(point);\n    setFormData({\n      id: point.id,\n      tech_point_id: point.tech_point_id,\n      title: point.title,\n      content: point.content,\n      knowledge_type: point.knowledge_type,\n      difficulty_level: point.difficulty_level,\n      tags: point.tags || [],\n      prerequisites: point.prerequisites || [],\n      learning_objectives: point.learning_objectives || [],\n      examples: point.examples || [],\n      references: point.references || [],\n      status: point.status,\n    });\n    setShowForm(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm(\"确定要删除这个知识点吗？\")) return;\n\n    try {\n      const response = await knowledgePointService.delete(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        await fetchKnowledgePoints();\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"删除知识点失败\");\n    }\n  };\n\n  const resetForm = () =&gt; {\n    setFormData\n\n;\n;",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 知识点收藏表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_point_favorites (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 技术包装材料表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_packaging_materials (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    material_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh',\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 技术推广策略表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "export class KnowledgePointService {\n\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async updateKnowledgePoint(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointDTO): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n    const updates: string[] = [];\n    const params: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (data.title !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('title = ?');\n      params.push(data.title);\n    }\n    if (data.content !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('content = ?');\n      params.push(data.content);\n    }\n    if (data.knowledge_type !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('knowledge_type = ?');\n      params.push(data.knowledge_type);\n    }\n    if (data.difficulty_level !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('difficulty_level = ?');\n      params.push(data.difficulty_level);\n    }\n    if (data.tags !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('tags = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.tags));\n    }\n    if (data.prerequisites !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('prerequisites = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.prerequisites));\n    }\n    if (data.learning_objectives !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('learning_objectives = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.learning_objectives));\n    }\n    if (data.examples !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('examples = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.examples));\n    }\n    if (data.references !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('references = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.references));\n    }\n    if (data.status !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('status = ?');\n      params.push(data.status);\n    }\n    \n    if (updates.length === 0) {\n      return await this.getKnowledgePointById(id);\n    }\n    \n    updates.push('updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');\n    params.push(id);\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE knowledge_points \n      SET ${updates.join(', ')} \n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    await this.db.query(sql, params);\n    return await this.getKnowledgePointById(id);\n  }\n\n  // 删除知识点\n  async deleteKnowledgePoint(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    const sql =         "contents": "CREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',",
