```json
{
  "contents": "import { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\nimport { \n  KnowledgePoint, \n  CreateKnowledgePointDTO, \n  UpdateKnowledgePointDTO,\n  PaginatedResult,\n  QueryOptions \n} from '../types/database';\n\nexport class KnowledgePointService {\n  private db: DatabaseManager;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.db = new DatabaseManager();\n  }\n\n  // 创建知识点\n  async createKnowledgePoint(data: CreateKnowledgePointDTO): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO knowledge_points (\n        tech_point_id, title, content, knowledge_type, difficulty_level,\n        tags, prerequisites, learning_objectives, examples, references,\n        status, created_by\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [\n      data.tech_point_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.content,\n      data.knowledge_type,\n      data.difficulty_level,\n      JSON.stringify(data.tags || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.prerequisites || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.learning_objectives || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.examples || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.references || []),\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n    const knowledgePointId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const knowledgePoint = await this.getKnowledgePointById(knowledgePointId);\n    if (!knowledgePoint) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create knowledge point');\n    }\n    \n    return knowledgePoint;\n  }\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点\n  async getKnowledgePointById(id: number): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM knowledge_points WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n    const row = Array.isArray(result) ? result[0] : result;\n    \n    if (!row) return null;\n    \n    return this.formatKnowledgePoint(row);\n  }\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getKnowledgePointsByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options: QueryOptions = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const { limit = 10, offset = 0, orderBy = 'created_at', orderDirection = 'DESC' } = options;\n    \n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = &#96;\n      SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM knowledge_points \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND status != 'archived'\n    &#96;;\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, [techPointId]);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].total : countResult.total;\n    \n    // 获取数据\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM knowledge_points \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND status != 'archived'\n      ORDER BY ${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, limit, offset]);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n    \n    const data = rows.map(row =&gt; this.formatKnowledgePoint(row));\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page: Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1,\n      pageSize: limit,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit)\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async updateKnowledgePoint(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointDTO): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n    const updates: string[] = [];\n    const params: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (data.title !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('title = ?');\n      params.push(data.title);\n    }\n    if (data.content !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('content = ?');\n      params.push(data.content);\n    }\n    if (data.knowledge_type !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('knowledge_type = ?');\n      params.push(data.knowledge_type);\n    }\n    if (data.difficulty_level !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('difficulty_level = ?');\n      params.push(data.difficulty_level);\n    }\n    if (data.tags !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('tags = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.tags));\n    }\n    if (data.prerequisites !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('prerequisites = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.prerequisites));\n    }\n    if (data.learning_objectives !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('learning_objectives = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.learning_objectives));\n    }\n    if (data.examples !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('examples = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.examples));\n    }\n    if (data.references !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('references = ?');\n      params.push(JSON.stringify(data.references));\n    }\n    if (data.status !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('status = ?');\n      params.push(data.status);\n    }\n    \n    if (updates.length === 0) {\n      return await this.getKnowledgePointById(id);\n    }\n    \n    updates.push('updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');\n    params.push(id);\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE knowledge_points \n      SET ${updates.join(', ')} \n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    await this.db.query(sql, params);\n    return await this.getKnowledgePointById(id);\n  }\n\n  // 删除知识点\n  async deleteKnowledgePoint(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;DELETE FROM knowledge_points WHERE id = ?&#96;;\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n    \n    return (result.changes || result.affectedRows) &gt; 0;\n  }\n\n  // 格式化知识点数据\n  private formatKnowledgePoint(row: any): KnowledgePoint {\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      tech_point_id: row.tech_point_id,\n      title: row.title,\n      content: row.content,\n      knowledge_type: row.knowledge_type,\n      difficulty_level: row.difficulty_level,\n      tags: this.parseJSON(row.tags),\n      prerequisites: this.parseJSON(row.prerequisites),\n      learning_objectives: this.parseJSON(row.learning_objectives),\n      examples: this.parseJSON(row.examples),\n      references: this.parseJSON(row.references),\n      status: row.status,\n      created_by: row.created_by,\n      created_at: new Date(row.created_at),\n      updated_at: new Date(row.updated_at)\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 解析JSON字符串\n  private parseJSON(jsonString: string | null): any[] {\n    if (!jsonString) return [];\n    try {\n      return JSON.parse(jsonString);\n    } catch {\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n}",
  "totalLinesInFile": 205
}

        "contents": "export class KnowledgePointService {\n\n\n  // 创建知识点\n  async createKnowledgePoint(data: CreateKnowledgePointDTO): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO knowledge_points (\n        tech_point_id, title, content, knowledge_type, difficulty_level,\n        tags, prerequisites, learning_objectives, examples, references,\n        status, created_by\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [\n      data.tech_point_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.content,\n      data.knowledge_type,\n      data.difficulty_level,\n      JSON.stringify(data.tags || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.prerequisites || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.learning_objectives || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.examples || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.references || []),\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n    const knowledgePointId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const knowledgePoint = await this.getKnowledgePointById(knowledgePointId);\n    if (!knowledgePoint) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create knowledge point');\n    }\n    \n    return knowledgePoint;\n  }\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点\n  async getKnowledgePointById(id: number): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM knowledge_points WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\n      data.source_url || null,\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport {\n  KnowledgePoint,\n  CreateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  UpdateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  KnowledgePointQueryOptions,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/knowledgePoint';\n\nconst KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL = '/knowledge-points';\n\nexport const knowledgePointService = {\n  // 创建知识点\n  async create(data: CreateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.post(KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options?: KnowledgePointQueryOptions\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const params = {\n      page: options?.page || 1,\n      pageSize: options?.pageSize || 10,\n      orderBy: options?.orderBy || 'created_at',\n      orderDirection: options?.orderDirection || 'DESC'\n    };\n    \n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/tech-point/${techPointId}&#96;, { params });\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点详情\n  async getById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 删除知识点\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  }\n};",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    parent_id INTEGER,\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    category_id INTEGER,\n    parent_id INTEGER,\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

            "text": "    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',",

        "contents": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\n\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\n\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\n\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\n\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\n\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\n\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\n\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\n\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\n\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\n\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\n\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\n\n存储Agent工作流定义。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',",

        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",

            "line": 204,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class KnowledgePointService {\n\n\n  // 创建知识点\n  async createKnowledgePoint(data: CreateKnowledgePointDTO): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO knowledge_points (\n        tech_point_id, title, content, knowledge_type, difficulty_level,\n        tags, prerequisites, learning_objectives, examples, references,\n        status, created_by\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [\n      data.tech_point_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.content,\n      data.knowledge_type,\n      data.difficulty_level,\n      JSON.stringify(data.tags || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.prerequisites || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.learning_objectives || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.examples || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.references || []),\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n    const knowledgePointId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const knowledgePoint = await this.getKnowledgePointById(knowledgePointId);\n    if (!knowledgePoint) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create knowledge point');\n    }\n    \n    return knowledgePoint;\n  }\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点\n  async getKnowledgePointById(id: number): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM knowledge_points WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 技术点相关类型定义\nimport { CarModel } from './carModel';\n\nexport interface TechPoint {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  features?: string; // 技术特性（从technology_versions迁移）\n  version?: string; // 版本号（从technology_versions迁移）\n  release_date?: string; // 发布日期（从technology_versions迁移）\n  technology_id?: number; // 关联的技术IP（从technology_versions迁移）\n  category_id: number;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level: number;\n  tech_type: TechType; // 统一使用tech_type与后端保持一致\n  priority: TechPriority;\n  status: TechStatus;\n  tags?: string[];\n  technical_details?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  benefits?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  applications?: string[];\n  keywords?: string[];\n  source_url?: string;\n  created_by?: string;\n  tech_principle?: string; // 技术原理\n  tech_value?: string; // 价值\n  tech_boundary?: string; // 适用边界\n  highlights?: string[]; // 技术亮点列表\n  evidence_measured?: string[]; // 证据-实测列表\n  evidence_certified?: string[]; // 证据-认证列表\n  evidence_comparison?: string[]; // 证据-对比列表\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n  category?: TechCategory;\n}\n\nexport interface TechCategory {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export class KnowledgePointService {\nasync getKnowledgePointById(id: number): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getKnowledgePointsByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options: QueryOptions = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const { limit = 10, offset = 0, orderBy = 'created_at', orderDirection = 'DESC' } = options;\n    \n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = &#96;\n      SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM knowledge_points \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND status != 'archived'\n    &#96;;\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, [techPointId]);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].total : countResult.total;\n    \n    // 获取数据\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM knowledge_points \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND status != 'archived'\n      ORDER BY ${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, limit, offset]);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n    \n    const data = rows.map(row =&gt; this.formatKnowledgePoint(row));\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page: Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1,\n      pageSize: limit,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit)\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async updateKnowledgePoint(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointDTO): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

已更新导入脚本，将技术知识点字段创建为独立的知识点记录。修改如下：

## 已完成的修改

### 1. 更新了导入脚本
- **`import-tech-points-from-json.ts`** - 从 JSON 文件导入
- **`import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts`** - 从 TPD2 API 导入

两个脚本现在会将以下字段创建为独立的知识点：

- **技术原理** (`tech_principle`) → 知识点类型：`PRINCIPLE`
- **价值** (`tech_value`) → 知识点类型：`APPLICATION`
- **适用边界** (`tech_boundary`) → 知识点类型：`CONCEPT`
- **技术亮点** (`highlights`) → 每个亮点一个知识点，类型：`BEST_PRACTICE`
- **实测证据** (`evidence_measured`) → 每个证据一个知识点，类型：`CASE_STUDY`
- **认证证据** (`evidence_certified`) → 每个证据一个知识点，类型：`CASE_STUDY`
- **对比证据** (`evidence_comparison`) → 每个对比一个知识点，类型：`CASE_STUDY`

### 2. 创建了数据库迁移脚本
- **`add-tech-point-id-to-knowledge-points.ts`** - 为 `knowledge_points` 表添加 `tech_point_id` 字段

## 使用步骤

1. 先运行迁移脚本（如果表还没有 `tech_point_id` 字段）：
   ```bash
   cd backend
   npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/add-tech-point-id-to-knowledge-points.ts
   ```

2. 然后导入数据：
   ```bash
   # 从JSON文件导入
   npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-json.ts <json-file-path>
   
   # 或从TPD2 API导入
   npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts
   ```

## 知识点展示

导入后，这些知识点会作为独立记录存储在 `knowledge_points` 表中，并通过 `tech_point_id` 关联到对应的技术点。在前端的技术点详情页面中，它们会按照"知识点记录"的方式分类展示，与 TPD2 项目的展示方式一致。

        "contents": "export class KnowledgePointService {\n\n\n  // 创建知识点\n  async createKnowledgePoint(data: CreateKnowledgePointDTO): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO knowledge_points (\n        tech_point_id, title, content, knowledge_type, difficulty_level,\n        tags, prerequisites, learning_objectives, examples, references,\n        status, created_by\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [\n      data.tech_point_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.content,\n      data.knowledge_type,\n      data.difficulty_level,\n      JSON.stringify(data.tags || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.prerequisites || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.learning_objectives || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.examples || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.references || []),\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n    const knowledgePointId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const knowledgePoint = await this.getKnowledgePointById(knowledgePointId);\n    if (!knowledgePoint) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create knowledge point');\n    }\n    \n    return knowledgePoint;\n  }\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点\n  async getKnowledgePointById(id: number): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM knowledge_points WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

        "contents": "-- 项目表\n-- 用于存储项目信息\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- 项目来源表\n-- 用于关联项目与各种来源（文件、URL、文本、技术点等）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('file', 'url', 'text', 'tech_point', 'knowledge_point')),\n    source_content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_title TEXT,\n    source_description TEXT,\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_type ON projects(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_status ON projects(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_created_at ON projects(created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_last_opened_at ON projects(last_opened_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_project_id ON project_sources(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_source_type ON project_sources(source_type);",

s.trim());\n        for (const statement of indexStatements) {\n          if (statement.trim()) {\n            await this.db.query(statement);\n          }\n        }\n        logger.info('公共知识库表初始化成功 (SQLite)');\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.error('公共知识库表初始化失败:', error);\n        throw error;\n      }\n    } else {\n      // PostgreSQL 表结构\n      const createCategoriesTableSQL = &#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_knowledge_categories (\n          id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n          name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n          parent_id BIGINT,\n          sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n          created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES public_knowledge_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n        );\n      &#96;;\n\n      const createFilesTableSQL = &#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_knowledge_files (\n          id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n          category_id BIGINT,\n          name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n          file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n          file_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,\n          file_size BIGINT NOT NULL,\n          description TEXT,\n          uploaded_by BIGINT,\n          created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES public_knowledge_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n        );\n      &#96;;\n\n      const createIndexesSQL = &#96;\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_categories_parent_id ON public_knowledge_categories(parent_id);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_categories_sort_order ON public_knowledge_categories(sort_order);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category_id ON public_knowledge_files(category_id);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON public_knowledge_files(created_at);\n      &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\n\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\n\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\n\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\n\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\n\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\n\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\n\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\n\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\n\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\n\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\n\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\n\n存储Agent工作流定义。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建技术点\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_points (\n        name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n        priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n        keywords, source_url, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.name,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.category_id || null,\n      data.parent_id || null,\n      data.level || 1,\n      data.tech_type || TechType.FEATURE,\n      data.priority || Priority.MEDIUM,\n      data.status || Status.DRAFT,\n      data.tags ? JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.benefits) : null,\n      data.applications ? JSON.stringify(data.applications) : null,\n      data.keywords ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\n      data.source_url || null,\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

then\n        ROLLUP_PACKAGE=\"@rollup/rollup-darwin-x64\"\n    else\n        # 其他架构，使用通用检查\n        ROLLUP_PACKAGE=\"\"\n    fi\n    \n    # 检查关键依赖是否正常（检测 rollup 问题）\n    if [ -n \"$ROLLUP_PACKAGE\" ] &amp;&amp; ../logs/db-init.log 2&gt;&amp;1; then\n            echo \"✅ 数据库初始化完成（修复后）\"\n        else\n            echo \"⚠️  数据库初始化仍然失败，请检查 logs/db-init.log\"\n            echo \"   继续启动服务，但数据库可能无法正常工作...\"\n        fi\n    else\n        echo \"⚠️  数据库初始化出现警告，但继续启动服务...\"\n        echo \"   详细错误请查看 logs/db-init.log\"\n    fi\nfi\ncd ..\n\necho \"\"\necho \"🔧 启动服务...\"\necho \"\"\n\n# 检查端口是否被占用\nif lsof -Pi :3003 -sTCP:LISTEN -t &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then\n    echo \"⚠️  端口 3003 已被占用，尝试停止现有进程...\"\n    lsof -ti :3003 | xargs kill -9 2&gt;/dev/null || true\n    sleep 2\nfi\n\nif lsof -Pi :5173 -sTCP:LISTEN -t &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then\n    echo \"⚠️  端口 5173 已被占用，尝试停止现有进程...\"\n    lsof -ti :5173 | xargs kill -9 2&gt;/dev/null || true\n    sleep 2\nfi\n\n# 启动后端服务（后台运行）\necho \"📡 启动后端服务 (端口 3003)...\"\ncd backend\nnpx ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/app.ts &gt; ../logs/backend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\nBACKEND_PID=$!\ncd ..\n\n# 验证后端进程是否启动成功\nif ! kill -0 $BACKEND_PID 2&gt;/dev/null; then\n    echo \"❌ 后端服务启动失败！\"\n    echo \"   请查看 logs/backend.log 了解详细错误\"\n    BACKEND_ERROR=$(tail -20 logs/backend.log 2&gt;/dev/null | grep -i \"incompatible architecture\" || true)\n    if [ -n \"$BACKEND_ERROR\" ]; then\n        echo \"\"\n        echo \"   检测到 sqlite3 架构问题，尝试修复...\"\n        cd backend\n        npm rebuild sqlite3\n        echo \"   重新启动后端服务...\"\n        npx ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/app.ts &gt; ../logs/backend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n        BACKEND_PID=$!\n        cd ..\n        sleep 3\n    else\n        exit 1\n    fi\nfi\n\n# 等待后端启动\necho \"⏳ 等待后端服务启动...\"\nsleep 5\n\n# 启动前端服务（后台运行）\necho \"🌐 启动前端服务 (端口 5173)...\"\ncd frontend\nif [ -f \"node_modules/.bin/vite\" ] || npx --yes vite --version &gt; /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then\n    npx --yes vite &gt; ../logs/frontend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n    FRONTEND_PID=$!\n    echo \"   前端服务 PID: $FRONTEND_PID\"\nelse\n    echo \"⚠️  前端依赖未安装，跳过前端启动\"\n    echo \"   请运行: cd frontend &amp;&amp; npm install\"\n    FRONTEND_PID=\"\"\nfi\ncd ..\n\n# 保存进程ID到文件\necho $BACKEND_PID &gt; .backend.pid\nif [ -n \"$FRONTEND_PID\" ]; then\n    echo $FRONTEND_PID &gt; .frontend.pid\nfi\n\necho \"\"\necho \"✅ 服务启动完成！\"\necho \"\"\necho \"📋 服务信息:\"\necho \"   - 后端 API: http://localhost:3003\"\necho \"   - 前端应用: http://localhost:5173\"\necho \"   - 健康检查: http://localhost:3003/health\"\necho \"\"\necho \"📝 日志文件:\"\necho \"   - 数据库初始化: logs/db-init.log\"\necho \"   - 后端日志: logs/backend.log\"\necho \"   - 前端日志: logs/frontend.log\"\necho \"\"\necho \"🛑 停止服务: 运行 ./stop.sh 或按 Ctrl+C\"\n# 等待并检查服务状态\necho \"⏳ 等待服务就绪...\"\nsleep 10\n\n# 检查后端服务\necho \"🔍 检查后端服务状态...\"\nMAX_RETRIES=6\nRETRY_COUNT=0\nBACKEND_READY=false\n\nwhile [ $RETRY_COUNT -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; do\n    if curl -s http://localhost:3003/health &gt; /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then\n        echo \"✅ 后端服务运行正常\"\n        BACKEND_READY=true\n        break\n    else\n        RETRY_COUNT=$((RETRY_COUNT + 1))\n        if [ $RETRY_COUNT -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; then\n            echo \"   等待后端服务启动... ($RETRY_COUNT/$MAX_RETRIES)\"\n            sleep 2\n        fi\n    fi\ndone\n\nif [ \"$BACKEND_READY\" = false ]; then\n    echo \"⚠️  后端服务启动失败或响应超时\"\n    echo \"   请检查 logs/backend.log 了解详细错误\"\n    if [ -f \"logs/backend.log\" ]; then\n        echo \"\"\n        echo \"   最近的错误信息：\"\n        tail -10 logs/backend.log | sed 's/^/   /'\n    fi\nfi\n\n# 检查前端服务\necho \"🔍 检查前端服务状态...\"\nif curl -s http://localhost:5173 &gt; /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then\n    echo \"✅ 前端服务运行正常\"\nelse\n    echo \"⚠️  前端服务可能还在启动中，请稍候...\"\n    echo \"   请检查 logs/frontend.log 了解详细状态\"\nfi\n\necho \"\"\necho \"✨ 启动完成！可以在浏览器中访问 http://localhost:5173\"\necho \"\"\necho \"按 Ctrl+C 停止服务...\"\n\n# 等待用户中断\ncleanup() {\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"🛑 正在停止服务...\"\n    if [ -n \"$BACKEND_PID\" ] &amp;&amp; kill -0 $BACKEND_PID 2&gt;/dev/null; then\n        kill $BACKEND_PID 2&gt;/dev/null || true\n    fi\n    if [ -n \"$FRONTEND_PID\" ] &amp;&amp; kill -0 $FRONTEND_PID 2&gt;/dev/null; then\n        kill $FRONTEND_PID 2&gt;/dev/null || true\n    fi\n    # 清理 PID 文件\n    rm -f .backend.pid .frontend.pid\n    # 确保进程被终止\n    lsof -ti :3003 | xargs kill -9 2&gt;/dev/null || true\n    lsof -ti :5173 | xargs kill -9 2&gt;/dev/null || true\n    echo \"✅ 服务已停止\"\n    exit 0\n}\n\nif [ -n \"$FRONTEND_PID\" ]; then\n    trap cleanup INT TERM\nelse\n    trap cleanup INT TERM\nfi\n\n# 保持脚本运行\nwait\n\n",

- 总计：31 个技术点

### 导入内容

1. 技术点基本信息：31 个技术点已导入
2. 关联车型：已关联相关车型（部分车型在数据库中不存在，已跳过）
3. 技术知识点：已创建知识点记录，包括：
   - 技术原理
   - 价值
   - 适用边界
   - 技术亮点（每个亮点一个知识点）
   - 实测证据（每个证据一个知识点）
   - 认证证据（每个证据一个知识点）
   - 对比证据（每个对比一个知识点）

### 已修复的问题

1. SQLite 不支持 `RETURNING` 子句：已修复 TechPointModel
2. `references` 是 SQL 关键字：已用引号包裹
3. 数据库连接问题：已修复 KnowledgePointService 的连接逻辑
4. 类型错误：已修复 null/undefined 类型问题

### 数据展示

导入的数据会在技术点详情页面的“知识点记录”部分展示，与 TPD2 项目的展示方式一致。

        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 3. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  NOW(),\n  NOW()\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != ''\nON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW();\n\n-- 4. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nRENAME TABLE car_models TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 5. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本 (SQLite版本)\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  logo_url TEXT,\n  country TEXT,\n  founded_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 创建更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS brands_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON brands\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE brands SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 3. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 4. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT OR IGNORE INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  datetime('now'),\n  datetime('now')\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != '';\n\n-- 5. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nALTER TABLE car_models RENAME TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n  launch_year INTEGER,\n  end_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 7. 创建车型表更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS car_models_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON car_models\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE car_models SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 8. 创建车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);",

        "contents": "# 三层级车系架构设计\n\n## 概述\n将原有的两层级结构（品牌-车系）调整为三层级结构（品牌-车型-车系），以更好地反映汽车行业的实际层级关系。\n\n## 层级关系\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n品牌 (Brand)\n├── 车型 (Model) \n    ├── 车系 (Series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据库设计\n\n### 1. 品牌表 (brands)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 车型表 (car_models)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "  END;\n\n-- 8. 创建车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_status ON car_models(status);\n\n-- 9. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  generation TEXT,\n  launch_year INTEGER,\n  end_year INTEGER,\n  market_segment TEXT CHECK (market_segment IN ('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium')),\n  body_style TEXT,\n  engine_types TEXT, -- JSON格式存储\n  fuel_types TEXT,   -- JSON格式存储\n  description TEXT,\n  metadata TEXT,     -- JSON格式存储\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 10. 创建车系表更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS car_series_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON car_series\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE car_series SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 11. 创建车系表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_model_id ON car_series(model_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_status ON car_series(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_market_segment ON car_series(market_segment);\n\n-- 12. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车型记录\n-- 这里假设原有的 series 字段实际上是车型名称\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  b.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.series, '未知车型'),\n  '从原有数据迁移',\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.status = 'active' THEN 'active'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'discontinued' THEN 'discontinued'\n    ELSE 'active'\n  END,\n  cst.created_at,\n  cst.updated_at\nFROM car_series_temp cst\nJOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\nWHERE cst.series IS NOT NULL AND cst.series != '';\n\n-- 13. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车系记录",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\n-- 创建数据库\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\nUSE todify3;\n\n-- 1. 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 2. 车型车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\n);\n\n-- 3. 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",

        "contents": "### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  generation VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '世代信息',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  market_segment ENUM('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium') COMMENT '市场定位',\n  body_style VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '车身样式',\n  engine_types JSON COMMENT '发动机类型',\n  fuel_types JSON COMMENT '燃料类型',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车系描述',\n  metadata JSON COMMENT '额外信息',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_model_id (model_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status),\n  INDEX idx_market_segment (market_segment)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据示例\n\n### 品牌数据\n- 奥迪 (Audi)\n- 宝马 (BMW)\n- 奔驰 (Mercedes-Benz)\n\n### 车型数据\n- 奥迪 A 系列\n- 奥迪 Q 系列\n- 宝马 1 系列\n- 宝马 3 系列\n- 宝马 X 系列\n\n### 车系数据\n- 奥迪 A 系列 -&gt; A3, A4, A6, A8\n- 奥迪 Q 系列 -&gt; Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8\n- 宝马 3 系列 -&gt; 3系轿车, 3系旅行车, 3系GT\n\n## API 接口设计\n\n### 品牌相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/brands - 获取品牌列表\n- POST /api/v1/brands - 创建品牌\n- PUT /api/v1/brands/:id - 更新品牌\n- DELETE /api/v1/brands/:id - 删除品牌\n\n### 车型相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/models - 获取车型列表\n- GET /api/v1/brands/:brandId/models - 获取指定品牌的车型\n- POST /api/v1/models - 创建车型\n- PUT /api/v1/models/:id - 更新车型\n- DELETE /api/v1/models/:id - 删除车型\n\n### 车系相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/series - 获取车系列表\n- GET /api/v1/models/:modelId/series - 获取指定车型的车系\n- POST /api/v1/series - 创建车系\n- PUT /api/v1/series/:id - 更新车系",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### 3. 车系表 (car_series)",

        "contents": "async function createCarTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  if (await tableExists('car_series')) {\n    console.log('✅ car_series 表已存在');\n  } else {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\n        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n        model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n        name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n        name_en VARCHAR(255),\n        description TEXT,\n        launch_year INTEGER,\n        end_year INTEGER,\n        market_segment VARCHAR(100),\n        status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n        metadata TEXT,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n        UNIQUE(model_id, name)\n      );\n      \n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_model_id ON car_series(model_id);\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_status ON car_series(status);\n    &#96;;\n    await executeSQL(sql);\n    console.log('✅ car_series 表创建成功');\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 创建技术分类和技术点表\n */\nasync function createTechTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  if\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

            "line": 59

        },
        "contents": "# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\n\n## 一、概述\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\n\n### 1.1 设计目标\n\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\n\n### 1.2 架构分层\n\n数据库架构分为五层：\n\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\n\n## 二、表结构设计\n\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\n\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\n\n存储汽车品牌信息。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\n\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "-- Todify3 统一数据库索引优化 v2.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 整合所有索引定义，优化查询性能\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第一层：基础数据层索引\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 品牌表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brands_name ON brands(name);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brands_status ON brands(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brands_country ON brands(country);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brands_country_status ON brands(country, status);\n\n-- 车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_name ON car_models(name);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_category ON car_models(category);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_status ON car_models(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_launch_year ON car_models(launch_year);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_status ON car_models(brand_id, status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_category_status ON car_models(category, status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_category ON car_models(brand_id, category);\n\n-- 车系表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_model_id ON car_series(model_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_name ON car_series(name);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_status ON car_series(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_market_segment ON car_series(market_segment);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_launch_year ON car_series(launch_year);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_model_status ON car_series(model_id, status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_segment_status ON car_series(market_segment, status);\n\n-- 技术分类表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_categories_parent_id ON tech_categories(parent_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_categories_status ON tech_categories(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_categories_level ON tech_categories(level);",

        "contents": "JOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\nWHERE cst.series IS NOT NULL AND cst.series != '';\n\n-- 13. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车系记录\nINSERT INTO car_series (\n  model_id, \n  name, \n  launch_year, \n  end_year, \n  market_segment,\n  description, \n  metadata, \n  status, \n  created_at, \n  updated_at\n)\nSELECT \n  cm.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.model, cst.series || ' 基础版'),\n  cst.launch_year,\n  cst.end_year,\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'economy' THEN 'economy'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'compact' THEN 'compact'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'mid-size' THEN 'mid-size'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'full-size' THEN 'full-size'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'luxury' THEN 'luxury'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'sport' THEN 'sport'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'premium' THEN 'premium'\n    ELSE 'compact'\n  END,\n  cst.description,\n  cst.metadata,\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.status = 'active' THEN 'active'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'discontinued' THEN 'discontinued'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'planned' THEN 'planned'\n    ELSE 'active'\n  END,\n  cst.created_at,\n  cst.updated_at\nFROM car_series_temp cst\nJOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\nJOIN car_models cm ON cm.brand_id = b.id AND cm.name = COALESCE(cst.series, '未知车型');\n\n-- 14. 插入示例数据\nINSERT OR IGNORE INTO brands (name, name_en, country, founded_year, description) VALUES\n('奥迪', 'Audi', '德国', 1909, '德国豪华汽车品牌'),\n('宝马', 'BMW', '德国', 1916, '德国豪华汽车和摩托车制造商'),\n('奔驰', 'Mercedes-Benz', '德国', 1926, '德国豪华汽车品牌'),\n('大众', 'Volkswagen', '德国', 1937, '德国汽车制造商'),\n('丰田', 'Toyota', '日本', 1937, '日本汽车制造商');\n\n-- 15. 插入车型示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, category, description) \nSELECT b.id, '3系', 'sedan', '中型豪华轿车系列' FROM brands b WHERE b.name = '宝马'\nUNION ALL\nSELECT b.id, 'X系', 'suv', 'SUV系列' FROM brands b WHERE b.name = '宝马'\nUNION ALL\nSELECT b.id, 'A系', 'sedan', '豪华轿车系列' FROM brands b WHERE b.name = '奥迪'\nUNION ALL\nSELECT b.id, 'Q系', 'suv', 'SUV系列' FROM brands b WHERE b.name = '奥迪'",

OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    if (includeBrand) {\n      sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        ${whereClause}\n        ORDER BY cm.${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n        LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n      &#96;;\n    }\n    \n    const params = [...whereParams, limit, offset];\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [];\n      \n      const processedCarModels = carModels.map((carModel: any) =&gt; {\n        if (includeBrand &amp;&amp; carModel.brand_name) {\n          return {\n            ...carModel,\n            brand: {\n              id: carModel.brand_id,\n              name: carModel.brand_name,\n              name_en: carModel.brand_name_en\n            }\n          };\n        }\n        return carModel;\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        carModels: processedCarModels as CarModel[],\n        total\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查询车型列表失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查询车型列表失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据品牌ID查找车型\n   */\n  async findByBrandId(brandId: number, options: Omit&lt;FindAllCarModelsOptions, 'where'&gt; = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建车型\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateCarModelDTO): Promise&lt;CarModel&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    // 验证品牌是否存在\n    const brandCheckSql = 'SELECT id FROM brands WHERE id = ?';\n    const brandResult = await this.db.query(brandCheckSql, [data.brand_id]);\n    const brands = Array.isArray(brandResult) ? brandResult : brandResult.rows || [brandResult];\n    \n    if (brands.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('指定的品牌不存在');\n    }\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, name_en, category, launch_year, end_year, description, status)\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [\n      data.brand_id,\n      data.name,\n      data.name_en || null,\n      data.category || null,\n      data.launch_year || null,\n      data.end_year || null,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.status || CarModelStatus.ACTIVE\n    ];\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n      const insertId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n      \n      return await this.findById(insertId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('创建车型失败:', error);\n      if (error.message?.includes('UNIQUE constraint failed')) {\n        throw new Error('车型名称已存在');\n      }\n      throw new Error('创建车型失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找车型\n   */\n  async findById(id: number, includeBrand: boolean = true): Promise&lt;CarModel&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",

已修复这两个 API 端点的问题。修复内容如下：

## 修复内容

### 1. `getAssociatedCarModels` 方法
- 问题：SQL 查询使用了不存在的字段 `cm.brand, cm.series, cm.model`
- 修复：
  - 使用正确的表结构：`car_models` 表有 `brand_id` 和 `name` 字段
  - 添加 `LEFT JOIN brands` 获取品牌信息
  - 修改排序为 `ORDER BY b.name, cm.name`
  - 添加错误处理，表不存在时返回空数组

### 2. `getAssociatedContent` 方法
- 问题：查询的表可能不存在，导致 SQL 错误
- 修复：
  - 为每个查询添加 try-catch 错误处理
  - 表不存在时返回空数组，不抛出错误
  - 确保即使部分表不存在也能正常返回结果

### 3. 错误信息改进
- 在控制器中添加更详细的错误信息，便于调试

## 修复后的行为

- `getAssociatedCarModels`：即使表不存在或查询失败，也会返回空数组而不是 500 错误
- `getAssociatedContent`：即使某些关联表不存在，也会返回部分结果，不会完全失败

  "contents": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# Todify3 本地启动脚本\n# 用于同时启动前端和后端服务\n\necho \"🚀 启动 Todify3 项目...\"\n\n# 检查是否安装了 Node.js\nif ! command -v node &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n    echo \"❌ 错误: 未找到 Node.js，请先安装 Node.js\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# 检查是否安装了 npm\nif ! command -v npm &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n    echo \"❌ 错误: 未找到 npm，请先安装 npm\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# 函数：检查端口是否被占用\ncheck_port() {\n    local port=$1\n    if lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t &gt;/dev/null ; then\n        echo \"⚠️  警告: 端口 $port 已被占用\"\n        return 1\n    fi\n    return 0\n}\n\n# 函数：等待服务启动\nwait_for_service() {\n    local url=$1\n    local log_file=$2\n    local pid=$3\n    local max_attempts=60\n    local attempt=0\n    \n    echo \"⏳ 等待服务启动: $url\"\n    while [ $attempt -lt $max_attempts ]; do\n        # 检查进程是否还在运行\n        if ! kill -0 $pid 2&gt;/dev/null; then\n            echo \"❌ 服务进程已退出\"\n            if [ -f \"$log_file\" ]; then\n                echo \"📋 查看错误日志 (最后 20 行):\"\n                tail -20 \"$log_file\" | sed 's/^/   /' || true\n            fi\n            return 1\n        fi\n        \n        # 尝试连接服务（增加超时时间，避免快速失败）",
  "totalLinesInFile": 359
}

JSON.parse(workflow.nodes) \n            : workflow.nodes;\n          if (Array.isArray(workflowNodes)) {\n            const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n            const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n            roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n          }\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析工作流节点失败', { \n            workflowId: config.workflowId, \n            error: parseError \n          });\n          // 解析失败时返回空角色列表，不抛出错误\n        }\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'role' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    }\n    \n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      context: { metadata: { address: req.params.address } },\n    });\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\n      data: null\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 公开访问接口（通过configId获取配置和角色）\napp.get('/api/v1/public-config/:configId', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { configId } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(configId);\n    \n    if (!config || !config.isActive) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\n    }\n\n    // 获取角色列表\n    let roles: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; config.workflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\n      if (workflow) {\n        try {\n          const workflowNodes = typeof workflow.nodes === 'string' \n            ? JSON.parse(workflow.nodes) \n            : workflow.nodes;\n          if (Array.isArray(workflowNodes)) {\n            const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n            const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n            roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n          }\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析工作流节点失败', { \n            workflowId: config.workflowId, \n            error: parseError \n          });\n          // 解析失败时返回空角色列表，不抛出错误\n        }\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    }\n    \n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      context: { metadata: { configId: req.params.configId } },\n    });\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\n      data: null\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// API 健康检查\napp.get('/api/health', (req, res) =&gt; {\n  res.json({ \n    message: 'Todify3 Backend API',\n    version: '1.0.0',\n    status: 'running',\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    uptime: process.uptime(),\n  });\n});\n\n// 性能监控 API\napp.get('/api/v1/monitoring/performance', (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const stats = performanceMonitor.getStats();\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: stats,\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      error: {\n        code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',\n        message: '获取性能统计失败',\n      },\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// Prometheus 指标端点\napp.get('/metrics', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    res.set('Content-Type', 'text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8');\n    const metrics = await prometheusMetrics.getMetrics();\n    res.send(metrics);\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\n    res.status(500).send('# Error generating metrics\\n');\n  }\n});\n\n// 公共知识库文件服务\nconst publicKnowledgeUploadDir = path.join(__dirname, '../uploads/public-knowledge');\napp.use('/api/v1/public-knowledge/files', express.static(publicKnowledgeUploadDir, {\n  maxAge: 86400000, // 1 day\n  etag: true,\n  lastModified: true,\n}));\n\n// 生产环境静态文件服务：直接从 frontend/dist 提供资源\n// 注意：必须在 API 路由之后，否则会拦截 API 请求\n// 仅在非开发环境或明确需要时才启用静态文件服务\nconst isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';\nif (!isDev) {\n  const distDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../frontend/dist');\n  app.use(express.static(distDir, {\n    maxAge: 0,\n    etag: true,\n    lastModified: true,\n  }));\n\n  // SPA Fallback：除 /api/* 外的所有路由都返回 index.html\n  app.get(/^(\\/(?!api).*)$/, (_req, res) =&gt; {\n    res.sendFile(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'));\n  });\n}\n\n// 全局错误处理中间件\n// 注意：这个中间件必须放在所有路由之后，且必须有4个参数 (err, req, res, next)\napp.use((err: any, req: any, res: any, next: any) =&gt; {\n  // 如果响应已经发送，则委托给默认的 Express 错误处理\n  if (res.headersSent) {\n    return next(err);\n  }\n\n  // 记录错误详情\n  logger.error('全局错误处理', {\n    error: err,\n    stack: err?.stack,\n    requestUrl: req.url,\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\n    method: req.method,\n    path: req.path,\n    body: req.body,\n    params: req.params,\n    query: req.query,\n  });\n\n  // 发送到错误追踪\n  errorTracking.captureException(\n    err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)),\n    {\n      context: {\n        metadata: {\n          method: req.method,\n          path: req.path,\n          body: req.body,\n          params: req.params,\n          query: req.query,\n        },\n      },\n    }\n  );\n\n  // 根据错误类型返回不同的状态码\n  const statusCode = err.statusCode || err.status || 500;\n  const errorMessage =\n    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'\n      ? '服务器内部错误'\n      : err.message || 'Unknown error';\n\n  res.status(statusCode).json({\n    success: false,\n    message: 'Internal server error',\n    error: errorMessage,\n    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' &amp;&amp; { stack: err?.stack }),\n  });\n});\n\n// 启动服务器前测试数据库连接\nasync function startServer() {\n  try {\n    logger.info('正在测试数据库连接...');\n    const isConnected = await testConnection();\n    if (!isConnected) {\n      throw new Error('数据库连接失败');\n    }\n    logger.info('数据库连接成功');\n    \n    // 初始化AI角色数据库表\n    try {\n      const { aiRoleModel } = await import('./models');\n      await aiRoleModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('AI角色数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('AI角色数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    // 初始化Agent工作流数据库表\n    try {\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\n      await agentWorkflowModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('Agent工作流数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('Agent工作流数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    // 初始化公开页面配置数据库表\n    try {\n      const { publicPageConfigModel } = await import('./models');\n      await publicPageConfigModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('公开页面配置数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('公开页面配置数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    // 初始化来源信息数据库表\n    try {\n      const sourceInformationService = new SourceInformationService();\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('来源信息数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('来源信息数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    // 初始化公共知识库数据库表\n    try {\n      const { publicKnowledgeModel } = await import('./models');\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('公共知识库数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('公共知识库数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    const server = app.listen(port, \"0.0.0.0\", () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&#96; });\n    });\n\n    // 保持进程运行\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\n\n    // 优雅关闭处理\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGINT received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    return server;\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      level: 'fatal',\n    });\n    logger.error('Failed to start server', { error });\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\nstartServer();",
