{
  "contents": "    return this.formatKnowledgePoint(row);\n  }\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getKnowledgePointsByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options: QueryOptions = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const { limit = 10, offset = 0, orderBy = 'created_at', orderDirection = 'DESC' } = options;\n    \n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = &#96;\n      SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM knowledge_points \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND status != 'archived'\n    &#96;;\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, [techPointId]);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].total : countResult.total;\n    \n    // 获取数据\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM knowledge_points \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND status != 'archived'\n      ORDER BY ${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, limit, offset]);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n    \n    const data = rows.map(row =&gt; this.formatKnowledgePoint(row));\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page: Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1,\n      pageSize: limit,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit)\n    };\n  }\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 208
}

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的所有内容\n   */\n  async getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;{\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\n    pressReleases: any[];\n    speeches: any[];\n  }&gt; {\n    // 初始化返回结果\n    const result = {\n      packagingMaterials: [] as any[],\n      promotionStrategies: [] as any[],\n      pressReleases: [] as any[],\n      speeches: [] as any[]\n    };\n\n    try {\n      // 获取技术包装材料\n      const packagingSql = &#96;\n        SELECT * FROM tech_packaging_materials \n        WHERE tech_point_id = ? \n        ORDER BY created_at DESC\n      &#96;;\n      try {\n        const packagingResult = await this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.packagingMaterials = Array.isArray(packagingResult) ? packagingResult : [];\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 表不存在或其他错误，返回空数组\n        if (!error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn('获取技术包装材料失败:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 忽略错误\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 获取推广策略\n      const promotionSql = &#96;\n        SELECT ts.*, pt.weight \n        FROM tech_promotion_strategies ts\n        JOIN promotion_tech_points pt ON ts.id = pt.promotion_id\n        WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC\n      &#96;;\n      try {\n        const promotionResult = await this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.promotionStrategies = Array.isArray(promotionResult) ?         "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en,\n          tcm.application_status, \n          tcm.implementation_date, \n          tcm.notes\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n        WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY b.name, cm.name\n      &#96;;\n      \n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\n      return Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取关联车型失败:', error.message);\n      // 如果表不存在，返回空数组\n      if (error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n        return [];\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 关联车型到技术点\n   */\n  async associateCarModel(\n    techPointId: number, \n    carModelId: number, \n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ContentConcatenationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 批量获取知识点数据以提高性能\n   */\n  private async batchGetKnowledgePointData(knowledgePointIds: string[]): Promise&lt;Map&lt;string, { associatedContent: any; techPointInfo: any }&gt;&gt; {\n    const result = new Map&lt;string, { associatedContent: any; techPointInfo: any }&gt;();\n    \n    // 并行获取所有知识点的数据\n    const promises = knowledgePointIds.map(async (id) =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const numericId = parseInt(id, 10);\n        const [associatedContent, techPointInfo] = await Promise.all([\n          this.techPointModel.getAssociatedContent(numericId),\n          this.techPointModel.findById(numericId)\n        ]);\n        return { id, associatedContent, techPointInfo };\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;批量获取知识点 ${id} 数据失败:&#96;, error);\n        return { id, associatedContent: null, techPointInfo: null };\n      }\n    });\n    \n    const results = await Promise.all(promises);\n    \n    results.forEach(({ id, associatedContent, techPointInfo }) =&gt; {\n      result.set(id, { associatedContent, techPointInfo });\n    });\n    \n    return result;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 按知识点ID分组选择项\n   */\n  private groupByKnowledgePoint(selectedItems: SelectionItem[]): Map&lt;string, SelectionItem[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ? JSON.parse(row.keywords) : []\n        }));\n      } else {\n        console.log('硬编码查询也失败了，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车系技术点失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车系技术点失败');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const carSeriesModel = new CarSeriesModel();",

{\n  success: boolean;\n  data?: T;\n  message?: string;\n  error?: string;\n}\n\nexport interface PaginatedResponse&lt;T&gt; {\n  success: boolean;\n  data: T[];\n  pagination: {\n    page: number;\n    pageSize: number;\n    total: number;\n    totalPages: number;\n  };\n}\n\n// 创建知识点的表单数据\nexport interface CreateKnowledgePointFormData {\n  tech_point_id: number;\n  title: string;\n  content: string;\n  knowledge_type: KnowledgeType;\n  difficulty_level: DifficultyLevel;\n  tags?: string[];\n  prerequisites?: string[];\n  learning_objectives?: string[];\n  examples?: string[];\n  references?: string[];\n  status?: KnowledgeStatus;\n  created_by?: string;\n}\n\n// 更新知识点的表单数据\nexport interface UpdateKnowledgePointFormData {\n  title?: string;\n  content?: string;\n  knowledge_type?: KnowledgeType;\n  difficulty_level?: DifficultyLevel;\n  tags?: string[];\n  prerequisites?: string[];\n  learning_objectives?: string[];\n  examples?: string[];\n  references?: string[];\n  status?: KnowledgeStatus;\n}\n\n// 知识点查询参数\nexport interface KnowledgePointQueryOptions {\n  page?: number;\n  pageSize?: number;\n  orderBy?: string;\n  orderDirection?: 'ASC' | 'DESC';\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的所有内容\n   */\n  async getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;{\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\n    pressReleases: any[];\n    speeches: any[];\n  }&gt; {\n    // 初始化返回结果\n    const result = {\n      packagingMaterials: [] as any[],\n      promotionStrategies: [] as any[],\n      pressReleases: [] as any[],\n      speeches: [] as any[]\n    };\n\n    try {\n      // 获取技术包装材料\n      const packagingSql = &#96;\n        SELECT * FROM tech_packaging_materials \n        WHERE tech_point_id = ? \n        ORDER BY created_at DESC\n      &#96;;\n      try {\n        const packagingResult = await this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.packagingMaterials = Array.isArray(packagingResult) ? packagingResult : [];\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 表不存在或其他错误，返回空数组\n        if (!error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn('获取技术包装材料失败:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 忽略错误\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 获取推广策略\n      const promotionSql = &#96;\n        SELECT ts.*, pt.weight \n        FROM tech_promotion_strategies ts\n        JOIN promotion_tech_points pt ON ts.id = pt.promotion_id\n        WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC\n      &#96;;\n      try {\n        const promotionResult = await this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.promotionStrategies = Array.isArray(promotionResult) ? promotionResult : [];\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        if (!error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn('获取推广策略失败:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 忽略错误\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 获取通稿\n      const pressSql = &#96;\n        SELECT pr.*, pt.weight \n        FROM tech_press_releases pr\n        JOIN press_tech_points pt ON pr.id = pt.press_release_id\n        WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC\n      &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ContentConcatenationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 批量获取知识点数据以提高性能\n   */\n  private async batchGetKnowledgePointData(knowledgePointIds: string[]): Promise&lt;Map&lt;string, { associatedContent: any; techPointInfo: any }&gt;&gt; {\n    const result = new Map&lt;string, { associatedContent: any; techPointInfo: any }&gt;();\n    \n    // 并行获取所有知识点的数据\n    const promises = knowledgePointIds.map(async (id) =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const numericId = parseInt(id, 10);\n        const [associatedContent, techPointInfo] = await Promise.all([\n          this.techPointModel.getAssociatedContent(numericId),\n          this.techPointModel.findById(numericId)\n        ]);\n        return { id, associatedContent, techPointInfo };\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;批量获取知识点 ${id} 数据失败:&#96;, error);\n        return { id, associatedContent: null, techPointInfo: null };\n      }\n    });\n    \n    const results = await Promise.all(promises);\n    \n    results.forEach(({ id, associatedContent, techPointInfo }) =&gt; {\n      result.set(id, { associatedContent, techPointInfo });\n    });\n    \n    return result;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 按知识点ID分组选择项\n   */\n  private groupByKnowledgePoint(selectedItems: SelectionItem[]): Map&lt;string, SelectionItem[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ? JSON.parse(row.keywords) : []\n        }));\n      } else {\n        console.log('硬编码查询也失败了，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车系技术点失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车系技术点失败');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const carSeriesModel = new CarSeriesModel();",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取车系关联的技术点\n   */\n  async getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      await this.ensureConnection();\n      \n      console.log('获取车系技术点 - carSeriesId:', carSeriesId);\n      console.log('carSeriesId type:', typeof carSeriesId);\n      \n      // 先测试硬编码的查询\n      const testSql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          tp.id,\n          tp.name,\n          tp.description,\n          tp.tech_type,\n          tp.priority,\n          tp.status,\n          tp.tags,\n          tp.technical_details,\n          tp.benefits,\n          tp.applications,\n          tp.keywords,\n          tp.source_url,\n          tp.created_at,\n          tp.updated_at,\n          tpcm.application_status,\n          tpcm.implementation_date,\n          tpcm.notes as association_notes\n        FROM tech_points tp\n        INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n        INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n        INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n        WHERE cs.id = 1\n        ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n      &#96;;\n      \n      console.log('执行测试SQL查询（硬编码）:', testSql);\n      \n      const testRows = await this.db.query(testSql, []);\n      \n      console.log('测试查询结果行数:', testRows.length);\n      console.log('测试查询结果:', testRows);\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async \n\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\"检索信息\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\n      // 检查：type为external，且有url，且url不是http/https开头\n      // 文件URL特征：以/uploads/开头，或者包含文件扩展名（.pdf, .doc等）\n      \n      // 首先检查type\n      if (s.type !== 'external') {\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 检查URL是否存在\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;&amp; (typeof s.url === 'string' || typeof s.url === 'object');\n      if (!hasUrl) {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（无URL）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 处理URL（可能是字符串或对象）\n      let urlStr: string;\n      if (typeof s.url === 'string') {\n        urlStr = s.url.trim();\n      } else if (s.url &amp;&amp; typeof s.url === 'object' &amp;&amp; 'toString' in s.url) {\n        urlStr = String(s.url).trim();\n      } else {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（URL格式异常）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      if (urlStr.length === 0) {\n        return false;\n      }\n    };\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 过滤检索信息：排除上传的文件，只显示真正的检索信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\n  const filteredSources = sources.filter(source =&gt; {\n    // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的，不是http链接）\n    if (source.url &amp;&amp; !source.url.startsWith('http') &amp;&amp; !source.url.startsWith('https')) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    // 只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源\n    return true;\n  }).filter(source =&gt;\n    source.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||\n    source.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const filteredTechPoints = techPoints.filter(tp =&gt;\n    tp.name.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\n    tp.description?.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const filteredKnowledgePoints = knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&gt;\n    kp.title.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\n    kp.content?.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const filteredPublicFiles = publicKnowledgeFiles.filter(file =&gt;\n    file.name.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\n    file.description?.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const toggleTechPoint = (techPointId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedTechPoints(prev =&gt;\n      prev.includes(techPointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== techPointId)\n        : [...prev, techPointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const toggleKnowledgePoint = (knowledgePointId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedKnowledgePoints(prev =&gt;\n      prev.includes(knowledgePointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== knowledgePointId)\n        : [...prev, knowledgePointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const togglePublicFile = async (fileId: number)\n;\n;",

## 问题分析与修复

### 问题1：知识点记录显示空白
原因：
- 组件从 `currentTechPoint.tech_principle` 等字段读取，但这些字段已不在技术点表中
- 数据已作为独立知识点存储在 `knowledge_points` 表中

修复：
- 添加 `knowledgePoints` 状态
- 在 `fetchAssociatedData` 中调用 `knowledgePointService.getByTechPointId` 获取知识点
- 按标题分组并显示（去除数字后缀，如"技术亮点 1" → "技术亮点"）
- 按固定顺序显示：技术原理、价值、适用边界、技术亮点、实测证据、认证证据、对比证据

### 问题2：关联车型显示不对
原因：
- 只显示 `carModel.name`，缺少品牌信息

修复：
- 显示为 `品牌名 车型名`（如"特斯拉 Model Y"）
- 使用 `carModel.brand_name` 和 `carModel.name` 组合

### 问题3：关联资源显示空白
原因：
- API 返回的 `associatedContent` 中没有 `resources` 字段
- 只有 `packagingMaterials`, `promotionStrategies`, `pressReleases`, `speeches`

说明：
- 当前 API 未返回 `resources` 字段，显示为空属正常
- 如需显示资源，需要后端添加该字段或使用其他 API

## 修复后的效果

1. 知识点记录：从知识点 API 获取并正确显示，按类别分组
2. 关联车型：显示为"品牌名 车型名"格式
3. 关联资源：当前为空（API 未返回该数据）

刷新页面后，知识点和关联车型应能正常显示。关联资源需要后端支持或使用其他数据源。

  "contents": "  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en,\n          tcm.application_status, \n          tcm.implementation_date, \n          tcm.notes\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n        WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY b.name, cm.name\n      &#96;;\n      \n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\n      return Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取关联车型失败:', error.message);\n      // 如果表不存在，返回空数组\n      if (error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n        return [];\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 661
}

        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 3. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  NOW(),\n  NOW()\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != ''\nON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW();\n\n-- 4. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nRENAME TABLE car_models TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 5. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "# 三层级车系架构设计\n\n## 概述\n将原有的两层级结构（品牌-车系）调整为三层级结构（品牌-车型-车系），以更好地反映汽车行业的实际层级关系。\n\n## 层级关系\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n品牌 (Brand)\n├── 车型 (Model) \n    ├── 车系 (Series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据库设计\n\n### 1. 品牌表 (brands)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 车型表 (car_models)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 三层级车系架构设计",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 概述",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "将原有的两层级结构（品牌-车系）调整为三层级结构（品牌-车型-车系），以更好地反映汽车行业的实际层级关系。",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 层级关系",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 7

        "contents": "/**\n * 创建车型和车系表\n */\nasync function createCarTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  if (await tableExists('car_models')) {\n    console.log('✅ car_models 表已存在');\n  } else {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\n        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n        brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n        name TEXT NOT NULL,\n        name_en TEXT,\n        category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n        launch_year INTEGER,\n        end_year INTEGER,\n        description TEXT,\n        status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n      );\n      \n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_status ON car_models(status);\n    &#96;;\n    await executeSQL(sql);\n    console.log('✅ car_models 表创建成功');\n  }\n\n  if (await tableExists('car_series'))\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/database/database-design-v2.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 59
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\n\n## 一、概述\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\n\n### 1.1 设计目标\n\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\n\n### 1.2 架构分层\n\n数据库架构分为五层：\n\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\n\n## 二、表结构设计\n\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\n\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\n\n存储汽车品牌信息。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\n\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 一、概述",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1.1 设计目标",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1.2 架构分层",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "数据库架构分为五层：",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "## 二、表结构设计",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },

            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "| description | TEXT | 描述 |",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "存储车型信息，关联品牌。",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "|--------|------|------|",

          },
          {

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/docs/three-tier-design.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 50
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 115
          }
        },
        "contents": "### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  generation VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '世代信息',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  market_segment ENUM('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium') COMMENT '市场定位',\n  body_style VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '车身样式',\n  engine_types JSON COMMENT '发动机类型',\n  fuel_types JSON COMMENT '燃料类型',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车系描述',\n  metadata JSON COMMENT '额外信息',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_model_id (model_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status),\n  INDEX idx_market_segment (market_segment)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据示例\n\n### 品牌数据\n- 奥迪 (Audi)\n- 宝马 (BMW)\n- 奔驰 (Mercedes-Benz)\n\n### 车型数据\n- 奥迪 A 系列\n- 奥迪 Q 系列\n- 宝马 1 系列\n- 宝马 3 系列\n- 宝马 X 系列\n\n### 车系数据\n- 奥迪 A 系列 -&gt; A3, A4, A6, A8\n- 奥迪 Q 系列 -&gt; Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8\n- 宝马 3 系列 -&gt; 3系轿车, 3系旅行车, 3系GT\n\n## API 接口设计\n\n### 品牌相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/brands - 获取品牌列表\n- POST /api/v1/brands - 创建品牌\n- PUT /api/v1/brands/:id - 更新品牌\n- DELETE /api/v1/brands/:id - 删除品牌\n\n### 车型相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/models - 获取车型列表\n- GET /api/v1/brands/:brandId/models - 获取指定品牌的车型\n- POST /api/v1/models - 创建车型\n- PUT /api/v1/models/:id - 更新车型\n- DELETE /api/v1/models/:id - 删除车型\n\n### 车系相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/series - 获取车系列表\n- GET /api/v1/models/:modelId/series - 获取指定车型的车系\n- POST /api/v1/series - 创建车系\n- PUT /api/v1/series/:id - 更新车系",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### 3. 车系表 (car_series)",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE car_series (",

          },
          {
            "text": "  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "  model_id INT NOT NULL,",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系名称',",

          },
          {
            "text": "  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "  generation VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '世代信息',",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',",

          },
          {
            "text": "  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "  market_segment ENUM('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium') COMMENT '市场定位',",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "  body_style VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '车身样式',",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "  engine_types JSON COMMENT '发动机类型',",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "  fuel_types JSON COMMENT '燃料类型',",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "  description TEXT COMMENT '车系描述',",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "  metadata JSON COMMENT '额外信息',",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 68

        "contents": "  END;\n\n-- 8. 创建车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_status ON car_models(status);\n\n-- 9. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  generation TEXT,\n  launch_year INTEGER,\n  end_year INTEGER,\n  market_segment TEXT CHECK (market_segment IN ('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium')),\n  body_style TEXT,\n  engine_types TEXT, -- JSON格式存储\n  fuel_types TEXT,   -- JSON格式存储\n  description TEXT,\n  metadata TEXT,     -- JSON格式存储\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 10. 创建车系表更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS car_series_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON car_series\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE car_series SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 11. 创建车系表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_model_id ON car_series(model_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_status ON car_series(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_market_segment ON car_series(market_segment);\n\n-- 12. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车型记录\n-- 这里假设原有的 series 字段实际上是车型名称\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  b.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.series, '未知车型'),\n  '从原有数据迁移',\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.status = 'active' THEN 'active'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'discontinued' THEN 'discontinued'\n    ELSE 'active'\n  END,\n  cst.created_at,\n  cst.updated_at\nFROM car_series_temp cst\nJOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\nWHERE cst.series IS NOT NULL AND cst.series != '';\n\n-- 13. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车系记录",

        "contents": "  updated_at\n)\nSELECT \n  cm.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.model, CONCAT(cst.series, ' 基础版')),\n  cst.launch_year,\n  cst.end_year,\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'economy' THEN 'economy'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'compact' THEN 'compact'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'mid-size' THEN 'mid-size'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'full-size' THEN 'full-size'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'luxury' THEN 'luxury'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'sport' THEN 'sport'\n    WHEN cst.market_segment = 'premium' THEN 'premium'\n    ELSE 'compact'\n  END,\n  cst.description,\n  cst.metadata,\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.status = 'active' THEN 'active'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'discontinued' THEN 'discontinued'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'planned' THEN 'planned'\n    ELSE 'active'\n  END,\n  cst.created_at,\n  cst.updated_at\nFROM car_series_temp cst\nJOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\nJOIN car_models cm ON cm.brand_id = b.id AND cm.name = COALESCE(cst.series, '未知车型');\n\n-- 9. 更新技术点关联表（如果存在）\n-- 假设有 tech_point_car_models 表需要更新\n-- UPDATE tech_point_car_models tpcm\n-- JOIN car_series_temp cst ON tpcm.car_model_id = cst.id\n-- JOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\n-- JOIN car_models cm ON cm.brand_id = b.id AND cm.name = cst.series\n-- JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n-- SET tpcm.car_series_id = cs.id;\n\n-- 10. 插入示例数据\nINSERT INTO brands (name, name_en, country, founded_year, description) VALUES\n('奥迪', 'Audi', '德国', 1909, '德国豪华汽车品牌'),\n('宝马', 'BMW', '德国', 1916, '德国豪华汽车和摩托车制造商'),\n('奔驰', 'Mercedes-Benz', '德国', 1926, '德国豪华汽车品牌'),\n('大众', 'Volkswagen', '德国', 1937, '德国汽车制造商'),\n('丰田', 'Toyota', '日本', 1937, '日本汽车制造商')\nON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW();\n\n-- 插入车型示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, category, description) \nSELECT b.id, model_name, 'sedan', description FROM brands b\nCROSS JOIN (\n  SELECT '3系' as model_name, '中型豪华轿车系列' as description WHERE b.name = '宝马'",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找车型\n   */\n  async findById(id: number, includeBrand: boolean = true): Promise&lt;CarModel&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM car_models WHERE id = ?';\n    \n    if (includeBrand) {\n      sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        WHERE cm.id = ?\n      &#96;;\n    }\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [result];\n      \n      if (carModels.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('车型不存在');\n      }\n      \n      const carModel = carModels[0] as any;\n      \n      if (includeBrand &amp;&amp; carModel.brand_name) {\n        return {\n          ...carModel,\n          brand: {\n            id: carModel.brand_id,\n            name: carModel.brand_name,\n            name_en: carModel.brand_name_en\n          }\n        } as CarModel;\n      }\n      \n      return carModel as CarModel;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查找车型失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查找车型失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车型\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

已修复数据验证和显示逻辑。总结修复内容：

## 修复总结

### 1. **前端显示逻辑修复**
- 仅在品牌名称存在且非空时显示品牌
- 品牌为空时只显示车型名称
- 添加开发环境调试日志，便于检查数据准确性

### 2. **后端数据获取优化**
- 修复 SQL 查询，使用 `COALESCE` 处理 NULL 值
- 添加调试日志，记录返回的车型数据

### 3. **导入脚本数据验证**
- 添加品牌名称验证：品牌为空或无效时跳过该车型
- 添加车型名称验证：确保车型名称不为空
- 添加数据清理：自动去除品牌和车型名称的前后空格
- 改进错误处理：更清晰的错误提示

### 问题根源分析

如果显示"特斯拉 Model Y"但 TPD2 中没有"特斯拉"，可能原因：
1. TPD2 API 返回的 `brand` 字段为空或不存在，但导入时使用了错误的默认值
2. 数据库中已存在名为"特斯拉"的品牌，但 TPD2 中实际没有这个品牌
3. 导入脚本在品牌为空时创建了错误的品牌名称

### 修复后的行为

- 如果 TPD2 返回的 `brand` 字段为空或不存在，导入脚本会跳过该车型并记录警告
- 前端只在品牌信息存在且有效时才显示品牌名称
- 添加了调试日志，便于检查数据来源

### 建议的后续操作

1. 检查数据库中实际存储的品牌数据，确认是否有"特斯拉"品牌
2. 如果数据库中存在错误的品牌数据，需要清理或修正
3. 重新从 TPD2 导入数据，确保只导入有效的品牌信息

刷新页面后，如果品牌信息为空，将只显示车型名称（如"Model Y"），不会显示错误的品牌名称。

        "contents": "/**\n * 从TPD2项目API导入所有技术点数据\n * 一次性导入所有技术点及其关联数据\n */\n\nimport axios from 'axios';\nimport { DatabaseManager, db } from '../config/database';\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel, carModelModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority, KnowledgeType, DifficultyLevel, CreateKnowledgePointDTO } from '../types/database';\nimport { KnowledgePointService } from '../services/knowledgePointService';\n\ninterface TPD2TechPoint {\n  id?: number;\n  name: string;\n  description?: string;\n  category_id?: number;\n  category_name?: string;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level?: number;\n  tech_type?: string;\n  priority?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  tags?: string[] | null;\n  technical_details?: any;\n  benefits?: string[] | null;\n  applications?: string[] | null;\n  keywords?: string[] | null;\n  source_url?: string | null;\n  created_by?: string | null;\n  tech_principle?: string;\n  tech_value?: string;\n  tech_boundary?: string;\n  highlights?: string[];\n  evidence_measured?: string[];\n  evidence_certified?: string[];\n  evidence_comparison?: string[];\n  associated_car_models?: Array&lt;{\n    id?: number;\n    name: string;\n    brand: string;\n    type?: string;\n    car_model_id?: number;\n    relationship?: string;\n    notes?: string;\n  }&gt;;\n  associated_resources?: any[];\n}\n\n/**\n * 查找或创建技术分类\n */\nasync function findOrCreateCategory(\n  categoryId: number | undefined,\n  categoryName: string | undefined\n): Promise&lt;number | null&gt; {\n  \n}",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\nconst ;\n\n    let techPointId: number;\n    if (existing) {\n      // 更新现有技术点\n      await techPointModel.update(existing.id, techPointData);\n      techPointId = existing.id;\n      console.log(&#96;  ✅ 更新技术点: ${tpdTechPoint.name} (ID: ${techPointId})&#96;);\n    } else {\n      // 创建新技术点\n      const newTechPoint = await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n      techPointId = newTechPoint.id;\n      console.log(&#96;  ✅ 创建技术点: ${tpdTechPoint.name} (ID: ${techPointId})&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 8. 处理关联车型\n    if (tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models &amp;&amp; tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models.length &gt; 0) {\n      for (const carModelData of tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models) {\n        try {\n          // 验证车型数据：必须有名称\n          if (!carModelData.name || carModelData.name.trim() === '') {\n            console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  跳过无效车型数据: 缺少车型名称&#96;, carModelData);\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          // 验证品牌数据：如果品牌为空或无效，记录警告但不创建品牌\n          const brandName = carModelData.brand?.trim();\n          if (!brandName || brandName === '') {\n            console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  车型 ${carModelData.name} 缺少品牌信息，将不关联品牌&#96;, carModelData);\n            // 如果品牌为空，跳过该车型或使用默认处理\n            // 这里选择跳过，因为无法创建没有品牌的车型\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          // 如果已有car_model_id，直接使用\n          let carModelId: number;\n          if (carModelData.car_model_id) {\n            const existingCarModel = await carModelModel.findById(carModelData.car_model_id);\n}",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n {\n      for (const carModelData of tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models) {\n        try {\n          // 如果已有car_model_id，直接使用\n          let carModelId: number;\n          if (carModelData.car_model_id) {\n            const existingCarModel = await carModelModel.findById(carModelData.car_model_id);\n            if (existingCarModel) {\n              carModelId = existingCarModel.id;\n            } else {\n              // 如果ID不存在，通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n              carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n                carModelData.brand,\n                carModelData.name,\n                carModelData.type\n              );\n            }\n          } else {\n            // 通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n            carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n              carModelData.brand,\n              carModelData.name,\n              carModelData.type\n            );\n          }\n\n          // 关联车型到技术点\n          try {\n            await techPointModel.associateCarModel(\n              techPointId,\n              carModelId,\n              'planned', // 默认状态\n              null,\n              carModelData.notes || carModelData.relationship || null\n            );\n            console.log(&#96;    ✅ 关联车型: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name}&#96;);\n          } catch (error: any) {\n            // 如果已存在关联，忽略错误\n            if (!error.message?.includes('已关联') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('UNIQUE')) {\n              console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  关联车型失败: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  处理车型失败: ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 9. 处理技术知识点（创建独立的知识点记录）\n    const knowledgePointService = new KnowledgePointService();\n    let knowledgePointCount = 0;\n\n    // 技术原理\n    if\n}",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n\n          if (carModelData.car_model_id) {\n            const existingCarModel = await carModelModel.findById(carModelData.car_model_id);\n            if (existingCarModel) {\n              carModelId = existingCarModel.id;\n            } else {\n              // 如果ID不存在，通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n              carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n                brandName,\n                carModelData.name.trim(),\n                carModelData.type\n              );\n            }\n          } else {\n            // 通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n            carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n              brandName,\n              carModelData.name.trim(),\n              carModelData.type\n            );\n          }\n\n          // 关联车型到技术点\n          try {\n            await techPointModel.associateCarModel(\n              techPointId,\n              carModelId,\n              'planned', // 默认状态\n              undefined,\n              carModelData.notes || carModelData.relationship || undefined\n            );\n            console.log(&#96;    ✅ 关联车型: ${brandName} ${carModelData.name.trim()}&#96;);\n          } catch (error: any) {\n            // 如果已存在关联，忽略错误\n            if (!error.message?.includes('已关联') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('UNIQUE')) {\n              console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  关联车型失败: ${brandName} ${carModelData.name.trim()} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  处理车型失败: ${carModelData.name || '未知'} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 9. 处理技术知识点（创建独立的知识点记录）\n    // 确保数据库已连接\n    await db.connect();\n    const knowledgePointService = new KnowledgePointService();\n    let knowledgePointCount = 0;\n\n    // 技术原理\n    if\n}",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    logo_url TEXT,\n    country TEXT,\n    founded_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 车型表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 车系表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\n    description TEXT,\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\n);\n\n-- 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

AND name = ?';\n  const carModelResult = await db.query(carModelSql, [brandId, trimmedCarModelName]);\n  \n  if (Array.isArray(carModelResult) &amp;&amp; carModelResult.length &gt; 0) {\n    return carModelResult[0].id;\n  }\n\n  // 创建车型\n  const categoryMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n    '轿车': 'sedan',\n    'SUV': 'suv',\n    'MPV': 'mpv',\n    '跑车': 'coupe',\n    '皮卡': 'pickup',\n  };\n  \n  const category = type ? categoryMap[type] || null : null;\n  \n  const insertCarModelSql = &#96;\n    INSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, category, status) \n    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n  &#96;;\n  const insertResult = await db.query(insertCarModelSql, [\n    brandId,\n    trimmedCarModelName,\n    category,\n    'active'\n  ]);\n  const carModelId = insertResult.lastID || insertResult.insertId;\n  console.log(&#96;  ✅ 创建车型: ${trimmedBrandName} ${trimmedCarModelName} (ID: ${carModelId})&#96;);\n  return carModelId;\n}\n\n/**\n * 导入单个技术点\n */\nasync function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "async function fetchAllTechPointsFromTPD2(tpdApiBaseUrl: string): Promise&lt;TPD2TechPoint[]&gt; {\nwhile (hasMore) {\n\n\n      // 获取每个技术点的详细信息（包含关联数据）\n      for (const techPoint of techPoints) {\n        try {\n          const detailResponse = await axios.get(\n            &#96;${tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${techPoint.id}&#96;,\n            {\n              params: {\n                includeAssociations: true,\n              },\n              timeout: 30000,\n            }\n          );\n\n          let detailData: TPD2TechPoint = techPoint;\n\n          // 处理不同的响应格式\n          if (detailResponse.data.code === 200 &amp;&amp; detailResponse.data.data) {\n            detailData = detailResponse.data.data;\n          } else if (detailResponse.data.success &amp;&amp; detailResponse.data.data) {\n            detailData = detailResponse.data.data;\n          } else if (detailResponse.data.data) {\n            detailData = detailResponse.data.data;\n          } else {\n            detailData = detailResponse.data;\n          }\n\n          // 合并数据\n          allTechPoints.push({\n            ...techPoint,\n            ...detailData,\n          });\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;  ⚠️  获取技术点 ${techPoint.id} 详情失败: ${error.message}&#96;);\n          // 如果获取详情失败，使用列表数据\n          allTechPoints.push(techPoint);\n        }\n      }\n\n      console.log(&#96;  ✅ 已获取 ${techPoints.length} 个技术点（总计: ${allTechPoints.length}）\\n&#96;);\n\n      // 检查是否还有更多数据\n      if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n        hasMore = false;\n      } else {\n        page++;\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(&#96;❌ 获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error.message);\n      \n      // 如果是404或400，可能没有更多数据了\n      if\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找车型\n   */\n  async findById(id: number, includeBrand: boolean = true): Promise&lt;CarModel&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM car_models WHERE id = ?';\n    \n    if (includeBrand) {\n      sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        WHERE cm.id = ?\n      &#96;;\n    }\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [result];\n      \n      if (carModels.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('车型不存在');\n      }\n      \n      const carModel = carModels[0] as any;\n      \n      if (includeBrand &amp;&amp; carModel.brand_name) {\n        return {\n          ...carModel,\n          brand: {\n            id: carModel.brand_id,\n            name: carModel.brand_name,\n            name_en: carModel.brand_name_en\n          }\n        } as CarModel;\n      }\n      \n      return carModel as CarModel;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查找车型失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查找车型失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车型\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的所有内容\n   */\n  async getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;{\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\n    pressReleases: any[];\n    speeches: any[];\n  }&gt; {\n    // 初始化返回结果\n    const result = {\n      packagingMaterials: [] as any[],\n      promotionStrategies: [] as any[],\n      pressReleases: [] as any[],\n      speeches: [] as any[]\n    };\n\n    try {\n      // 获取技术包装材料\n      const packagingSql = &#96;\n        SELECT * FROM tech_packaging_materials \n        WHERE tech_point_id = ? \n        ORDER BY created_at DESC\n      &#96;;\n      try {\n        const packagingResult = await this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.packagingMaterials = Array.isArray(packagingResult) ? packagingResult : [];\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 表不存在或其他错误，返回空数组\n        if (!error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn('获取技术包装材料失败:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 忽略错误\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 获取推广策略\n      const promotionSql = &#96;\n        SELECT ts.*, pt.weight \n        FROM tech_promotion_strategies ts\n        JOIN promotion_tech_points pt ON ts.id = pt.promotion_id\n        WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC\n      &#96;;\n      try {\n        const promotionResult = await this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.promotionStrategies = Array.isArray(promotionResult) ?   "contents": " * 查找或创建技术分类\n */\nasync function findOrCreateCategory(\n  categoryId: number | undefined,\n  categoryName: string | undefined\n): Promise&lt;number | null&gt; {\n  if (categoryId) {\n    const category = await techCategoryModel.findById(categoryId);\n    if (category) {\n      return category.id;\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (categoryName) {\n    // 通过名称查找\n    const allCategories = await techCategoryModel.findAll({ limit: 1000 });\n    const found = allCategories.data.find((c: any) =&gt; c.name === categoryName);\n    if (found) {\n      return found.id;\n    }\n\n    // 创建新分类\n    const newCategory = await techCategoryModel.create({\n      name: categoryName,\n      level: 1,\n      sort_order: 0,\n      status: Status.ACTIVE,\n    });\n    console.log(&#96;  ✅ 创建技术分类: ${categoryName} (ID: ${newCategory.id})&#96;);\n    return newCategory.id;\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * 查找或创建品牌\n */\nasync function findOrCreateBrand(brandName: string): Promise&lt;number&gt; {\n  // 验证品牌名称\n  if (!brandName || brandName.trim() === '') {\n    throw new Error('品牌名称不能为空');\n  }\n  \n  const trimmedBrandName = brandName.trim();\n  \n  // 查找品牌\n  const brandSql = 'SELECT id FROM brands WHERE name = ?';\n  const brandResult = await db.query(brandSql, [trimmedBrandName]);\n  \n  if (Array.isArray(brandResult) &amp;&amp; brandResult.length &gt; 0) {\n    return brandResult[0].id;\n  }\n\n  // 创建品牌\n  const insertBrandSql = 'INSERT INTO brands (name, status) VALUES (?, ?)';\n  const insertResult = await db.query(insertBrandSql, [trimmedBrandName, 'active']);\n  const brandId = insertResult.lastID || insertResult.insertId;\n  console.log(&#96;  ✅ 创建品牌: ${trimmedBrandName} (ID: ${brandId})&#96;);\n  return brandId;\n}\n\n/**\n * 查找或创建车型\n */\nasync function findOrCreateCarModel(\n  brandName: string,\n  carModelName: string,\n  type?: string\n): Promise&lt;number&gt; {\n  // 验证输入\n  if (!brandName || brandName.trim() === '') {\n    throw new Error('品牌名称不能为空');\n  }\n  if (!carModelName || carModelName.trim() === '') {\n    throw new Error('车型名称不能为空');\n  }\n  \n  const trimmedBrandName = brandName.trim();\n  const trimmedCarModelName = carModelName.trim();\n  \n  // 先查找或创建品牌\n  const brandId = await findOrCreateBrand(trimmedBrandName);\n\n  // 查找车型\n  const carModelSql = 'SELECT id FROM car_models WHERE brand_id = ? AND name = ?';\n  const carModelResult = await db.query(carModelSql, [brandId, trimmedCarModelName]);\n  \n  if (Array.isArray(carModelResult) &amp;&amp; carModelResult.length &gt; 0) {\n    return carModelResult[0].id;\n  }\n\n  // 创建车型\n  const categoryMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n    '轿车': 'sedan',\n    'SUV': 'suv',\n    'MPV': 'mpv',\n    '跑车': 'coupe',\n    '皮卡': 'pickup',\n  };",

  "command": "cd /Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/todify3/backend &amp;&amp; node -e \"\nconst { DatabaseManager } = require('./dist/config/database.js');\nconst db = new DatabaseManager();\n\n(async () =&gt; {\n  await db.connect();\n  try {\n    console.log('🔍 开始诊断技术点关联车型数据...\\n');\n    \n    const sql = \\&#96;\n      SELECT \n        tcm.id,\n        tcm.tech_point_id,\n        tp.name as tech_point_name,\n        tcm.car_model_id,\n        cm.name as car_model_name,\n        cm.brand_id,\n        b.name as brand_name,\n        tcm.notes,\n        tcm.created_at\n      FROM tech_point_car_models tcm\n      JOIN tech_points tp ON tcm.tech_point_id = tp.id\n      JOIN car_models cm ON tcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n      LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = 153\n      ORDER BY tcm.car_model_id\n    \\&#96;;\n    \n    const associations = await db.query(sql, []);\n    console.log('技术点153的关联详情:');\n    console.log(JSON.stringify(associations, null, 2));\n    \n    // 检查所有关联到品牌ID=1的记录\n    const teslaSql = \\&#96;\n      SELECT \n        tcm.tech_point_id,\n        tp.name as tech_point_name,\n        cm.name as car_model_name,\n        b.name as brand_name\n      FROM tech_point_car_models tcm\n      JOIN tech_points tp ON tcm.tech_point_id = tp.id\n      JOIN car_models cm ON tcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n      JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n      WHERE cm.brand_id = 1\n      ORDER BY tcm.tech_point_id\n    \\&#96;;\n    \n    const teslaAssociations = await db.query(teslaSql, []);\n    console.log('\\n所有关联到\\\"特斯拉\\\"品牌的记录:');\n    console.log(JSON.stringify(teslaAssociations, null, 2));\n    \n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('诊断失败:', error.message);\n  } finally {\n    await db.close();\n  }\n})();\n\" 2&gt;&amp;1",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n {\n      for (const carModelData of tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models) {\n        try {\n          // 如果已有car_model_id，直接使用\n          let carModelId: number;\n          if (carModelData.car_model_id) {\n            const existingCarModel = await carModelModel.findById(carModelData.car_model_id);\n            if (existingCarModel) {\n              carModelId = existingCarModel.id;\n            } else {\n              // 如果ID不存在，通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n              carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n                carModelData.brand,\n                carModelData.name,\n                carModelData.type\n              );\n            }\n          } else {\n            // 通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n            carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n              carModelData.brand,\n              carModelData.name,\n              carModelData.type\n            );\n          }\n\n          // 关联车型到技术点\n          try {\n            await techPointModel.associateCarModel(\n              techPointId,\n              carModelId,\n              'planned', // 默认状态\n              null,\n              carModelData.notes || carModelData.relationship || null\n            );\n            console.log(&#96;    ✅ 关联车型: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name}&#96;);\n          } catch (error: any) {\n            // 如果已存在关联，忽略错误\n            if (!error.message?.includes('已关联') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('UNIQUE')) {\n              console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  关联车型失败: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  处理车型失败: ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 9. 处理技术知识点（创建独立的知识点记录）\n    const knowledgePointService = new KnowledgePointService();\n    let knowledgePointCount = 0;\n\n    // 技术原理\n    if\n}",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\nprivate async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&#96;);\n      }\n\n      return { created };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&#96;, error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射技术点类型\n   */\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\n    const typeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE\n,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en,\n          tcm.application_status, \n          tcm.implementation_date, \n          tcm.notes\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n        WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY COALESCE(b.name, ''), cm.name\n      &#96;;\n      \n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];\n      \n      // 调试日志：检查返回的数据\n      if (carModels.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log(&#96;[TechPointModel] 获取技术点 ${techPointId} 的关联车型:&#96;, \n          carModels.map((cm: any) =&gt; ({\n            id: cm.id,\n            name: cm.name,\n            brand_id: cm.brand_id,\n            brand_name: cm.brand_name,\n            brand_id_ref: cm.brand_id_ref\n          }))\n        );\n      }\n      \n      return carModels;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取关联车型失败:', error.message);\n      // 如果表不存在，返回空数组\n      if (error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n        return [];\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 关联车型到技术点\n   */\n  async associateCarModel(\n    techPointId: number, \n    carModelId: number, \n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\n   */\n  async disassociateCarModel(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const techPointId = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      const carModelId = parseInt(req.params.carModelId);\n\n      if (isNaN(techPointId) || isNaN(carModelId)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的ID参数'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const result = await techPointModel.disassociateCarModel(techPointId, carModelId);\n      \n      if (!result) {\n        return res.status(404).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '关联关系不存在'\n        });\n      }\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        message: '取消关联成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Disassociate car model error:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '取消关联失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新车型关联信息\n   */\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ProjectController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 添加项目关联（通用接口）\n   */\n  async addProjectRelation(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的项目ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const { relationType, relationId, notes } = req.body;\n\n      if (!relationType || !relationId) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '缺少必要参数：relationType 和 relationId'\n        });\n      }\n\n      let success = false;\n      switch (relationType) {\n        case 'tech_point':\n          success = await projectModel.addTechPoint(id, relationId, notes);\n          break;\n        case 'knowledge_point':\n          success = await projectModel.addKnowledgePoint(id, relationId, notes);\n          break;\n        case 'file':\n          success = await projectModel.addFile(id, relationId, notes);\n          break;\n        case 'source_information':\n          success = await projectModel.addSourceInformation(id, relationId, notes);\n          break;\n        default:\n          return res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: &#96;不支持的关联类型: ${relationType}&#96;\n          });\n      }\n\n      if (success) {\n        res.json({\n          success: true,\n          message: '关联添加成功'\n        });\n      } else {\n        res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '关联添加失败，可能已存在'\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Add project relation error:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '添加项目关联失败',\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 移除项目关联（通用接口）\n   */\n  async removeProjectRelation(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

已添加“车辆关联”和“资源展示”功能区域。总结如下：

## 已添加的功能

### 1. **车辆关联功能区域**
- 位置：在表单的技术类型/优先级/状态字段之后
- 功能：
  - 编辑模式：集成 `CarModelAssociation` 组件，可直接管理关联车型
  - 新建模式：显示提示信息，引导用户在创建后管理关联车型

### 2. **资源展示功能区域**
- 位置：在车辆关联功能之后
- 功能：
  - 编辑模式：显示提示信息，引导用户在详情页面管理资源
  - 新建模式：显示提示信息，说明创建后可在详情页面管理资源

### 实现细节

1. 编辑模式（已有技术点）：
   - 车辆关联：直接嵌入 `CarModelAssociation` 组件，支持添加、编辑、删除关联车型
   - 资源展示：显示提示信息（资源管理功能可在后续扩展）

2. 新建模式（创建技术点）：
   - 两个区域都显示友好的提示信息，说明创建后可在详情页面管理

### 用户体验

- 清晰的区域划分：使用分隔线和标题区分不同功能区域
- 友好的提示信息：使用不同颜色的提示框（蓝色用于提示，灰色用于信息）
- 功能完整性：编辑模式下可直接管理车辆关联，无需跳转页面

刷新页面后，在新增/编辑技术点表单中可以看到这两个功能区域。
